name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

description: Discover the magic of running in Svartedalen on a lovely 12 km trail through wilderness-like landscapes. The run takes you along winding forest paths, past mirror-still lakes and over hilly terrain that offers both a challenge and the joy of running. There are several stops along the way to enjoy the views and the special atmosphere of one of western Sweden’s most beloved natural areas. The run ends with a light lunch, a drink and cake at the shelter, creating a wonderful sense of community and an energizing morning for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths through deep spruce forests
Mirror-still lakes and moss-covered sections
Hilly terrain with mountain-like landscapes
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. Meet at the Bottenstugan parking area. After the run, a light lunch, a drink and cake are served at the shelter. Meet at 10:00 at the Bottenstugan parking area. 2–3 pace groups. A light lunch, a drink and cake are included.

description: Falktrailen is a trail race held at Falkenberg Motor Speedway in Falkenberg. The race offers lovely narrow trails and varied terrain suited to both experienced runners and recreational runners. There are several categories for women and men, as well as youth categories and children’s races. The course is mainly on trails, where trail shoes are recommended, but regular running shoes also work well. After the race, refreshments are available for purchase, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttans nationalpark entrance parking area, Lekeberg Municipality, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr för vuxna; 50 kr för deltagare under 18 år
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km trail in total darkness, with a headlamp as the only source of light
Reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails
Course with elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. A short briefing takes place 10 minutes before the start. No on-site registration. The national park car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. Outdoor toilets are available, but there are no changing facilities. You must bring your own headlamp with a fully charged battery. The course has muddy sections and a water station halfway. Race bibs can be collected from 16:00; sausage and a drink are included after the finish. Places are limited, and there is no on-site registration.

name: Mustaschmilen Malmö

Mustaschmilen takes place at Jägersro Trotting & Galop, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a community celebration on November 14. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable stadium experience.

Mustaschmilen in Malmö has three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an encouraging commentator along the 1,000-metre course.

A 600 m Mini Run for children starts at 14:00.

name: Kristiansund Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to Kristiansund Backyard Ultra, a unique endurance race taking place on Saturday, November 15, starting at Frei School. Participants must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour, and the race continues for 12 hours. If you cannot finish the loop within the hour or do not start the next loop, you are out of the race. This format tests both physical endurance and mental strength, pushing runners to complete “just one more loop.” Everyone who completes at least one loop receives a medal.

The races take place during the winter months and provide a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to compete and stay in shape. The event has a long tradition and includes several distances and classes suited to different levels. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which also serves as insurance.

description: Blåmansløpene 2026 consists of three spectacular races from Fjellveien to Blåmanen, with the start and finish at the same location, but on different routes featuring trails, nearby mountains and varied running challenges. Stage 3, held on 14 November, follows a demanding, technical course on trails towards Blåmanen, finishing at Tindevann. The race is suited to runners who enjoy challenging terrain and technical sections, and trail shoes are recommended. Varegg IL welcomes everyone to a great running experience in beautiful surroundings in Bergen.

description: Sognefjord Backyard is a unique backyard ultra race held in Sogndal on Saturday, 14 November 2026, starting at 08:00 from Meieriet. The race consists of a 6.7 km loop with approximately 45 metres of elevation gain, run every hour on the hour. Participants have one hour to complete each loop. The competition continues until only one participant remains who has completed one more loop than everyone else. This race challenges both endurance and mental strength, and is suited to runners who want to test themselves in a unique format with no fixed distance.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 45 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at Meieriet in Sogndal
The course follows pavements and shared pedestrian and cycle paths, in both daylight and darkness
additional: Maximum 100 participants. Minimum age: 18. Start and finish at Meieriet, which also serves as a base with space for drop bags and rest. The café at Meieriet is open for food and drink purchases, but participants must arrange their own provisions. Assistance and provisions are only permitted in the start and finish area. Each participant may have one dedicated support person in the participant area. Registration is binding and non-refundable, but the entry can be transferred to another person via Racetracker. Warnings are given 3 and 1 minute before each start. One winner is declared: the participant who completes one more loop than everyone else; otherwise, there is no winner. Start at Meieriet in Sogndal at 08:00 on Saturday, 14 November 2026. If you cannot complete the loop within the hour, you are out of the race.

This race is part of Hvam Runners’ training and racing activities and offers a unique opportunity to test endurance and speed in a controlled indoor environment.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.

additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.

name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Fakkeltoget Løvstakken
description: The Løvstakken Torchlight Procession is an enjoyable mountain hike for all ages, held every year in support of the Norwegian Cancer Society. No particular level of fitness is required, and you’re welcome to come without children. The hike up Løvstakken begins as darkness falls and the city lights become visible. At the summit, there’s a medal ceremony, a barbecue and other fun activities, before everyone lights their torches for the group hike back down. Pizza, mulled wine and gingerbread are served at the finish.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu ja -kävely
description: Forssa Park Run, which gets the whole city moving, has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, the park run always attracts 100–200 runners of different ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, and participants can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route. It passes near the centre of Forssa, through the park at the old cotton mill and along the Loimijoki River. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of Elävien kuvien, a cinema more than 100 years old.

name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: The Run for Lithuanian Soldiers’ Day will take place in Tauragė on Saturday, November 17. The event will begin at 11:00 with a 600 m run for children and parents. At 11:20, runners choosing the 1.8 km distance will start, completing three laps of the 600 m course. Participants in the 6 km and 12 km distances will start at 12:00. Registration is open online at www.begimotaure.lt until November 16. Winners in each age group will receive medals and prizes.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Løp 2
description: Necon Winter Series continues today with the season’s second race, which takes place at Fana Stadium. Race numbers can be collected in the gym from 17:00, and a limited selection of Necon Winter Series Craft products will be available for sale. Payment is by Vipps only, and live results from the race will be available after 19:15.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 2 (16. nov)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series with 8 races throughout the winter, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The start and finish are at Fana Stadion in Bergen, with races starting at 18:45. The races are held on Mondays from October to April, and discounts are available for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual through EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups with a valid license may participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km race
Start and finish at Fana Stadion
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members with main club membership and training fees (use code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist recreational members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). An annual license must be selected during registration, otherwise a fee of 50 kr will apply. Registration is through individual registration in EQ-timing. Registration is individual via EQ Timing. Without an annual license, 50 kr is charged at registration.

name: Snøkuten Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten Glestadrunden is a trail race held in Innlandet on February 10. The race offers distances of 7.4 km and 9.5 km and is designed to provide an exciting and challenging experience for participants of all levels. Participants will have the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery and challenging terrain.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 2
description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen. Unlike the summer version, all races follow the same 5-kilometre course on lit pedestrian and cycle paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. We keep the same officially measured 5-kilometre course for every race, making it an excellent opportunity to use as a test race. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions: walkers (untimed or timed), runners (untimed or timed), those who want to compete with themselves or beat the neighbour, and active super-runners.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is run on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through the beautiful, flat terrain of Kaarina and Piikkiö. All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering participants several different distances. The event includes a marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km run. The course is designed to offer beautiful scenery and varied terrain, making the run both enjoyable and challenging. The marathon course is officially measured and meets international standards, making it possible for competitors to set personal records.

name: Begbyjoggen
description: Begbyjoggen is a weekly recreational run in Fredrikstad, offering an accessible event for everyone. The race takes place on gravel paths in the lit trail network. The main course is 6.8 km, starting at the Begbyporten clubhouse and passing Bjørneklova, heading down Alleen, going around the golf course, and returning via Bjørneklova. There is also a separate 4.6 km course for those who want to walk or jog. The event takes place every Wednesday at 18:00, and tickets are sold through Strava.com.
course_highlights: 6.8 km course on gravel paths in the lit trail network
Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse
Separate 4.6 km course for walkers and joggers

Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse. The weekly gathering is listed as Wednesdays at 18:00 at Begbyporten (the “clubhouse”).

name: GIF Joggen
description: GIF Joggen is a challenging but friendly competition against yourself or others, an accessible race for everyone, or a wonderful walk in the Gressvik forest. This event is for everyone, from children in strollers to seniors nearing 100 years old. That’s how we can make the most of the day.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children's race. The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

name: Østmarka Trail Challenge
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge organizes tough and challenging trail races in Østmarka. This race, taking place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, is not for the faint-hearted, as it features 37 km of technically demanding terrain and nearly 1,000 metres of elevation gain. Participants will experience trails that cross rough, rocky ground, and after many hours of preparation, they will feel ready for this challenge.

images.alt_text: Kart over Østmarka Trail løp, som viser ruten gjennom skogen.

name: Hodelyktløpet Østmarka
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge – The Headlamp Race is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, running mainly on blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The route will be marked all the way by the organizers, but there is definitely a chance of taking a wrong turn, so it is important to pay close attention, especially at trail junctions. A good headlamp is essential! From the start at Skullerud, we follow the Flyktningeruta up to Rundvann, before taking the technically challenging blue trail downhill.

name: Hodelyktløpet i Østmarka
description: The Headlamp Run in Østmarka is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, mainly following blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The race takes place in the evening, starting at 19:30, and a good headlamp is required to navigate in the dark. Runners face challenging terrain with 400 metres of elevation gain. The race offers a nature experience in beautiful surroundings, with demanding trails. There are no food or drink stations along the route, so runners must bring their own drinks.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km of technically demanding trail running
The course follows blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka
400 metres of elevation gain and demanding trails, with a risk of going off course
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Skullerud park between 18:15 and 19:00 on race day. There are good parking options and public transport to the start area. Indoor changing facilities and luggage storage are available. The course is marked throughout, but runners are advised to pay close attention to avoid going off course. There are no food or drink stations during the race, so runners must bring their own drinks. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are by the entrance towards Østmarkaporten. Start at 19:30, with space for up to 200 participants.

name: Mustaschmilen Stockholm
description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Solvalla in Stockholm, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a festival on November 21. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors, and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable arena experience.

Mustaschmilen in Stockholm has three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-meter course.

name: Bislett 24 Hour Indoor
description: Bislett 24-hour is a unique indoor race held at the famous Bislett Stadium in Oslo. Participants have 24 hours to run as far as possible around the 542-meter track. The event attracts both experienced ultrarunners and beginners who want to test their limits in a supportive and motivating environment. The race is sold out, and prizes include a large achievement medal for those who reach 150 km (men) and 130 km (women).

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: 5 Km Sport Glexe is a certified course offering a fast route along new pedestrian and cycle paths on the way to Gvarv. This race is perfect for both beginners and experienced runners looking to set new personal records.

images.alt_text: Rød 3D-modell av tallet 5.

name: Klubbmesterskap 5k
description: The Club Championship 5K is a running competition that is part of Tjøme Running Club’s events. The courses are officially measured, and the race is run over a distance of 5 km. This championship gives members the opportunity to compete for club championship titles and set club records. The race takes place at the beautiful Grønneset by Ånøya on Wednesday, June 25, with the start from 18:00, and is designed to challenge both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Bergen Cider Marathon
description: Bergen Cider Marathon is a unique race combining running, Bergen and cider for a different kind of marathon experience. The course goes through Fyllingsdalstunnelen, the world’s longest tunnel for pedestrians and cyclists, and continues through beautiful surroundings in Bergen. Half-marathon runners complete one lap, while marathon runners complete two laps and pass through the tunnel four times. After the race, participants are invited to a cider party featuring tastings of different ciders and food inspired by Bergen and Hardanger.
course_highlights: The course goes through Fyllingsdalstunnelen, the world’s longest tunnel for pedestrians and cyclists
Three laps around Store Lungegårdsvannet in central Bergen
A measured course through beautiful surroundings in Bergen
additional: All participants receive a technical running shirt included in the price. There will be no medal, but a certificate can be printed after the race. Refreshments during the race are non-alcoholic, with non-alcoholic cider, water and squash/energy drink. After the race, a separate cider party will be held at Siderbaren, with tastings of at least seven different ciders and food. It requires a separate ticket and has limited capacity. Registration is for the selected distance, and it is possible to transfer your entry to someone else. Start at 09:00. A technical running shirt is included. Aid stations serve non-alcoholic cider, water and squash or energy drink. The cider party at Siderbaren requires separate registration and has limited capacity. Age limit: 18 years.

name: Barteløpet Tønsberg
organizer: Prostatakreftforeningen i Vestfold og Revetal Halvmaraton
description: Barteløpet Tønsberg is a charity race in support of the Prostate Cancer Association in Vestfold. The event includes a 5 km distance on a flat route starting from the motorhome parking area at Grevestien and going around Illene National Park and Semslinna. The surface is gravel and asphalt. A children’s race is also held, and no advance registration is required to participate. Race numbers are collected from the race office on race day.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km route
The route goes around Illene National Park
Gravel and asphalt surface
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, with no advance registration required. The 5 km Barteløpet starts at 12:00. Race numbers are collected from the race office on race day. The children’s race starts at 11:30, and the 5 km race starts at 12:00. Advance registration is not required for the children’s race. Race numbers are collected from the race office.

name: i Heiane ODDERØYA OPP
description: i Heiane ODDERØYA OPP is a mountain race held in Kristiansand on November 21, 2026. The race focuses on elevation gain and terrain, and is suitable for runners who want to challenge themselves on hilly ground. Treni offers training guidance tailored specifically to the race, focusing on proper training for both uphill and downhill elevation. The event is a great opportunity for both experienced and motivated runners seeking a demanding and rewarding racing experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Mountain race focused on elevation gain
Trail race on hilly terrain on Odderøya
Held in scenic surroundings in Kristiansand
additional: Treni offers a training app with guidance for the race, including an expert guide featuring mountain runner Eirik Haugsnes. It is recommended to train uphill and downhill elevation separately and taper properly before the race.

name: Tyn_deg BARNEKARUSELL Odderøya
description: Tyn_deg BARNEKARUSELL Odderøya is a children’s fun run held on Odderøya in Kristiansand. The race focuses on giving children a safe and enjoyable running experience without injuries, in an environment adapted to them. It is part of a series that encourages running and activity among children in the local area. The event is well suited to young runners who want to take part in a social and inclusive race.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Odderøya in Kristiansand
A children’s race series focused on safety and injury prevention
A fun and inclusive running environment for children
additional: The race is part of a series that emphasizes running without injuries and builds training programs based on the runner’s actual activity. Participants are encouraged to register via affiliated timing systems, but no direct registration link is provided.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 1
description: Nidaros Vinterkarusell is a winter running series organized by Strindheim IL Friidrett, with races held at Ranheimshallen. Race 1 takes place on Saturday, February 7, starting at 15:00, and offers an indoor running experience with timing by EQTiming. The event is open to all ages, with separate prices for under and over 18s, and includes a one-time license. The series continues with several races during the winter months, offering both recreational runners and competitive track and field athletes a great opportunity to compete in a social and inclusive environment.
course_highlights: Indoor race at Ranheimshallen
Timing by EQTiming
Races for all ages, with separate distances for children and adults
additional: Registration is available on the day of the event for a fee. A one-time license of NOK 20/30 may be charged in addition. Results are published after the race. Race 2 is also held at Ranheimshallen, with a 3000 m race for everyone and a 1000 m race for children. Past and upcoming events include Trønderjogg, Nidaroslekene, Nidaros løpefest and Jentebølgen. Previous races have used timing by EQTiming. The listed price information is not specific.

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed but lively trail running event where you take on Köykkyrin Hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweat, and a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere, elf-runner style! Experience the thrill of Kempele’s “high altitude” and the true excitement of hill running, with 25 meters of elevation gain. Get ready to dash across the “summit” of Kempele, where every climb is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser
description: The Braunsteichlauf Weißwasser is a traditional race held at the end of the running season, taking participants through the Braunsteich nature reserve. A particular highlight is crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, which offers a picturesque view across the water. The event is for all ages, from children to seniors, who enjoy running and walking. The race is part of the Dresden District Rankings and the Niederlausitz Cup, and is officially recognized by the German Athletics Association in the walking category.
course_highlights: Crossing the Braunsteich on the wooden Braunsteich Bridge, with views across the water
The route mainly follows public forest paths, with three short sections on quiet residential cul-de-sacs
Autumnal November atmosphere in the Braunsteich nature reserve
additional: The 5 km and 10 km routes have three short sections on public roads, which have little traffic as they are residential cul-de-sacs. The rest of the route follows moderate forest paths, some of which are cross-country style. The race is open to all age groups, and walking is also officially recognized. Participant limit of 300–500; medals for finishers; registration on site or online; free showers and changing rooms available; integrated into regional athletics.

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

Participants can compete in the 10 km race, and a 400-meter race is prepared for the youngest runners. The event is open to everyone, offering attractive prizes, medals, and the opportunity to take part in both the main race and children’s races. The race takes place in urban and park areas, providing a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km route on asphalt and through park areas
400-meter race for children
Medals and prizes for participants
additional: Online and on-site registration; the event also includes a program for children and adults, with the schedule and details available on the organizer’s website.

Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as an autumn highlight for trail runners. The race offers several distances, making it accessible to both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Preliminary race information and courses are published on the website, along with information about course previews ahead of the event. Organizer pages and the registration link are collected on the race website.
course_highlights: Running in Bockeboda Forest — woodland terrain near Kristianstad
Several distances: approx. 25 km (25–26.4 km), 12 km (12–12.9 km) and 5 km (5.3–5.7 km), depending on the measurement method
Course distances are listed with variations depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: the page mentions individual and group registration. The website mentions insurance and includes a registration link for a previous year’s edition (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Course previews have also been held ahead of the race, and late registration has previously been announced as available via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year’s edition is available in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF’s website and the RaceID page.

name: Karmøy Marathon
description: Karmøy Marathon wraps up the running season in the fresh West Norwegian air. The marathon course takes you through three towns, along the coastline on both the east and west sides of Karmøy, with the North Sea as your closest neighbour. This year, IL Trio is strongly represented, with participants in both the full and half marathon, including Emil Solli Stafsnes, who is taking part in his first full marathon. Results will be posted on Trio’s Facebook page as they become available.

name: Speira Karmøy Maraton 2026
description: Speira Karmøy Marathon 2026 is a season-ending race in the fresh West Norwegian air, taking you through three towns on Karmøy and along the coastline on both the east and west sides, with the North Sea as your nearest neighbor. The courses are nationally certified in cooperation with AIMS & WA, and the start and finish are at Åkrahallen in Åkrehamn. The event offers marathon, half-marathon and 10 km distances, with several drink stations and pacers. There are also activities for children and a social running day ahead of the main event.
course_highlights: The marathon course passes through three towns and follows the coastline on both the east and west sides of Karmøy
Courses nationally certified in cooperation with AIMS & WA
Several drink stations offering water, sports drink and cola, as well as bananas in the finish area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Åkrahallen on Saturday, November 21, from 12:00–19:00 and on race day from 07:45. Several changing rooms are available at Åkrahallen. Parking attendants help ensure smooth logistics in the parking areas. Bag storage is available in a designated area at Åkrahallen. The kiosk and barbecue are run by Åkra Idrettslag. Free 700 m children's race with a warm-up and medal. Prize-giving for all distances after runners finish. Pacers for the marathon and half-marathon. Social Run takes place on October 31, with 10 km and half-marathon distances in different groups. Race day features a marathon, half-marathon, 10 km and children's race. The start and finish for all distances are at Åkrahallen in Åkrehamn. The race website has a course video, GPX files, course certificate and course descriptions.

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in several stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races follow gravel and partially paved paths, where snow and ice may be present, underscoring the winter character of the event. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is open to recreational runners of all age groups. All runners are welcome; club membership is not required. Times are recorded electronically, and there is a cup classification for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Route around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partially paved paths
Possible icy and snowy conditions on the course
additional: The Winter Running Series consists of three races, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 20 km spread across three dates. To qualify for the cup classification, you must register for all three races. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. Refreshments are available in the start/finish area. The course may change due to official orders. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; accompanying others on sports equipment is not permitted; aids such as inline skates are not permitted; start times between November 2025 and February 2026.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: The TuS Jaderberg Winter Running and Walking Series is a popular event held annually in Jaderberg. The first part of the series takes place in November and gives runners and walkers the opportunity to enjoy some friendly sporting competition. The event is known for its winter atmosphere and the support of TuS Jaderberg, which organizes the series. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Winter running and walking routes
A shared community experience
Part of a popular series in Jaderberg
additional: The first part of the series takes place on November 22, 2026. The event promotes sporting activities in the community.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located on Św. Wawrzyńca Street. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains unchanged, allowing participants to compare results over the years. In the 2026/2027 season, the Poznań edition also includes races on 11 October 2026, 17 January 2027, and 21 March 2027. The series also features races for children and young people.

Dress for lovely autumn weather, put on your headlamp, and join us. You’ll run among torches lighting the way through the dark forest and the runway’s colorful spotlights. Geiteryggen Run 2022 was a success, with as many as 700 people registered, and we’re really looking forward to this year’s race.

description: Rambo Mosse Night Trail is a unique trail race through the fascinating natural surroundings of Rambo Mosse Nature Reserve in Mölndal. The race, which is just over 11 km long, takes place at dusk, with headlamps and a course marked with reflectors, offering a special and challenging running experience on forest trails. The start and finish are at Herkulesgården, where participants can enjoy a sauna, showers and warming soup in the clubhouse after the race. The race is limited to 400 participants and includes a medal and awards for the top finishers in the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Just over 11 km on forest trails marked with reflectors
A gently undulating course featuring a mix of forest, bogs and rocky outcrops
Run by headlamp, starting and finishing at Herkulesgården
additional: Maximum 400 participants. All participants receive a training hat from Ullmax (value: SEK 149). Aid stations with water and Umara sports drink at approximately 4 km and 8 km, and after the finish. Electronic timing with a split time. After the race, showers, a sauna and warming soup with bread and a drink are available in the clubhouse. Race bibs can be collected the day before or on race day. Recommended equipment includes a headlamp with sufficient battery life and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is limited; public transport is recommended. Start and finish at Herkulesgården. Registration is via RaceID from 1 September and remains open until 25 November or until all 400 places are filled. The entry fee includes refreshments, soup after the finish, a training hat, a medal for all finishers, and access to changing rooms, showers and a sauna.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp

description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

The race offers two distances, 5 and 10 km, on officially measured courses heading into Brusdalen, with turnarounds after 2.5 and 5 km. The 5 km distance includes a non-timed recreational class, and there is usually little traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg.

description: Rantasaunan Lenkki and Osmo Runs take place on Friday, June 8. The Osmo Runs start at 6:00 p.m., and runners are placed in age categories. After registration, runners are assigned to suitable heats, and race numbers are handed out at around 6:00 p.m. The Hintrekin run starts at 7:30 p.m. Prizes are awarded after the races, including a prize donated by Avain Säästöpankki, and ice cream is provided to all participants.

description: Trails - Flyvestationen 2025 is a race taking place on Sunday, November 30, 2025, at Flyvestation Værløse. The area is a unique trail destination

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometres, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical landmarks. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approx. 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, undulating 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with spectator support
additional: New since 2022: split-time tracking on the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to follow intermediate times. The races start at the same time, with runners lining up on the right-hand side at the start on Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Routes around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee; online registration opens on 01.09.2026; participant limits apply to each distance; timing by Race Result.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on 4 February! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in great condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: Adventsløpet
description: The Corporate Sports Association in Nordland, together with Flygt Bil, is organizing the Advent Run! On Wednesday, December 3, we’ll run to meet Advent in a fun, family-friendly race! It’s truly for everyone, as you can choose whether to walk, jog, or run. Distance: Choose between 5 and 10 kilometers, corresponding to one or two laps of the Tokleløypa trail. The race starts at 18:00 at Flygt Bil.

name: Kolding Light Run 2026 powered by Andelskassen
Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 2. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organised by the Samnanger IL Running Group. It takes place approximately every other Friday during winter at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km routes, with the 5 km route officially measured by NFIF. The races suit all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training and socialising. Wearing a reflective vest is important during the dark winter months. The running group is informal, free and open to everyone.
course_highlights: The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km routes; the 5 km route is officially measured by NFIF
The races take place in winter darkness, so a reflective vest is required
additional: The races are held approximately every other Friday at 18:30. The running group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. The event is informal and free, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the darkness. The races take place approximately every other Friday from November to March at 19:00. Wear a reflective vest.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: Vinterkarusellen 3rd race takes place in Fana, and all times achieved in this year’s series will be recognized in the statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. This means that a personal record set in Vinterkarusellen will always be recognized. Ålesund Vinterkarusell has a long history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has been the organizer.

name: Grimstadvatnet Rundt
description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is part of the Hareid Winter Series, with races held on the first Saturday of November, December, January and February, for a total of four races. The race is a 7.8 km road race that runs mostly on asphalt, and the course is relatively flat. The first race in the series was held on 5 December 1981, and the 110th race took place in November 2008. Everyone can take part, regardless of their fitness level.

name: Bergen Advents Maraton
description: Join the Bergen Advent Marathon on Saturday, December 6, where you can choose between the half marathon (21,097 meters) or the marathon (42,195 meters). The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are completely traffic-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Marathon runners complete the same loop twice. The course is gently undulating, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that runners must go up and down from both sides.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) – 3. løp, Løvenstad
description: Vinterkarusellen Romerike - 3rd race takes place on Saturday, December 5, 2026, on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen, Akershus. This race is part of Vinterkarusellen, a popular race series that attracts runners of all ages and abilities. The event offers a great opportunity to test your fitness during the winter months in a scenic area. Registration is easy through the WODira platform, and everyone can choose their category and register directly on the website.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen
Held during the winter months, with fresh, crisp air
Part of an established race series in the Romerike region
additional: Registration is through the WODira event page.

name: Borredalen Rundt – Juleløpet
description: Borredalen Rundt is the Fredrikstad district’s most longstanding recreational race, held since 1962. The race takes place on Tuesday evenings during the April-to-October season. Its approximately 5.5 km course winds around Borredalsdammen through scenic surroundings, along forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths. This is an informal weekly event with no entry fee, built on volunteer effort and a sense of community among women and men who enjoy running. Participants register at the start and set off together, keeping their own time.
course_highlights: The course follows forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths around Borredalsdammen
An approximately 5.5 km route with varied terrain: trails, rocky terrain, forest paths and gravel roads
Scenic surroundings in the Fredrikstad forest
additional: The race is held every Tuesday during the summer season, with a mass start. Participants register their names at the start and must keep track of their own time and report it to the official recording the times. Volunteers run the event, with a six-week rotation in the race office. The Borredalen Rundt tradition began in 1962.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg
location: Parking near Kungens kök, Halleberg, Vänersborg Municipality, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg 12-15 km

description: Celebrate the second Sunday of Advent with a unique running experience on Halleberg, one of western Sweden’s most spectacular table mountains. The route offers varied scenery and a close-to-nature experience through enchanting forests, past lakes and along beautiful trails, with changing terrain ranging from soft forest paths to technical sections and more open plateau trails. Along the way, enjoy magnificent views of Lake Vänern and fascinating geology that tells a story dating back hundreds of millions of years. After the run, participants gather for a festive Advent fika—a cosy and well-deserved end to the second Sunday of Advent.
course_highlights: Magnificent views of Lake Vänern
Running through enchanting forests and past lakes
Varied terrain with soft forest paths and technical sections
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. Festive Advent fika is served after the run. Meet at the parking lot near Kungens kök. Start at 10:00. Meet at the parking lot near Kungens kök. Advent fika is included.

name: Lierløpet 13
description: Lierløpet is an exciting race series offering different distances for both men and women of all ages. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with age categories for everyone aged 11 and up. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and follows the well-known Linnesrunden, an easy-to-run route suitable for everyone. Prizes are awarded to the top runners, and there are opportunities to set personal records.

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: In 2025, Itsenäisyysmaraton celebrates its 44th year and will be held on Saturday, 06.12, in Kuopio at Väinölänniemi. Several distances are offered, including the marathon, half marathon, minimarathon, and the Kultajousi Running 10 km and 5 km races. The route is 5.27 km long, flat, and runs on sand and asphalt. A refreshment station provides runners with water and juice. Participants can register in advance or on race day.
