name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

Adventsløp - Gled en som gruer seg til jul
description: Advent Run in Tønsbergmarka is an inclusive and enjoyable event held to spread joy in the run-up to Christmas and support the Church City Mission’s project “Bring joy to someone who dreads Christmas.” The run is suitable for everyone, regardless of age or pace, and focuses on community and activity rather than competition. Participants can run, jog, or walk at their own pace on a course of approximately 2.8 km, which can be completed once or twice. After the run, hot drinks and something tasty to eat are served, and 25% of the proceeds go to a good cause.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 2.8 km in Tønsbergmarka
Option to complete the course once or twice
The run is not competitive—everyone can take part at their own pace
additional: Timing is optional; participants decide whether they want their time recorded. After the run, hot drinks and something tasty to eat are served. 25% of the proceeds go to the Church City Mission’s project “Bring joy to someone who dreads Christmas.” The course can be completed once or twice. The course is available on Strava. The member price is NOK 150 without a medal or NOK 200 with a medal; non-members pay NOK 250 without a medal or NOK 300 with a medal. Bring a headlamp and reflective gear, as some sections may be dark.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail running race taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the beginning. Participants run as many laps as they can within time limits that gradually decrease. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The race is open to all levels and ambitions, and is organised with a focus on enjoying the forest.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail course with 24 m of elevation gain per lap
A substantial hill at the beginning of the course
Running in the dark and cold weather
additional: Participants have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap point, with broth possibly also available. Prizes are awarded to many participants. The number of places is limited. Start at the Dalbybadet car park at 15:30. Lap times decrease gradually: 10 minutes for the first lap, then 9 minutes and 40 seconds, followed by 9 minutes and 20 seconds. Water, cola and light refreshments are available at the lap point. Places are limited; bring a headlamp.

name: Magni Maraton 95
description: Magni Marathon 95 is an exciting running event held in Trøndelag. The course is designed to give participants a challenging and scenic experience, allowing them to enjoy beautiful landscapes while competing. The race attracts both experienced runners and beginners, and offers a great opportunity to test their skills on a varied and inspiring route.

The course is 3 km long, and you have 30 minutes to complete the first lap; the time limit then decreases with each lap. Informal and social, with prizes for the winners in both genders.

description: Bunkersen Christmas 3 km is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on Saturday, December 12, 2026. This race offers a fast and atmospheric 3-kilometer distance in mid-December, perfect for runners looking for a challenge in the winter darkness. The event is open to everyone and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness before Christmas at a classic running venue.
course_highlights: 3 km distance at Bislett Stadium
Fast and atmospheric winter course
Central location in Oslo
additional: Tickets are sold via EQ Timing through the Aett platform. The event runs from December 12 to 13, 2026. The start time is early Saturday morning at 01:00. Tickets are sold via EQ Timing.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio follows the traditional backyard ultra format, but it is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked loop of approximately 6.7 kilometres through the forest. The event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, 16 November 2024, from 9:00 to 21:00. All participants start their first lap at 9:00, and subsequent laps start on the hour. The winner is the first person to finish the final lap. There is no winner if nobody completes the final lap.

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: The Kaunas SK „Nemunas” 1000 m Race Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m event. The top places went to the Youth category: Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. Juniors, younger juniors, and children also took part and achieved excellent results.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra race designed to help runners cover the 100-mile distance as easily as possible. If you’ve never received a DNF in your life, here’s your chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner, so get ready for a challenge in Alytus.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: Sørlandstesten
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for anyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their ambitions. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the thrill of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners, and the most important thing is that you show up in good spirits and ready to run. We cheer just as loudly for the first person across the finish line as we do for someone completing their very first race.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series will be run on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness race open to everyone.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter-season series of test runs, offering the opportunity to take part in running races at all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The event is held in Ylöjärvi, near the Teivo Race Centre, and is aimed at everyone who enjoys endurance sports. Each race is 5 km, and runners can register on site. The entry fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää Lodge.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that gets the whole city moving and has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, it typically attracts 100–200 runners of all ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km course, which passes near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen, with all races taking place on the same 5-kilometre course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. All ambitions are welcome, whether you walk or run, timed or untimed, and it’s an excellent opportunity for a test run. There are 6 races in total over the winter, so bring your running shoes and join in the fun!

name: Adventsmila Kjølnes
description: In collaboration with Kirkens Bymisjon in Grenland, we invite you to Adventsmila at Kjølnes. Join us for an atmospheric race on 17 December at 18:00, with each lap measuring 3.3 km. Participants in the timed 10 km race will run 3 laps, while those in the untimed fitness class can complete 1, 2, or 3 laps. Support Kirkens Bymisjon and bring joy to someone who is dreading Christmas!

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett in Ringsaker, Hedmark. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Winter Series Snøkuten and attracts around 100 participants despite variable weather conditions. It is an important event at a time when many recreational and competitive opportunities have been canceled. Participants must wear a reflective vest and observe traffic safety, and both timed and recreational classes are offered.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
6.9-kilometer distance
Reflective vests and traffic safety are required
additional: The race attracts around 100 participants each time. Both timed and recreational classes are available. Participants must wear a reflective vest and observe traffic safety. Reflective vests are required. Both timed and recreational classes are offered.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 4. løp Jessheim
description: The Winter Series on Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Athletics Club, offering competitions for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and are part of a traditional winter series that encourages versatility and the joy of running. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which provides insurance coverage. The event is well suited to both recreational and competitive runners looking to compete in an inclusive environment.
course_highlights: Race at the athletics stadium in Jessheim
Suitable for all age groups from 6 years and up
Part of a long-standing winter series on Romerike
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which must be purchased separately. Children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance and do not need their own license. The Jessheim race has previously been organized by Ull/Kisa IL. The distance and practical details for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Team Mormor løbet, Ib's Marathon nr. 200
2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: The Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is open to runners of all ages and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, and the courses are paved and suitable for both recreational and professional runners. After the run, participants are treated to kūčiukai and tea, and can also use the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Course in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface; snow and ice are possible depending on weather conditions
Choose to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap) or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 10:00 to 11:40. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the Kaunas Running Club. After the run, participants will be treated to kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, participants can swim at Žalgiris Swimming Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo Ave. 50, Kaunas). Registration is permitted only in your own name; bib transfers are prohibited. Registration is open until October 31. Participants will receive personalized bibs. Event date: 2026-12-19

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...
Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the fourth Sunday of Advent in Lipperreihe, a district of Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and finishes at Lipperreihe Primary School and is precisely measured, with a hilly, moderately challenging profile. The scenic route is timed using the professional race|result timing system. The event is for adults and young people and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Moderately challenging route through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe Primary School
additional: Online registration is available until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start, with a late-entry fee of 5 EUR payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An event shirt in French navy can be ordered as an option. Timing uses the race|result system, with a dual transponder in the race number since 2019. Residents are provided with information about traffic restrictions and road closures. Precisely measured; race|result timing; online registration until 7 a.m. on the day of the event; cash payment only; no animals permitted.

name: Nisseløpet Lommedalen
description: Nisseløpet Lommedalen is an exciting race held in Viken. It was started by neighbors Harald Krogh and Anders Lindell to spread joy on Christmas Eve. Participants can choose between distances of 6 km and 10 km, and the race is known for its scenic route through beautiful surroundings. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners and has become a tradition in Lommedalen.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Søndagsløpet, Sarpsborg - juleløp - Gul løype
description: The Sunday Race in Sarpsborg is a traditional race held at Kalnes Athletics Stadium. It offers several courses, including the popular 7.05 km Yellow Course, which features a varied and challenging route. The event brings together runners of all ages and abilities in a social and inclusive atmosphere. Several competitions are also held, including the Triple and Super Triple, offering extra challenges for those who want them.
course_highlights: 7.05 km Yellow Course
Varied terrain with challenging sections
Held at Kalnes Athletics Stadium in Sarpsborg
additional: The race has several courses (yellow, green, red) and competitions such as the Triple and Super Triple. Results and statistics from previous years are available on the website. The start time for the Christmas race (Yellow Course) is 11:00 on 24 December. Meet at Kalnes Athletics Stadium. To register, add your name to the participant list before the start. The date of the 2026 race has not been confirmed in the provided sources.

name: Valestrandsmarka Rundt
description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a fun run organized by Osterøy IL, taking place on 24 May 2024. Participants can look forward to a scenic 4.4 km course, with a start time of 18:45. There is a great atmosphere in the svele area, bringing together both experienced and new participants, and awards are given to participants who have completed multiple races.

name: Dalborgløpet
description: Dalborgløpet takes place on December 27, the third day of Christmas, and offers a refreshing running experience during the holiday period! The course is 5 km long, starts at the sports ground at Vind, and follows Dalborgvegen along the top of Gjøvik over gently rolling terrain. It turns around after 2.5 km and follows the same route back. The race has an informal atmosphere, and runners of all abilities are warmly welcome to join in the Christmas exercise!

The race is part of the running calendar in Agder and gives participants the opportunity to experience a festive atmosphere during the Christmas holidays. It attracts both experienced and new runners and features a traditional celebration that makes it a popular activity after Christmas.

The race is an official marathon and counts toward all kinds of Kondis awards, but it lacks the pursuit of personal records. The most important thing is to enjoy a nice run, take as much time as you need, and meet new runners. Keeping the conversation going is more important than keeping your heart rate up!

Bjørnar Gangsøy won the 10 km in 36:58, while Sondre Gangsøy and Emil also put in strong performances, recording 43:40 and 25:04 respectively in the 5 km.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt Juleløp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt Christmas Run is a traditional recreational race organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race follows a 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka, starting and finishing at Furubakken sports ground. The event takes place on 26 December at 12:00 and offers a friendly atmosphere, with prizes, sveler and cordial for participants. There is a separate walking group with recorded times for those who take 30 minutes or more. The race is part of a larger race series that also includes a New Year’s race and several races throughout the year.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka

Separate walking group with timed results for those taking 30 minutes or more

There is a separate walking group with timed results for those taking 30 minutes or more. The race starts at 12:00. No licence is required for the race. The entry fee is listed as 30 kr.

name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf
location: Wolfshagen im Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf is a traditional race held annually on December 26 in Wolfshagen im Harz. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and offers a sporting way to round off the Christmas season. It is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a nonprofit club that promotes running in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the strong sense of community among its runners.
course_highlights: A run through the picturesque Harz countryside
A family-friendly course for all ages
A traditional end-of-year race on December 26
additional: The race is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a club that also holds charity runs. The event is open to recreational and competitive runners, as well as children and teenagers. No prices or start times are published on the website. The organizer can be contacted by email with questions. Information about distances and registration is available on the website; the event promotes health and community spirit.

name: Schokocross
description: Schokocross is a cross-country running event organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder, Bremen. The event features short off-road races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km and 8.2 km, as well as 400 m races for children under 10 and 800 m races for children under 14. This local club race offers competitions for children, young people, women and men, and is particularly family-friendly, with appealing race options for both young and adult runners. It traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.
course_highlights: Cross-country course at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder
Distances ranging from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, young people and adults
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, with nighttime temperatures down to -2 °C, an average of 40 mm of precipitation, and usually snow-covered conditions. This local club race has competitions for various age groups, including U8 and U10. Cross-country running in winter weather, with categories for children, young people and adults. Registration deadline: December 22, 2026.

name: Nyttårsmaraton Ålesund
location: Moa i Spjelkavika ved Moa Bussstasjon og Spjelkavik Omsorgsenter
description: Nyttårsmaraton Ålesund takes advantage of Western Norway’s mild, snow-light winter climate to offer an event for keen runners during the Christmas holiday period. In 2025, the race takes place on Sunday, December 28, and is normally the last marathon event of the year in Norway. The race starts at Moa in Spjelkavika, and the course follows Gamle Brusdalsvei. Marathon runners complete two laps, while half-marathon runners complete one.

name: Samnanger Romjulshalvmaraton
description: Samnanger Romjulshalvmaraton is held on 27 December 2026, starting at Ådland Church in Samnanger. The race is part of Samnanger IL’s athletics events and welcomes runners of all ages to a traditional activity during the Christmas holidays. The race starts at 11:00 and gives participants a great opportunity to stay in shape during the winter break. Samnanger IL offers a wide range of sporting activities and welcomes everyone to take part.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ådland Church
A Christmas holiday event in scenic surroundings
Part of Samnanger IL’s athletics programme
additional: The race is part of a wide range of sporting activities at Samnanger IL. Winter series races are also held in Nesodden before and after the Christmas holiday half marathon. The Samnanger IL running group offers group training for all levels, with an accessible option for recreational and experienced runners. The start time is listed as 11:00.

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
Romjulsløpet Jaktstart
description: The Romjulsløpet Pursuit Race has a flexible start in Fjellveien by “Damen” on Tuesday, December 31, between 10:30 and 11:00. The start and finish are in Fjellveien above Varegg’s clubhouse, where you must pick up your timing chip before the start. The course goes from Fjellveien, past BKK’s station, across the field to Permisjonsstien, and down to the water at the top of Munkebotn, with the option of an extra loop up to Stoltzen before returning to the start.

name: Nytårsløb
description: The New Year’s Run 2024 starts and finishes in Østerbro, with participants running through Fælledparken. It’s a fantastic opportunity to say goodbye to the old year

name: Total El Nytårsløbet
description:
New Year's Race in Herning 2025 – A festive start to the new year!
Start the new year with fresh air, a great atmosphere and plenty of energy at New Year's

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional end-of-year race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured the finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen, providing a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and ties to the club make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race information, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. Historically, the event has had changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen. Historical information and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: Nyårsmilen Halmstad
description: Nyårsmilen in Halmstad is a festive New Year’s race where you can choose between 5 or 10 km on a fast, easy-to-run course along cycle paths in Halmstad. The start and finish are at the athletics track at Halmstad Arena, and the race uses chip timing via the race bib. After the finish, participants are treated to a medal, sparkling drinks, snacks, music and a great atmosphere, whether they run fast or take it easy. The race is open to everyone and is a perfect start to the new running year.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run course along cycle paths
The 10 km race consists of two laps
Start and finish at the athletics track at Halmstad Arena
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 to 10:10 at Halmstad Arena. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are displayed immediately after the finish. Toilets and changing facilities are available at the venue. Valuables can be left in the covered grandstand (unattended). Parking is about 200 metres from the start. Water and Umara sports drink are available after 5 km for 10 km runners. All runners receive a medal; if you decline the medal, SEK 15 is donated to the organisation Aldrig Ensam. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest women and men in each category. Pacing for the 10 km is available on request by email. The race takes place on 31 December 2026, with the start and finish at Halmstad Arena. Provisional start times are 10:30 for 10 km and 10:35 for 5 km. Race bibs can be collected at the arena between 9:00 and 10:10. Chip timing; toilets, changing facilities and parking are available at the arena.

name: Nyttårsløpet i Egersund
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Egersund takes place on 31 December 2026 at Vannbasengene in Egersund. The race offers 1 or 3 laps in a figure-eight, with each lap measuring 1.7 km. There is also a separate children's race, making the event family-friendly and inclusive. The start is at 12:00, and the event runs until approximately 15:00.
course_highlights: The course follows a figure-eight around Vannbasengene
Each lap is 1.7 km long
Choose between 1 or 3 laps
additional: The event runs from 12:00 to 15:00. A separate children's race is also held. The race is organized by Egersunds IK - friidrett. The start time is listed as 12:00 on New Year's Eve.

name: Nyttårsløpet, Fredrikstad
description: The New Year’s Run in Fredrikstad takes place on December 31, 2026, starting and finishing at Stortorvet. The race is suitable for elite athletes, recreational runners, old and young, and offers a fun, inclusive experience for everyone. The course consists of two laps through central Fredrikstad, each 1,600 meters long. There is no entry fee or registration, and the event runs from 12:00 to 15:00.
course_highlights: Two laps through central Fredrikstad, each 1,600 meters long
Start and finish at Stortorvet
Suitable for all ages and abilities
additional: No entry fee or registration required. Tickets are sold via f-b.no. The event runs from 12:00 to 15:00. The 2026 edition starts at 12:00 on December 31. No registration information is provided.

name: Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg
description: The New Year’s Race Tønsberg has been held for many years and is a fun run for absolutely everyone. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great way to start a new year. Whether you’re in peak shape or looking for a leisurely run on the last day of the year, you’re very welcome.

name: Nyttårstrimmen
description: Nyttårstrimmen is a 10 km recreational race suitable for runners of all abilities. The race has a long tradition and is Norway’s oldest continuously held recreational race, taking place every New Year’s Eve since 1975. This year, we are celebrating Nyttårstrimmen’s 50th anniversary, with hundreds of participants expected in Grenland. Participants can look forward to a varied and enjoyable experience, despite challenges such as snow and weather conditions.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever feel-good New Year’s run at Buugi Sports Centre on 31 December 2024 at 18:00! The event is organised jointly by Buugi Sports Centre and Hippoksen Marathon Club, with the aim of offering the best way in Central Finland to start celebrating the New Year in good company with a run and a buffet meal. Participants can choose the 10 km distance, with competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 8.2 km, 7.6 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.2 km
description: The New Year’s Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year’s Eve. The event takes place on 31 December 2024 at various locations, including Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto and Imatra, and offers participants a range of distances for runners of different ages and abilities. The courses are officially measured and safe, with traffic marshals. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also offers the chance to enjoy coffee and refreshments from kiosks in the area.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PROMISE RUN. We continue the tradition started in 2018. On the morning of 2026-01-01, while the sound of fireworks still echoes in your ears, confirm to yourself during the run that your New Year’s resolutions will really come true. No competition, registration, medals or prizes—just you and your New Year’s “PROMISES.” Run 10 km and write down your goals so you can check on 2027-01-01 whether they came true. The start will take place on 2026-01-01 at 14:00 at Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The Silvesterlauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The race is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children’s race over 1.2 km for age groups 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus €3) from 16.12. to 28.12.2025 at the Stadtbad Salzgitter pool cashier. Changes of registration and late registration are possible on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is available until 31.12.25 at 10:00 without an extra fee, unless the event is full. Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race packs do not need to be collected in person. Online registration until 31.12.25, race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter, refreshments in the finish area, parking available at Salzgittersee, dogs and jogging strollers allowed

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The event begins at Zossen Town Hall Square with a ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. on the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start on the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and prosecco
additional: Ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall Square. In frosty conditions, the route is firmly frozen and easy to run on. At the finish, runners receive a commemorative medal and prosecco. Registration deadline: December 28, 2025; route may be frozen depending on the weather; commemorative medal and prosecco for finishers; event away from the stadium.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)

description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a popular end-of-year race that traditionally starts at 1:00 p.m. on December 31. The event offers a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. The race is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course runs through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 1:00 p.m. Late entries are available on site on the day of the event from 12:00 p.m., payable in cash or via PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. There is a walking category. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race has a relaxed atmosphere, with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to round off the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year’s Eve Run is an active way to round off the year, taking place around Lake Seeburger See in Bernshausen. The flat loop course on paved paths offers runners an attractive route of one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all abilities for a festive end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Lake Seeburger See
Paved paths
5 km lap (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km lap (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Bib pickup on event day from 10:30 a.m. at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Online late registration is not possible after 26.12.2025. The start and finish are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall. No bib pickup at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not start or if the event is cancelled. Run on paved paths, online registration until 26.12.2025, bib pickup in Bernshausen, no late registration, no showers, winter conditions possible, recommended parking in Seeburg.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting finale to the year and, with up to 800 participants of all ages, is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances that run through Altenrheine and each finish with a lap of the stadium. The varied courses include out-and-back sections and loops through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporting note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 m with 3 loops through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes of all ages. Each course finishes with a lap of the stadium. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive atmosphere at the end of the year, with courses in the region and a broad participant base.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2025, in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, young people, and adults
additional: The registration deadline is December 27, 2025. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben. The event is for children, young people, and active runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walking races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenau New Year's Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Pulsnitz, Saxony. With a 1.2 km children’s race, a 4.8 km fun run and a 9.2 km long-distance race, it offers a sporting option for all ages and ability levels. The race is popular with runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year’s Eve, giving participants a chance to end the year on an athletic note. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: 1.2 km children’s race
4.8 km fun run
9.2 km long-distance race
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and provides a sporting end to the year. The website has no information on start times or pricing tiers. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment, with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. Start times on December 31, 2025: 13:10, 13:50 and 14:00; on-site registration available; race distances: 1.2 km children’s race, 4.8 km fun run, 9.2 km long-distance race; refreshments provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Park im. Jana Kasprowicza, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year's Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 in Szczecin, by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children's races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia
The start and finish are by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: The race office is open on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30, where race numbers can be collected. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are located in the start area by the Summer Theatre. Capacity: 470 participants for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 for the Children's Races. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Nordic Walking and the Main Run each consist of two 2.5 km loops. Children's races are divided into three age-group heats, with distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. The program also includes Nordic Walking events over two 2.5 km loops and children's races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
location: Toruń city centre along the Vistula River, Toruń, Poland
description: The 5 km Road Race is one of the events at the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor, which will take place in the centre of Toruń along the Vistula River. The competition attracts masters runners from across Europe, offering a unique opportunity to compete on a scenic urban course. The route passes through charming parts of the city, providing both a sporting challenge and beautiful views. This event is an excellent opportunity to bring the athletics community together and promote physical activity among masters athletes.
course_highlights: Course in central Toruń along the Vistula River
Scenic views of the river and the city’s historic area
Flat, fast road course
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme for the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor, taking place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. It is a masters championship, meaning participants compete in older age categories. No information about entry fees or online registration is available on the website. The date listed in the materials is 7 January 2027, but it has not been officially confirmed. Do not confuse it with the 5 km race held during the European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń in 2026.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year’s Run will take place on January 1, 2027. The start is at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, and the finish is on Kauno Street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions. After the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea and snacks and collect commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Traditional 20 km running course
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, with the finish on Kauno Street
additional: After the run, participants receive trophies and prizes, commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The course is hilly, and in winter it may be slippery and windy. The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala; the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular with local runners as a way to start the new year.

name: Grimstadvatnet Rundt
description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is part of the Hareid winter series, with race 1 held on a Saturday in November, December, January and February, making 4 races in total. This is a 7.8 km road race, mostly on asphalt, and the course is relatively flat. The first race in the series was held on 5 December 1981, and the 110th race took place in November 2008.

Løpere klare for start i et landevegsløp.
Løper i Grimstadvatnet Rundt-løpet.
