name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast, flat 5K taking place on New Year’s Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. in Galway city centre. The route passes through the city centre, starting at the Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, and continuing along Merchants Road and through the Docks before returning via Grattan Road and the Prom, with a fast finish in South Park, beside Nimmo’s Pier. The route passes many of the city’s most iconic attractions. The race is AAI-certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year with energy and activity. It’s a great opportunity to keep your New Year’s resolutions by running alongside a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event promises good spirits, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for participants in all distances
Run on routes through Kaunas
additional: Distribution of participants’ race packs and awards are scheduled in the event programme. The event will include an official opening and a warm-up for participants in all distances. The event takes place in Kaunas and is organised by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; the event takes place in Kaunas; the organiser offers a festive start and a sense of community.

name: Ełcka Zmarzlina

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: W terminie do 16 listopada 2026 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 90 zł

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: W terminie do 11 grudnia 2026 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 120 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: W terminie do 9 stycznia 2027 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 150 zł

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: Lierløpet
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway’s fastest courses, running along a wide footpath that is popular with runners and recreational exercisers in the Drammen area. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), and is open to those who want to jog or walk as well as to fit, fast runners. There is also a children’s race, where all participants receive ice cream. Race numbers can be purchased at Lier Station, and the race starts at 12:00.

location: Torna Hällestad, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre is organizing LBT 1 – the New Year’s Run “KĖDAINIAI 2025,” which will take place on January 5 at 12:00 at the Kėdainiai Central Stadium grounds (J. Basanavičiaus St. 1). The running distances include a 400 m children’s run and 4 km and 8.5 km courses.

distance_verbose: Ultramarathon, 50 Meilen, Halbmarathon, 12.3 km, 10 km, 7 km, 1.9 km

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 4. Løp
description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in good condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

images.alt_text: Løpere samlet før eller etter løp.
Løpere som løper i et løp, sett fra en lav vinkel.
Løpere på podiet med pokaler.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where the venue was crowded and 515 runners finished the 5 km, while 247 finished the 10 km. Participation increased considerably after the previous winter race, and conditions were good despite brisk winds in some places. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of Ålesund Vinterkarusell, which consists of 5 races suited to both beginners and experienced runners.

Løpere i snø under Vinterkarusellen.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
description: The Three Kings Run is the first stage of the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on the beach in Brzeźno. Participants can take part in a 6 km cross-country run or 6 km Nordic walking. The event is open to various age and gender categories and also features a three-person team competition, with at least one woman on each team. The participant limit is 500, and the run is scheduled to start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course is 100% on the beach
6 km cross-country run and Nordic walking
Three-person teams may enter, with at least one woman on each team
additional: Race office opens at 07:30. Nordic walking starts at 10:00. Winners’ awards ceremony at 11:30. The participant limit is 500. Three-person teams (including at least one woman) can register at the race office. Choose between the cross-country run and Nordic walking. The limit is 500 participants. A three-person team may be entered, and it must include at least one woman.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvesterloppet in Gothenburg is a spectator-friendly 10 km race held on New Year's Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The flat course covers two loops through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and the area around Svenska Mässan. The race is suitable for all runners who want to end the year with a fast and festive running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and has a chance to win prizes in a draw.
course_highlights: Flat, two-loop 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and Svenska Mässan
Spectator-friendly, festive atmosphere, with firefighters cheering runners on at Gårda fire station
additional: Start groups are assigned according to expected finish time: elite, start group 1 and start group 2. The warm-up begins 15 minutes before the start. Race bibs can be collected on 29–30 December and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30 at Exercishuset at Heden. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race bib is used, and net times are shown in the results. The race starts at 12:00 on 31 December. Registration via MittLopp is available until one hour before the start, unless the race is full.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 3. løp
description: The Samnanger Winter Series is a social and inclusive running series organised by Samnanger IL Athletics. The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km distances. The Winter Series is suitable for all levels, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, maintain your fitness, or simply enjoy a pleasant run with others. Races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective gear because of the dark season.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km and 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: Races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter. The running group is beginner-friendly, free, and open to all levels. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the dark season. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 at Hagabotnane. The schedule lists the start time as 18:30. The Winter Series is free; remember your reflective vest.

Participation has increased sharply since the winter race 3 weeks ago, and the running conditions were good despite brisk winds in exposed areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km.

Choose from several distances, from 5 km to a full marathon (42.195 km), and experience the magic of the magnificent Arctic landscape. The race takes place in early January, during the polar night, when the sun does not rise above the horizon.

description: Magni Marathon is a popular marathon that attracts participants from various places. The course is known for its beautiful scenery and varied terrain, offering runners a unique experience. Participants can enjoy both challenging hills and flat stretches, making the race exciting for beginners and experienced runners alike.

There will be seven races in total this season, with three before Christmas and four after New Year. The course follows the usual route around Eikangervågen, and registration opens from 14:20.

The event has a long history, and past results are available for those who want to follow previous performances.

The races take place indoors and include distances such as 3,000 meters for everyone and 1,000 meters for children. The event is open to both young people and adults. Timing is provided by EQTiming, but times are not accepted for records or annual statistics. The series is part of Strindheim’s tradition of offering inclusive athletics events that bring the community together in Trondheim.

The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”

This event is for everyone who wants to spend winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organisers ensure participants’ comfort by offering passes for the entire series as well as the option to take part in a single race.

description: Forssa Park Run has been promoting the city’s fitness for 30 years. Each month, 100–200 runners of different ages take part. The beautiful route runs through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, with a choice of distances: 5.8 km or 11.2 km. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-100-year-old Elävien kuvien cinema.

Participants can choose from four signposted loop courses of varying difficulty in the scenic Bückeberge hills. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.

A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, and challenges and competitions will be organised for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.

The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a scenic setting. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and bringing the local community together.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.

Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)

additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and covers a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The course is quite demanding, but takes you through beautiful scenery, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. This is a popular event on Veldre Friidrett’s calendar.

Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage before the races, and family and individual registration are available.

A total of 382 runners completed the 5 km, while 169 finished the double distance. Hector Breivik from Ask was the fastest over 5 km with a time of 18:13, while Miriam Emilie Stensland Donovan from Lerøy won the women’s race in 21:31. The 10 km winners were Magne Knudsen (35:48) and Vanja Flatberg (40:26).

Each lap has approximately 80 metres of elevation gain, and medals are awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap. The start and finish are at Svelvik Sports Association’s clubhouse/football pitch at Solbakken, with the option to rest indoors in the changing rooms between laps.

The event also includes a separate children’s race, Gneist 400 Kids, for children aged 6 to 12, covering 400 metres. A café with grandstand seating will be open during the event, and race bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start.

Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Information about the distance, course and fees comes from the 2026 edition and may differ from the conditions for the 2027 edition. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

description: Run in Sopot - Stage 1 is the first race in the #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series, taking place on January 17, 2026, on Sopot beach. It’s a unique opportunity to tackle a course on the seaside sand and experience the atmosphere of a sporting celebration in one of the most beautiful resorts on the Baltic Sea. The race series also includes further editions on the beach and a race near the Forest Opera, with participants competing for cash prizes in the overall standings. The organizers invite both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this modern, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Course on Sopot beach
A race in a seaside resort with a unique microclimate
Overall standings competition with cash prizes
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes four races: three on the beach and one near the Forest Opera. Participants compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. Sopot residents can receive a discount on the entry fee by using the Sopot Card.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race starting and finishing at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. Shorter races over 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children. The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for everyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their level of ambition. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the excitement of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand. Participants follow a flat, fast route up Setesdalsveien to Strai, then turn around and run back.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: Vinterkarusellen is an annual running series featuring several distances, with courses officially measured and certified. This means that times achieved in the races will be recognized in statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has once again been the organizer.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 4
description: Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of the new Hamarkarusellen. All races follow the same 5-kilometer course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions—whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races during the winter.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart is a unique night race held in total darkness, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides. Choose between two challenging and varied courses of 6 km or 12 km, taking you over logs and rocks, along narrow trails and across rocky outcrops around Gunnebo Castle, Kallebäck and Lackarebäcksfjället. The races are a perfect Friday activity focused on adventure and experience, with an AfterRun featuring food, drinks and music waiting in the finish area. There is also a secret contest within the race for anyone looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the dark, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides
The course follows unique trails around Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället and Kallebäck
Gothenburg’s most legendary hill—Hobo Hill, with 80 metres of elevation gain over approximately 200 metres (12 km course)
additional: Start and finish at Gunnebo Castle & Gardens. The courses are marked with reflectors attached to clothespins and trail markers. Bibs and timing chips can be collected at Nordic Wellness Krokslätt the day before and on race day. Unsupervised bag drop is available. There is one water station halfway around the course, and refreshments are provided after the finish. Medical staff will be on site. Bus 754 goes to Gunnebo Park. Parking is available below the castle, but not at the start/finish. AfterRun with food, drinks and music takes place in the finish area. Trail shoes with a substantial sole are recommended; a headlamp is mandatory. A headlamp is strongly recommended and described as mandatory on the race information page; trail shoes are recommended. There is a water station approximately halfway around the course. AfterRun with music, food and drinks awaits after the finish.

name: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet
description: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet is an exciting running race held in Kristiansand. The race covers a distance of 10 kilometres and gives participants the opportunity to experience the beautiful winter landscape of Sørlandet. It is perfect for both recreational and experienced runners who want to challenge themselves in a wintry setting.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are either completely free of cars or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Each loop is exactly one half marathon, and the same loop is run twice for the full marathon. The half marathon is one loop, while the marathon is two loops.

Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, comes from a running calendar; the organizer’s available pages do not yet confirm details of this edition in Grudna.

name: 10 Bieg Pobiegnij z WOŚP
description: The 10th Run with WOŚP in Ostrów Wielkopolski is an annual running event organised under the patronage of the WOŚP Ostrów Wielkopolski Committee. The race covers a distance of 10 km and is a charity event, combining sporting competition with a social cause. It takes place in January, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to train and compete together. On race day, the organiser provides an information point at Plażowa Restaurant.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road race
Charitable event supporting WOŚP
Race in Ostrów Wielkopolski
additional: On race day, 25 January 2026, the information point will be open from 10:00 to 11:30 at Plażowa Restaurant, ul. Plażo. Training sessions count from the time of registration until the race. No information is available about start waves, participant limits or additional equipment. Information about the 10th edition gives the date as 25 January 2026; the running calendar tentatively indicates 25 January 2027. Information about the course and entry fee has not been confirmed.

description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

description: The 18th Run for Diabetes Awareness is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia, near Stara Rzeźnia, and is a charity event that brings people together and promotes diabetes awareness. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.

The start and finish are located by Stara Rzeźnia
The race takes place in the afternoon, which helps ensure participants’ comfort

Participants can sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with race information. Information about the distance, fees, and course comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026, not from a confirmed edition scheduled for 2027. In 2026, the participant limit was 400; children’s races were also held over distances of 100 m and 500 m.

description: Gramy dla WOŚP is a running event and walking rally held in the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest, partly along the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail. Participants can choose from several walking distances and an 11 km run, which was shortened in 2026 due to weather conditions. The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: The running and walking rally routes pass through the wooded areas of the Bydgoszcz Forest
Part of the route follows the Blessed Czesław Jóźwiak Trail
Aid stations are located in Łażyn and before the finish
additional: Race packs are handed out one hour before the start in the start area. The combined participant limit for the run and walking rally is 250. Time is recorded before the railway crossing in Nowa Wieś Wielka. The organizer provides return bus transport from the finish to the start locations (Plaża Piecki and Solec Kujawski). Hot drinks, firefighters’ pea soup and a campfire are available at the finish. A mobile bag drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Szczecin by Emerald Lake. The races take place from October to April, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. Each location has its own final standings, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and has a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and city parks
Szczecin: the race takes place by Emerald Lake
The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing the city and nature together
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. The main race starts at 11:00. The programme also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children, with distances from 200 m to 1 km. In Szczecin, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The races follow a regular schedule, and the race office remains at the same location throughout the season. In Szczecin, the 2026/2027 season races are scheduled for 18 October 2026, 15 November 2026, 10 January 2027 and 4 April 2027. The stated date of 24 January 2027 does not appear in Szczecin’s official calendar. The regulations specify an 11:00 start and allow registration online or at the race office on race day.

description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

description: Frikarusellen is a race organized by Idrettslaget Fri at Espeland sports ground in Arna, Bergen. The race features a certified 5 km course that starts north of Londalskrysset, runs to Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route, with the finish inside the sports ground. The event is part of a race series with several dates throughout the winter and early spring. It is a popular recreational race with a friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants of all ages.

Start north of Londalskrysset – Gamle Haukeland station – return along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground

A license fee is additional for participants over 13 who do not have an annual license. There is a fee of 50 kr for a forgotten race bib for those registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. The race takes place at Espeland sports ground in Arna. Registration is stated to be via EQ Timing.

name: Søknad Frikarusellen løp nr.4 2027
description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, with six races throughout the winter and spring. The course is certified as 5 km and runs mainly along a pedestrian and cycle path between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station, with the start and finish at Espeland sports grounds. The race is suitable for both young people and adults, with separate prices for members and age groups. It is a social and inclusive running series that encourages people to enjoy running together through the winter months.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly along a pedestrian and cycle path or a lightly trafficked road
Start and finish at Espeland sports grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is added for participants over 13 years old who do not have an annual license. A fee of 50 kr applies if participants who registered for all the races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up at the after-run with a hot drink and refreshments alongside other runners.

Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus

The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, close to the metro and bus. After the race, a warming after-run with a hot drink and refreshments is available. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding, with no refunds. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Start and finish at Stora Skuggan. description: Winterrun Oslo 2027 is the big winter running festival, taking place on Saturday, 30 January at Rådhusplassen in Oslo. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as thousands of participants gather for a magical running experience through Oslo’s streets. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish, and great prizes are drawn after the race. This is a feel-good race for anyone who wants to test their fitness or simply have fun in the winter cold.

Start and finish at the beautiful Rådhusplassen
A unique atmosphere with music and marshals providing an extra boost

There is a dedicated women’s tent for warming up and changing. Public transport to the start area is recommended due to limited parking. Race bibs can be transferred for a fee of NOK 150 via My Page. The race takes place on winter surfaces. Costumes are encouraged, and prizes are awarded for eye-catching outfits. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation in Bydgoszcz. The race features beautiful, scenic routes that encourage outdoor activity in a winter setting. The organisers place particular emphasis on the cross-country nature of the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

Winter scenery ideal for outdoor activity

The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
90% unpaved surface
Start and finish in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.

Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a running series held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event is intimate in scale, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without the need to collect a number separately for each event. The races take place on Sundays at 10:00, offering an active way to spend the weekend amid scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. The source information relates to the 2026 edition, not a confirmed edition on 31 January 2027. In 2026, the races took place on Sundays at 10:00.

name: IV Cross Smolarza
description: The 4th Cross Smolarza is a cross-country race held in the picturesque area of Krzyżowiec. The event takes place on natural forest and off-road trails that challenge runners who enjoy being close to nature. The participant limit is 170, divided into three categories: two running distances and Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only until January 23, allowing the event to be organised efficiently.
course_highlights: Forest and off-road trails in the Krzyżowiec area
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking
additional: The participant limit is 170: 70 for each running distance and 30 in the Nordic walking category. Entries are online only. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. The limit is 170 participants: 70 places for each of the two running distances and 30 places in Nordic walking. The event page lists the registration deadline as January 23, 2026, and the hours as 9:00–10:30; participants were told that grilled sausage, bread and tea would be provided.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in running and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, and welcomes both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Entry is free. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must take part in at least four races or walks at the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Entry is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The league runs from October 2026 to April 2027, with several event dates. This is the 2026/2027 season series. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 5
description: The Necon Winter Series in Bergen is a winter running series with eight races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups who pay a training fee may participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members, with different codes for free or reduced entry fees. An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Participants are responsible for using the correct discount code and paying the correct fee. The series takes place on several Mondays during the winter half of the year. A licence fee of 50 kr may be added if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 5 (1. jan)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series consisting of 8 races held on Mondays throughout the winter, with the start and finish at Fana Stadion in Bergen. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The races start at 18:45, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual through EQ-timing, with options for both annual-license holders and those without a license.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadion
Choice of 5 km and 10 km distances
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club membership fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist trim members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). The annual license must be selected during registration, and a license fee of 50 kr applies to those without a license. Registration is individual through EQ-timing. Registration is individual through EQ Timing. The annual license costs 50 kr if it has not already been paid.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 5. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing series of races organized by the Athletics Group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many local runners of all ages. The start is usually at 19:00, and the atmosphere is social and inclusive, with biscuits, squash and fruit served after the race.
course_highlights: Races in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy
Held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Race numbers can be collected from 18:00, with the start at 19:00
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00. Biscuits, squash and fruit are served to participants after the race. The running series relies on voluntary efforts by coaches, team leaders and parents to take place.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 4. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organized by Samnanger IL Running Group, held approximately every other Friday at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km courses, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The races are suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training, and socializing. The event takes place in the evening during the winter darkness, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests for safety. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training sessions and other running events throughout the year.
course_highlights: Run at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km courses; the 5 km course is officially measured by NFIF
Races are held approximately every other Friday in the evening during the winter darkness
additional: The running group is informal, free, and open to all levels. Group training sessions are held every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. Participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests because of the darkness. The races are social and inclusive, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Reflective vests are recommended.

name: BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race offering runners a unique opportunity to experience the Åkulla beech forests in their winter dress. With distances of 5, 12 and 24 km, the race features magical trails and a wonderful atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and finish are at Öströö Fårfarm, and the event is characterised by community, commitment and respect for nature. Only 600 exclusive starting places are available, making this an intimate and special experience for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Winter trail in the Åkulla beech forests
Start and finish at Öströö Fårfarm
A magical winter landscape experience
additional: A total of 600 starting places are available: 5 km (150 places), 12 km (300 places) and 24 km (150 places). You must help other runners if needed. The start list is available online. Startklar and Startklar Plus insurance are offered for refunds in case of illness or injury. Traffic rules apply at road crossings. Littering will result in disqualification. For urgent assistance, call 076-8159678 or 112. The race starts at 10:00 from Öströö Fårfarm. There is one refreshment station with energy supplies along the course. The final registration date is 2 February 2027.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging, technical 21 km loop with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-supported and unstaffed, so participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event to warm up cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed if there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unstaffed race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no cut-off time. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event for participants to warm themselves between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Skis are allowed when there is snow. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice. An external race calendar lists the distance as 241.4 km; this information is not confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

description: Grimstadvatnet Rundt is a 7.8 km road race that is part of the Hareid Winter Series, which consists of four races held on the first Saturday in November, December, January and February. The course is mostly on asphalt and relatively flat, making the race accessible to many runners. The first race in the series was held in 1981, and prizes are awarded after the final race in February to participants who have taken part in at least three of the four races. The event is a cherished tradition and brings together runners of all ages at the Hareid clubhouse.
course_highlights: 7.8 km road race
The course is mostly on asphalt
Relatively flat course
additional: Registration takes place at the Hareid clubhouse from 13:00 on race day. Changing facilities are available at the clubhouse. A one-time licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required for races outside a track if you do not have an annual licence. Prizes are awarded after the four-race series, using a points system based on the three best races, with bonus points for participating in all four. The race starts at 14:00, with registration from 13:00 at the Hareid clubhouse. Changing rooms are available at the clubhouse. Overall prizes are awarded after the fourth race; participants must complete at least three of the four races to qualify for a prize.

The race offers a unique atmosphere with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, and participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. All participants receive a medal and a drink at the finish, and the race is known for its great atmosphere and excellent prizes. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Løplabbet Bergen or in the start area on race day.

Fire baskets, torches and music along the course
Everyone receives a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen, Strandkaien 6, from 4 to 6 February, 10:00–19:00, or in the start area from 2 hours before the start. There will be approximately 45 seconds between each start group, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; bring your own baggage tag. There are no shower or changing facilities in the start and finish area. Public transport is recommended due to limited parking. Start time: 18:00. Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen at Strandkaien 6 or in the start area. Participants are encouraged to wear luminous costumes.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part series of training races and test runs held once a month from November to April. The event’s fourth race takes place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge in Ylöjärvi. The series offers several distances for different age groups and divisions, and the route follows a pedestrian and cycle path near the Teivo Race Centre junction. Registration is on site by 11:30, and the start is at 12:00. The top runners will be awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The route follows a pedestrian and cycle path
Start and finish at the Teivo Race Centre junction
Several distances for different age groups and divisions (5 km and 2 km)

A patriotic atmosphere commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising
A commemorative cast medal for every participant

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route through the forests and along the Łyna River near Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—crisp air and forest trails create a unique running atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to regularly check your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition and spend time outdoors. The organizers also cater to participants’ comfort by offering children’s races at various distances. The series concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend in the Łyna River
Variable forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s races take place over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, with different start times. The final race concludes with an awards ceremony and a bonfire with the Mayor. A one-off race entry can be purchased on race day at the race office. The race number included with a series pass is the same for the entire series and must be brought to every race. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 February 2027 at 23:59.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter competition consisting of a series of four runs and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event center by the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, passing through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race day in the morning.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails through the Warta River forests, along the Warta River
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops (42.6 km)
The course has a natural surface and is slippery and uneven in places, with leaves, puddles, and mud
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running-trail signs. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. Nordic Walking events over 21.3 km are also organized, along with 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event center is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car and by municipal and suburban public transport; free parking is available on site.

description: The 15th “Winter in Jonava” run invites runners to a traditional winter event in the surroundings of Jonava. The event takes place on cycling paths around the Jonava ponds, offering an opportunity to enjoy winter scenery and active leisure. It is a great chance for both experienced and beginner runners to test their endurance and enjoy a community atmosphere. The event takes place in February, when winter is still fully present in nature.
course_highlights: Run around the Jonava ponds
The route follows cycling paths
Winter scenery and fresh air
additional: The event attracts participants from various cities across Lithuania, and is open to all age groups. The 2024 event had 88 participants, and the scenic routes are suitable for runners of various levels.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz na Orientację Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore a variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The foundation also works to create courses for blind and visually impaired participants, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, experienced runners, and blind and visually impaired participants
A series of several events during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series comprises six orienteering rounds in different forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. Participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card for each completed round. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government. Available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
description: The Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the Gdynia Grand Prix. The races take place on urban routes accessible to different age groups and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide rules for the main race, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. The event is well organized and popular with residents and runners from the region.
course_highlights: The 1,926 m distance commemorates the year Gdynia was granted city rights
The race is held as part of the Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia
The event also includes races for children and young people
additional: In the 2026 edition, the 1,926 m race took place on Saturday, while the 10 km main race and Nordic walking were scheduled for Sunday. The schedule and fees for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging, ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at SILGAN Metal Packaging’s premises at 13 Rokicka Street in Tczew. The course runs through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny; its final route will be announced two weeks before the event. The course has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, and the race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun, and the route is marked with horizontal signs every 1 km.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
Route marked with horizontal signs every 1 km
additional: The participant limit is 200 paid entrants. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The start and finish are at the premises of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. Previous editions were held in May. Price and route information is from the 2026 edition and may differ in 2027.

name: Snøkuten - Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten is a traditional series of running races held in Veldre, starting from Kirkekretsen School in Byflaten. The races cover varying distances, including the 9.5 km Nordhagarunden. The event is social and includes both competitive classes and the option to participate without timing. Prizes are awarded to everyone who completes at least four of the six races in the season.
course_highlights: Start from Kirkekretsen School in Byflaten
Nordhagarunden, one of the race routes, is 9.5 km
Both timed and untimed participation options
additional: Untimed start at 17:00; competitive class start at 18:30. A prize is awarded to everyone who completes 4 of the 6 races in the season.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 2
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races that start and finish on the south side of the IKEA Åsane building. The course is nationally measured and suitable for all levels, with an inclusive atmosphere and qualified coaches. The series is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus and has a long tradition of focusing on community and the joy of running. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage before the race, and participants can take part in individual races or the entire series.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and certified by NFIF
Start and finish on the south side of IKEA Åsane
The course is nationally measured, with certification valid until 31.12.2026
additional: Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race bibs must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race bib costs 100 kr. The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Participants can take part in individual races or the entire series. Training sessions and races are suitable for all levels and led by qualified coaches. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45.

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 2027 Løp 2
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series featuring weekly 5 km races in Åsane, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified and suitable for all levels, led by experienced coaches. The series has a friendly and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected at the venue before the race, and participants can enter individual races or the entire series.
course_highlights: 5 km nationally certified, officially measured course
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. The race takes place on Thursday evenings. Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45.

name: Bislett Indoor Marathon 12 - 14 februar 2027
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter
description: Bislett Indoor Marathon 2027 takes place from 12–14 February on the heated indoor track beneath the stands at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The event offers distances from 3 km to 50 km, all on an AIMS-certified course measuring 546.5 metres per lap. Held indoors, the event provides stable conditions without wind, ice or rain. It takes place at a historic venue that has been in use since 1922 and hosted the 1952 Olympic Games. This is a unique opportunity to run long distances during winter in a comfortable environment.
course_highlights: Heated indoor running track measuring 546.5 metres per lap
The course is AIMS-certified, with the finish at the entrance to the track
Historic venue in use since 1922 and an Olympic venue in 1952
additional: All distances are run on the same indoor lap. Time limits vary by distance; for example, 5 hours for the marathon and 50 km. The marathon and 50 km start together. The number of available places is updated daily. The event takes place at Bislett Stadium, known for the Bislett Games and as a historic Olympic venue. All finishers receive a medal. Enter via the Training Entrance at Sofies gate 38. An NFIF one-time licence must be purchased if required.

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027
organizer: Robust Trening og Fysioterapi og Undheim IL
description: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027 is a city-centre race in Bryne offering several distances, including 5 km, 10 km in two waves, a half marathon, a relay, a children’s race and a wheelchair race. The event takes place on 13 February, with most distances starting and finishing at Bryne torg. The children’s race is an informal, untimed 800-metre run for children up to 12 years old. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop, and good parking and transport options are available in the area.
course_highlights: City-centre race starting and finishing at Bryne torg
10 km race split into two waves based on expected finish time
Relay with 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start. Parking is recommended at Bryne Torg, Time rådhus and Kiwi. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop. Children must register for the children’s race, but there is no timing. Den Robuste is a separate registration option that includes the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. The wheelchair race is approximately 200 metres, but the distance is somewhat uncertain. The children’s race is for children aged 0–12 and is untimed. The 10 km starts in Storgata and finishes at Bryne torg. Registration is through the organiser.
