description: Brooks Winterrun Trondheim is Trondheim city centre’s major winter running celebration, taking place on Saturday, 13 February 2027. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as well as volunteers providing extra motivation. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, and everyone receives a medal and a drink at the finish. The event has an inclusive, festive atmosphere, with great prizes drawn after the race.
course_highlights: Run through Trondheim’s streets, with fire baskets and torches
Music along the course creates a great atmosphere
Start waves with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km
additional: Start waves begin approximately 45 seconds apart, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; use your own baggage label. There are no shower or changing facilities at the start or finish area. We recommend arriving ready to run and using baggage transport for extra clothes after the finish. Parking is limited, so we recommend coming without a car. Parking is limited. Baggage is stored outdoors at your own risk, and there are no showers or changing facilities.

name: Nidaros Vinterkarusell: Løp 3
description: Nidaros Winter Series is a winter running series organized by Strindheim IL Athletics at Ranheimshallen. The races are held indoors and are suitable for both children and adults, with different distances adapted to all ages. The event has a friendly and inclusive atmosphere, and timing is provided by EQTiming, although times are not eligible for records or annual statistics. The series is part of Strindheim’s long-standing athletics community, which has existed since 1926.
course_highlights: Indoor races at Ranheimshallen
Distances for both children and adults
Timing by EQTiming
additional: Registration is available on race day for a fee. A one-time licence may be charged in addition (20/30 kr). Race 2 is also held at Ranheimshallen, with a 3000 m race for everyone and a 1000 m race for children. Times do not count toward records or annual statistics. Previous information about the series lists EQTiming as the timing system.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walking. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country beach route with sea views
Start and finish by the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot. Information about the distance, fees, and schedule from the previous edition may not apply in 2027.

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organized by the “Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The race takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a demanding route through forest terrain. The event is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and spend time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A demanding race through natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run; the 16th edition took place on 14 February 2026.

name: Vinterkarusellen i Ålesund - 4. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Series is a long-running race series held during the winter months in Ålesund, with five races from November to March. The races take place on certified 5 km and 10 km courses in Brusdalen, starting and finishing at BestDrive in Fremmerholen. The courses are relatively flat and follow Gamle Brusdals veg, which has little car traffic on race days. After the race, juice, cola, coffee and cake are served, and gift prizes are drawn. Participants who complete three or more races receive a series medal at the end of the season.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km and 10 km courses in Brusdalen
Relatively flat courses with little car traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg
Start and finish at BestDrive in Fremmerholen
additional: The 10 km race starts at 13:00 and the 5 km race at 13:05. There is an untimed 5 km recreational class. After the race, juice, cola, coffee and cake are served in the finish area. Gift prizes are drawn after each race. Participants who complete 3 or more races receive a series medal at the final race. Course records for both men and women are listed. The races are held on the second Sunday of each month from November to March. The 5 km is also offered as an untimed recreational class. Registration is via EQ Timing. Participants who complete at least three of the five races are stated to receive a series medal after the final race.

This stage traditionally took place in autumn, but this season participants are invited to take on the course in winter. The event offers routes of various lengths for runners of different ages and experience levels, from children to adults. It is part of the Trailo Kalvė Cup, which features routes of varying difficulty and elevation gain.
course_highlights: Routes from 5 km to 23 km, with varying elevation gain
The winter season offers a unique opportunity to run on snow-covered forest trails
Start at the Giraitiškės recreation area, Prienai
additional: There are no medals, but participants registering for the first time this season receive a Trailo Kalvė running band. The event takes place in winter, so the routes are snow-covered and require special preparation. Registration is available only for team participants; regular tickets are recommended for individual entries. Participants are encouraged to register in teams. The event takes place at the Giraitiškės recreation area, and the course is run in winter conditions.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The “We Run for Freedom” race is a unique running event in Mažeikiai, held to commemorate February 16, the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and the celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
The event takes place in Mažeikiai
Held to commemorate February 16
additional: All runners are advised to gather at the 200 m start at 11:35. The event includes various age groups; registration takes place at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants receive medals.

name: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“, skirtas Lietuvos Valstybės atkūrimo dienai
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The national run “Pabaiskas - Ukmergė” commemorates the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania and takes place in Ukmergė. This traditional event attracts running enthusiasts from across Lithuania and aims to promote civic spirit, active leisure and running. The races include an 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas and a 3 km race for students at the Ukmergė Hippodrome. After the finish, participants receive medals, and the event concludes with the awards ceremony and tea.
course_highlights: 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas
3 km race for students at the Ukmergė Hippodrome
Finish at the Ukmergė Sports Centre Stadium
additional: Race-number pickup takes place in the sports hall at the Ukmergė Sports Centre Stadium from 9:30 to 11:00. The bus to Pabaiskas departs at 11:15. After the finish, all participants receive commemorative medals, and the youngest and oldest participants are recognized. The race winners receive cups and medals. Participants are responsible for their own health, or responsibility lies with the people accompanying them. Concerts, exhibitions and other cultural events also take place in Ukmergė during the event, which draws around 120 runners.

The event welcomes everyone, from recreational runners to competitive super-runners, and focuses on the joy of running, personal achievement, and socializing throughout the winter. The start and finish are at Prestrudhallen, where light refreshments and facilities are also available. Gun time is used for ranking, while net time is shown in the results list.

The course runs mainly on segregated walking and cycling paths, with some pavement along low-traffic streets

Gun time is used for ranking; net time is shown in the results list. Registration via EQ Timing is open until the start. The course is cleared of snow and gritted as needed; a reflective vest is recommended, but a headlamp is not necessary.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r2 - 5000m/10000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series s3r2 is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo, with distances of 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters. It is part of a popular distance series that attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The race takes place on a classic athletics track and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year in a welcoming environment. The event is well organized and suited to anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience.

The distances are 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters on the track
Well suited to both recreational and competitive runners

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who focus on the aesthetic qualities of their routes. The event takes place in scenic locations, such as the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden in Zielona Góra. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The organizers promote running and make cross-country routes appealing.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Scenic, attractive surroundings along the route
The autumn route follows a two-lap course
additional: The race takes place on a two-lap course. The organizers celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka in 2026. The event is part of a series of cross-country races held at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond.

name: Klajoklio maratonas #25: Kūjagalviai
description: The KLAJOKLIS Marathon is a traditional running event in Lithuania, held in various locations since 2020. It brings running enthusiasts together for unique marathons where they can experience different natural and urban environments. The marathon takes place in a different location in Lithuania each year, and the 25th edition in 2027 will be held in Kūjagalviai. The event is intended for both experienced runners and amateurs who want to test their endurance and enjoy running in nature.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a recurring race organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held on scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare. The event is part of an autumn-winter race series that passes through various towns, offering participants varied and challenging courses. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners looking to test their endurance over the marathon distance. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and support runners at every stage of preparation and competition.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare
Varied and challenging running sections
Part of a regional autumn-winter race series
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon is co-financed by the Nowy Tomyśl County. Registration for the races usually opens several months before the event. The event takes place on weekends, and the routes change as the series moves to different locations. It is part of a series held in the autumn-winter period; the available information about the format comes from the 2025/2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses

name: Bieg Zimowy Jarocin
location: Forest near the intersection of al. Niepodległości and ul. Przemysłowej, Jarocin, Poland
description: The Jarocin Winter Run is a unique race of approximately 8 km, held in a picturesque forest in Jarocin. Runners start at 15-second intervals, ensuring safety and an exciting race against the clock. The course is a fast, marked forest loop, ideal for fans of winter running and woodland scenery. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. The participant limit is 300, and the race is open to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

Starts at 15-second intervals — an individual race against the clock
The course winds among snow-covered trees in Jarocin’s picturesque forest
additional: Participant limit: 300. Course time limit: 90 minutes. The race office and Finisher Zone, where a hot recovery meal is served, are open from 11:30 to 15:00 at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Participant limit: 300; time limit: 90 minutes. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, water, and a recovery meal. The race office is located at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Available sources give the date as 28 February 2027, not 21 February.

description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.

100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run of Poland’s Marriage to the Sea is a historic race connecting the two Józef Haller monuments in Władysławowo and Puck, inspired by events from 1920. The race route runs from Władysławowo to Puck and opens the Puck Running Triad. STONE TRI & RUN has taken over the organization of the race, bringing it new energy while continuing the tradition of this iconic event. Participants can expect a clearly marked route, a route map, and organizational support during the event.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
A race connecting two Józef Haller monuments
Opens the Puck Running Triad
additional: A personal race guide is available, featuring the current route, a map, rules, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. The 2026 edition also offered an 11.5 km Nordic Walking event. The information provided about the distance and organization refers to the previous edition.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 6
description: Necon Winter Running Series Bergen is a winter race series featuring eight races throughout the winter, with participants able to choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The races take place on Mondays from October to April, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-Timing, and discount codes are available for different membership groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Races take place on winter evenings, starting at 18:45
additional: IL Gneist members can use discount codes: Gneist00 for a free race, Gneist50 for 50% off, and Gneist25 for 25% off. An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration responsibility and payment are handled via EQ-Timing. The races are held as a series, with the option to register for the entire series or individual races. Registration is individual via EQ-Timing. IL Gneist members are eligible for discounts. Participants over 13 may need an annual licence; a surcharge of NOK 50 is listed for those without an annual licence.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 6 (22. feb)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups can participate for free with a valid licence.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races start at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for members of IL Gneist athletics (free with a valid licence), Gneist trim (50% discount), and other Gneist groups (25% discount). Discount codes must be used when registering. A year-round licence costs 50 kr if not already paid. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Start from 18:45. Individual registration via EQ-Timing. A year-round licence costs 50 kr if it has not already been paid.

name: Poznań Malta #62
description: Poznań Malta is a recurring running event organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, held in the picturesque area around Lake Malta in Poznań. The event brings together runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time outdoors. The route runs along the lake, providing beautiful views and comfortable conditions for both competition and recreation. It is a great opportunity to connect the local running community and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Malta
Picturesque views of the lake and greenery
Friendly atmosphere for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts
additional: The event is organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, a group that holds regular running and Nordic walking meetups in Poznań. The event is recurring and community-oriented, promoting physical activity and having fun.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 8. løp Lillestrøm
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place in Lillestrøm and the surrounding area and are part of a traditional winter series that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, ensuring insurance coverage and medical assistance if needed. The event promotes versatility and combines training and competition in a social setting.
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must purchase an athletics license individually. Children under 13 are covered by the child sports insurance and do not need their own license. Lørenskog Friidrettslag has training groups for different age groups and ability levels, and organizes several running and athletics events in the area. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the Child Sports Insurance.

description: The Bergen Marathon Series is a series of six races throughout the year, where participants can run both the half marathon and the full marathon. Bergen is regarded as Norway’s number one marathon city, and the series places great emphasis on quality and runners’ enjoyment, even though the races offer tough challenges. By completing five of the six races in the series, you receive a commemorative plaque. The February Marathon is the second race in the series and is held during the winter months, offering a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year.
course_highlights: The races are held in Bergen, known as Norway’s number one marathon city
The series consists of six races, with both half-marathon and full-marathon options
The courses are quality-assured with a national course certificate and an IAU label
additional: Kondis membership gives a NOK 50 discount. You can provide an annual licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation to avoid paying for a one-time licence. The minimum age for the marathon is 18. The Bergen Marathon Series is held in collaboration with BFG Bergen Running Club. It is possible to rent a function room at Fana Stadium. Complete five of the Bergen Marathon Series races to receive a plaque. Details about registration and the 2027 edition are not provided in the sources.

name: Maratonkarusellen 2027 Løp 2 Februar Maraton
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
description: Maratonkarusellen organizes several races in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, focusing on quality and a great experience for participants. The races include both half and full marathons, as well as other distances such as 10 km and ultramarathons. The February Marathon, held in Bergen, offers a challenging and beautiful course, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium. This race is part of a series of six races held throughout the year and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Course starts and finishes at Fana Stadium in Bergen
Includes both half-marathon and marathon distances
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, with a focus on quality
additional: Maratonkarusellen organizes three races in the spring and three in the fall each year. The races also include Bergen Skogsmaraton, with a 10 km distance, and Bergen Ultra, with 63.3 km and 100 km distances. Maratonkarusellen has hosted the Norwegian 100 km Championships six times. The focus is on making sure all participants enjoy themselves despite the tough challenges. Available distances are half marathon (21,097 meters) and marathon (42,195 meters).

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail is a unique winter adventure in Inari, offering participants the chance to experience Arctic nature and the Northern Lights. This winter trail-running event takes runners through stunning scenery in the Lapland wilderness, offering unforgettable experiences immersed in nature. The event is part of the Trail to Be Alive series, known for its high-quality and memorable trail races around the world. Runners can expect a challenging but rewarding course that combines the tranquillity of nature with the beauty of winter.
course_highlights: Arctic winter wilderness in Inari
A chance to see the Northern Lights
A challenging trail-running course immersed in nature
additional: The event is part of an international trail tour, but further details about the course or registration are not available.

Runners start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street and run a loop of approximately 2 km, which they can complete as many times as they like, with a minimum of two loops. The race lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The event combines athletic competition with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers.
course_highlights: Start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street
Approximately 2 km loop with a turnaround on Juliana Kubiaka Street
1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the end
additional: Runners may complete as many loops as they like, with a minimum of two. The race has a time limit of 1.5 hours. A fire siren signals the end of the race. In the previous edition, the time limit was 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signaled its end. The date of the 2027 edition is given as approximate.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held on different dates and at different locations in Biskupiec and the surrounding area. The races cover distances from approximately 2 km to 10 km, with routes through scenic areas by Lake Dadaj and Lake Kraksy, as well as the Municipal Park. Each race is electronically timed, and the overall standings are based on gun times. The organizers set a participant limit and offer registration both online and on race day. The event is open to individual runners and relay teams, and the courses are clearly marked and lit.
course_highlights: The Mors Run course is approximately 10 km, on asphalt and cobblestones
The Morning Run is approximately 5 km around Lake Kraksy Małe and the allotment gardens
The Night Run is approximately 8 km along paths, cycling routes, and through the Municipal Park
additional: Each race has a participant limit of 200. The race office is open on race day from 1 to 1.5 hours before the start. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. Bibs must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Courses are marked every 1 km and have hydration points. The Midday Run is an individual race over approximately 5 km. The Night Run starts at 19:53 and lasts about an hour.

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

name: Mistrzowski Bieg
location: Park przy ulicy Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The Mistrzowski Run in Toruń is a recreational family run held in the park on Bema Street. Participants compete over 800 metres for the youngest runners and 4 kilometres for older participants. Every participant receives a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The event promotes physical activity and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park on Bema Street
Two distances: 800 m for children and 4 km for adults
Commemorative T-shirts and medals for participants

The run is a family-friendly recreational event held in the city park. Participants receive a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships.

name: SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on the Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km route on the Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km laps
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Manned aid stations at km 15/45 and an additional one near the finish area for the 50 km. Heated cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish through Des ti nation Snogeholm. Start and finish at Gydarps gård in Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km. Emergency blanket and mobile phone are mandatory equipment. Limited number of places.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in picturesque forests and urban parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a regular, well-established route. The races are open to anyone aged 16 and over and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a recurring race series.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season across 7 locations. Four races are scheduled in Bydgoszcz: November 7, 2026; December 12, 2026; January 23, 2027; and March 6, 2027. During the 2026/2027 season, the Bydgoszcz races take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Participant Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the event offers two distances: 1,963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, giving participants the opportunity to honor the soldiers’ memory while running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1,963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers and their historical legacy
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. The start and finish are in Zalesie, near Ryki. Information about the 2027 edition in Zalesie, including local distances and registration, has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new race series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timing, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is an event for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful views of coastal Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone is available with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala is held at Seaside Park Hotel* and includes a quiz and prizes. Full sanitary facilities are provided: bag drop, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special accommodation discounts at Seaside Park Hotel* are available during the event. The organizers promise professional timing, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel. Available sources describe the 2026 edition and do not confirm a race on the stated date of February 28, 2027.

name: Prusice biegają
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prusicach
description: Prusice Biegają is a series of races organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre in Prusice, bringing together residents of all ages—from the youngest to adults. In the 14th edition, runners compete across four stages of the overall standings and receive a medal at the end for completing the entire series. Children can take part in the special “Prusice Biegają od Małego” category, combining sporting fun with their first race-day excitement and a medal at the finish. The event is about more than running: it also offers shared cheering and a great atmosphere in Prusice.
course_highlights: Four stages in the overall standings
Special category for the youngest participants: “Prusice Biegają od Małego”
Medal for completing the entire series
additional: The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and encourages participation with family and friends. It is about more than competition, with shared cheering and a friendly atmosphere. Participants who complete the entire series and children in the younger category receive medals. In the previous edition, medals were planned for completing the entire series, including for children.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka” and is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Sopot under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event takes place as part of the National Day of Remembrance of the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timing. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, attendees sing soldiers’ songs together and share food from a field kitchen, creating a unique atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka”
No timing—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal; after the run, there was group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen. Details of the edition on 28 February 2027 are not confirmed by available sources.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 6. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing race series organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many runners of all ages. The event offers a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with light refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Run through scenic surroundings in Bjørgene, Karmøy
Races are held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Start at 19:00; race bibs can be collected from 18:00
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 18:00. Juice, biscuits and fruit are served after the finish. The running series is organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club and relies on volunteer efforts.

description: Bolechowo Na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night #73, is a free sporting event held in Bolechowo. It is an active gathering for the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 5. løp
description: Samnanger IL Running Group invites you to Vinterkarusellen, a friendly and sociable race starting and finishing at Nesodden. You can choose between 2 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The race is suitable for all levels and paces, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, maintain your fitness or simply enjoy a sociable run. Remember to wear reflective gear, as it is dark at this time of year.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km or 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: The race is held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter. It is a free, accessible event suitable for everyone. The running group focuses on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the dark winter season. Start at 18:30. The organizer reminds participants to wear reflective gear in the dark.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V is a winter test-run race series held around Teivo racecourse once a month from November to April. The race covers a 5 km route and is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. Registration takes place on site at least one hour before the start. The entry fee is €10 per event, or €7 for club members. The series has men’s and women’s categories as well as a team competition.
course_highlights: 5 km running route around Teivo racecourse
Winter race series running from November to April
Suitable for runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes
additional: Registration takes place on site at least one hour before the start. The series has men’s and women’s categories as well as a team competition. It’s a great opportunity to regularly test your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. The organizers make things comfortable for participants by offering passes for the whole series as well as the option to enter a single race.

Varied forest terrain and natural winter conditions

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn Forest Parking, Łyse Lake, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter running tournament consisting of a series of four running events and Nordic Walking walks, held on forest tracks and trails in the forests along the Warta River. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, as well as Nordic Walking walks over the half-marathon distance. This is a small-scale event for both recreational and professional athletes, featuring themed races and seasonal touches. The start and race office are located by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. The gun start for each race is at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with some paved sections and slippery surfaces depending on the weather.
The half-marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of total elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, covering 42.6 km in total.
The course is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail, and passes, among other places, a landmark oak and stream cascades.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, races and walks over 5 km and 10 km distances are also held. Each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and touches. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bicycle computers and a Garmin. The start and event centre are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00; race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. Free parking is available, and the venue can also be reached by bus.

name: Lapland Arctic Ultra
description: Lapland Arctic Ultra is an extreme winter race held in Överkalix, Swedish Lapland. The race offers several distances from 20 km to 500 km, and participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. The courses follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests, with spectacular views and challenging Arctic conditions. The start and finish are at Grand Arctic Resort, and the race crosses the Arctic Circle twice on the 185 km distance. This is a unique challenge for endurance athletes who want to test their limits in Europe’s last wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses on snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests
The 185 km distance crosses the Arctic Circle twice
Start and finish at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix
additional: Participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. A mandatory training camp is required for participants with no experience in extreme cold. Transfers are available from Jockfall to the start area, including transport of pulks. There is no prize purse. Drop bags are not allowed under the rules. The start is at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix, beside the Kalix River. A training course is planned for 2–5 March 2027 and is mandatory for participants with no experience in extreme cold.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity, on Spokojna Street in Gdynia. The races take place in forests and urban parks, combining a city atmosphere with contact with nature. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in the overall and local standings. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and also offers races for children and young people.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Location in the Gdańsk Forest District and around the Mały Kack estate in Gdynia
Races take place in the natural setting of the Tricity Landscape Park
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule includes the main race starting at 11:00 and CITY TRAIL Junior races for children in different age categories. A pass for the entire series also includes one free race in a city other than the main location, provided participants notify the organizers by email in advance. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The race starts at 11:00.

description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race takes place on a scenic route in Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish at Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of accompanying activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of two 2.5 km loops along paths in Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish at Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green space in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: The race office is open on 7 March 2026 (10:00–18:00) at the Szczecin Philharmonic and on 8 March 2026 (09:00–10:30) at the Institute of Pedagogy of the University of Szczecin. Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old are held over 200 m and 1 km. The mini-race participant limit is 300; once the limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limited to 20 race numbers). Official race T-shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The running and Nordic walking routes follow paths through Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic walking and mini-races. The organizers announced that registration for the next edition would open on 12 December 2026 at 12:00.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races held as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, taking place in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide appeal. They are a great opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and its local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through Toruń’s Old Town Market Square
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed landmarks
additional: Children’s races are held at every edition; in March, they take place alongside the main race. Online registration for the first edition of the Trilogy is open until March 1, 2026. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional support and a friendly atmosphere. Available sources describe the edition on March 8, 2026, and do not confirm details of the event planned for March 7, 2027.

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett, marking the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. The race takes place in Ringsaker, Hedmark, and attracts around 100 participants despite varying weather conditions. Participants must wear a reflective vest and take care in traffic. Both timed and fitness classes are offered. The event is especially important this year, with many opportunities for exercise and competition having been cancelled.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
Distance of 6.9 kilometers
Reflective vest required; participants must take care in traffic
additional: Both timed and untimed fitness classes are available. The event attracts around 100 participants each time. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. A reflective vest is required; a headlamp and good winter footwear may be useful.

name: Cytadela by Night # 112
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The runs cover a distance of approximately 5 km and attract both recreational and more experienced runners. The event combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend an active evening in the park’s scenic surroundings. It is very popular and held regularly, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Cytadela Park in Poznań
Approximately 5 km with timekeeping
An evening route through scenic, green surroundings
additional: The runs are free and held regularly, with timekeeping. The event is recreational and open to everyone. Timed run.

name: Frikarusellen - 6. løp
location: Espeland Idrettsplass, Espeland, Arna, Bergen, Norway
description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, Bergen. The races take place on a certified 5 km course that starts at Espeland sports ground and runs via Gamle Haukeland station, mainly on walking and cycling paths with little traffic. The series consists of six races throughout the winter and is suitable for both young people and adults, with a friendly atmosphere and a shared love of running. IL Fri has a long tradition as an organizer and also offers discounts for club members.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly on walking and cycling paths or roads with little traffic
Start and finish at Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee applies in addition for participants over 13 without an annual license. A fee of NOK 50 applies for forgotten race numbers for those registered for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Race-number distribution and changing facilities are available from 18:00.

name: Frikarusellen løp nr.6 2027
location: Espeland idrettsplass, Espeland, Arna, Bergen, Norway
price_range: 65–80 kr for enkeltløp; 300–450 kr for hele serien
description: The Frikarusellen is a race series organized by IL Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and measured again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset intersection via Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout the season and is suitable for both young people and adults. You can register easily via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day at Espelandshallen.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course
Starts north of the Londalskrysset intersection and returns along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers are collected at Espelandshallen between 18:00 and 18:55 on race day. Registration is open until 18:55 on the same day. A licence fee is added for participants over 13 who do not have an annual licence. There is a fee of NOK 50 for a forgotten race number for those registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration via EQ Timing is available until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee may be added. Series registration is also available, with separate prices for IL Fri members.

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui - Jonava” race is a Lithuanian Running Cup event held in Jonava. It invites recreational and professional runners to take part in various distances, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting spirit. The race is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup, which includes several stages across the country. The event is organised by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė to promote running and encourage people to take part in competitions regularly.
course_highlights: More than 1,100 participants from Lithuania and abroad
Traditional distances: 2 km and 15 km
Events and concerts commemorating March 11
additional: Registrations are administered and entry fees collected by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant no later than the closing of advance registration; a fee of 10 euros applies. The first race stage starts at 08:00. The event is a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and offers awards and a photo gallery. Runners of all age groups are invited to participate.

description: The “Pamario Cup” run is a traditional event in Šilutė, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and popularizing running. The event is organized by Šilutė District Municipality together with local sports organizations. Participants are invited to run various distances, including a 400 m children’s course in the city center by the municipality. The event has a friendly atmosphere and aims to bring together both local residents and visitors.
course_highlights: Start by Šilutė District Municipality
Children’s course – 400 m in the city center
Participants run with electronic timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed on race day by Šilutė Cultural Center and on March 10 at the reception desk of Šilutė Leisure and Sports Center. Children participating in the run may be accompanied by one parent or guardian. Each participant must attach their bib, which contains an electronic timing chip, to the front of their shirt. The event takes place in Šilutė and is often associated with Lithuania’s Independence Day; it has about 500 participants, offers various distances, and awards prizes.

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: Landeveisløp 8km
location: IL Skade Clubhouse, Kåsa, Nome, Telemark, Norway
description: The Lunde Road Race is a traditional 8 km road race organised by IL Skade’s athletics group. It follows the beautiful, flat route alongside the Telemark Canal, starting and finishing at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa. The race has a long history and has been held more than 50 times, previously as part of the Vinterkarusellen in Telemark. After the race, participants are invited to socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving at the clubhouse, where changing rooms and showers are also available.
course_highlights: Flat route of approximately 7.8 km alongside the Telemark Canal
Start and finish at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa
More than 50 years of tradition; one of the oldest races in the area
additional: Registration is available on race day at the clubhouse from approximately 11:00 to 12:30, or by SMS to Sveinung Håland (98 62 38 62). Changing rooms and showers are available at the clubhouse. After the race, participants can socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving. Registration on race day is at the clubhouse from approximately 11:00 to 12:30, or by SMS.

description: The Winter Oak Run is an annual sporting event held since 2012. It attracts an ever-growing number of participants and is an important sporting event in Mogilno County. The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.
course_highlights: Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek
additional: The start and finish are by the school sports field of the School Complex in Dąbrowa, ul. Sportowa. The event includes children's races over distances from 60 m to 1,000 m and a 7.5 km Nordic walking event. Electronic timing. Awards ceremonies and prize drawings take place in the sports hall in Dąbrowa. The race office is open from 07:00; registration closes at 10:45. The start and finish are by the School Complex sports field on ul. Sportowa; the race office is in the sports hall. The race pack includes, among other things, a medal, a hot meal and an SMS with the result. Registration is open until 3 March 2027; there is no race-day registration or fee.

name: Mistrzostwa Polski Masters w Biegach Prz...
description: The Polish Masters Cross Country Championships are national championships for masters runners, held in the scenic Rudelka Park in Toruń. The event brings together experienced runners in various age categories, offering competition on challenging cross-country courses. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting camaraderie and to test your abilities in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Rudelka Park
Varied natural terrain
Scenic park surroundings in Toruń
additional: Contact and organizational matters are handled through the registration form on the contact page, enabling quick contact with the organizer and system administrator. Online registration is open until 4 March 2027 at 23:59; the rules also allow registration at the race office on event day from 9:00.

name: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury
description: Odlotowa 5 - Olsztyn Mazury is a 5 km race held in the scenic area around Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany. The event takes place annually and attracts runners of various age groups, offering a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The course is fast and accessible to runners of varying experience levels. Participants can expect efficient service and the option to collect their race packs on race day or the day before.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Olsztyn-Mazury Airport in Szymany
Fast, flat course conducive to good results
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office in Szczytno on 22.03.2025 or in Szymany on 23.03.2025. Authorization is required to collect a race pack, as is parental consent for minors. Olsztyn-Mazury Airport co-organized the 2026 edition. Sources for that edition stated a limit of 600 participants and a 60-minute time limit for the 5 km distance; it has not been confirmed whether these rules will apply in 2027.

description: Run in Sopot III is a 5 km beach race held by the Sopot pier. The start and finish are on the beach by the pier, and the course follows a scenic stretch along the coast. The race takes place in an intimate atmosphere, with the number of participants limited to 250 to ensure comfort and safety. The race is scheduled to start at 10:00, and participants line up in the designated starting area. The race is also open to Sopot residents with a Sopot Card and to people over 65, who have special participation terms.
course_highlights: A 5 km course on the beach by the Sopot pier
Start and finish on the beach by the pier
The race takes place in an intimate atmosphere, with a limited number of participants
additional: The participant limit is 250. People without a race number may not be on the course, except for people organizing the race. Participants line up in the designated starting area. Special pricing terms apply to Sopot residents with a Sopot Card and people over 65. The on-site entry fee is 99 PLN (or 0 PLN for people aged 65 and over). The limit is 250 participants. Information about Run in Sopot III confirms the edition scheduled for 14 March 2026; the date 13 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: Edsvidsleden Trailrun
price_range: 50 kr för T-shirt från tidigare år
description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 14 km course on the classic Edsvidsleden trail in Trollhättan
The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged
Water is available at approximately 9 km and in the start and finish area
additional: The start and finish have been moved to Forngården in Trollhättan. There is no parking at the start; park on the streets in Strömslund or at Torsbovallen. Bring your own water and cup. T-shirts from previous years will be sold on race day for 50 kr each. Course records for men and women are listed for the 14 km, 28 km and 56 km distances from previous years. All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Vinterkarusellen i Ålesund - 5. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Series is a long-standing race series held over five races during the winter months in Ålesund. The races take place on officially measured courses in Brusdalen, over distances of 5 and 10 km, and start at BestDrive in Fremmerholen. The courses are relatively flat and follow Gamle Brusdals veg, with little traffic on race days. After the race, juice, cola, cake and coffee are served, and medals are awarded to those who take part in three or more races in the series.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 and 10 km courses in Brusdalen
Relatively flat courses with little traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg
Start and finish at BestDrive in Fremmerholen
additional: The races start at 13:00 for the 10 km and 13:05 for the 5 km. There is a non-timed recreational category over 5 km. Gift prizes are drawn after each race. Medals are awarded to participants who complete three or more races in the series. Juice, cola, cake and coffee are served in the finish area after the race. Registration is through EQ Timing. The 5 km is also available as a non-timed recreational category. Juice, cola, cake and coffee are served in the finish area.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run approximately 14.5 km long, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.
