description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a cross-country running series held in the forested areas near the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved sections, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The start and finish are in the same location, making it easier to organize the event and cheer on the runners. Participants receive a medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Municipality of Śrem and the Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: An approximately 5.4 km course on forest paths and paved sections
Start and finish at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, in one convenient location for runners and spectators
A run surrounded by forest near the center of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. The warm-up and opening are scheduled for around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. A medal, a post-race meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications are provided. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. Information about the price and details of the edition scheduled for 14 March 2027 has not been confirmed by available sources.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland surroundings. The Szczecin course is varied and located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, by Emerald Lake, with challenging uphill and downhill sections. The event is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in woodland surroundings by Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at the edge of Kopalniana Street
Varied sections with uphills and downhills, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the 11:00 start, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. Races are held regularly during the season, from October to April. The start and finish are behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street; the race office is next door. According to the official calendar, Szczecin has no race on 14 March 2027—the Szczecin race dates for the 2026/2027 season are 18 October, 15 November, 10 January and 4 April.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
location: Wapnica, Międzyzdroje, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting event that invites running and Nordic walking enthusiasts to compete on courses of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners, and 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers. The league takes place during the 2026/2027 season, starting on October 18, 2026, and ending on April 11, 2027. Participation is free, and participants can enjoy healthy competition in a fun atmosphere on the beautiful routes of the Municipality of Międzyzdroje. To be included in the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Both regular participants and newcomers are welcome to run and walk together.
course_highlights: Running courses of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking courses of approximately 5 and 7 km
Beautiful routes in the Municipality of Międzyzdroje
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written consent from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be ranked in the league, participants must compete in at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km races, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events. The league is known for healthy competition in a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere full of smiles and fun. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events. The minimum age is 14; minors participate with a parent’s or guardian’s consent and under their supervision. The official website schedule lists the Wapnica event in this edition on March 21, 2027, not March 14.

name: Murowana Goślina Półmaraton
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Murowanej Goślinie
description: The Murowana Goślina Half Marathon is a historic race dating back to 1978. Initially organized for masters athletes, it is now open to everyone who wants to take on the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km. The race has a rich tradition and runs through the scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina. After a break caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the race was revived in 2025 by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Murowana Goślina.
course_highlights: A classic half-marathon distance of 21.097 km
Scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina
A tradition dating back to 1978, with a history of races for masters athletes
additional: The race is open to everyone, not just masters athletes. Entry fees increase across three registration periods, and registration is also available at the race office for a higher fee. The half-marathon has a long tradition and has been organized intermittently since 1978. The event is part of the Grand Prix series. The entry fees listed on the website are 99 zł, 119 zł, or 139 zł for the successive registration periods, and 200 zł at the race office.

name: Półmaraton i Piątka Raduni
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu, ul. Chopina 34, Pruszcz Gdański, Poland
description: The Pruszcz Gdański Half Marathon and Piątka nad Radunią are annual running events held in Pruszcz Gdański. Both courses are certified by PZLA, and the start and finish are located by the Centre for Culture and Sport. Runners start in time zones according to their declared finish time, allowing for a comfortable run. After the races, there are award ceremonies and a prize draw, creating a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified half-marathon and 5 km courses
Start and finish by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Pruszcz Gdański
Start divided into time zones according to declared finish time
additional: The start takes place in front of the Centre for Culture and Sport building and is divided into time zones according to declared finish time (red, blue, yellow). The race office is located on the glazed terrace of CKiS; baggage storage and changing rooms are inside the CKiS building. Parking is available at the stadium, with access from Bora-Komorowskiego Street. The award ceremonies and prize draw take place after the races. In previous editions, the start, finish and race office were located at the Centre for Culture and Sport, ul. Chopina 34. The courses were certified by PZLA; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 7 (15. mar)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs over several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups who pay the training fee may participate for free.
course_highlights: Races over 5 km or 10 km
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members using various discount codes. Members of the athletics groups who pay the main club membership fee and training fee may participate for free. An annual licence incurs a fee of 50 kr if it has not already been paid. Registration is via EQ-timing with individual sign-up. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Membership discounts are available for various IL Gneist memberships. The annual licence costs 50 kr if it has not already been registered.

name: Hamarkarusellen vinter Løp 6
description: The Hamarkarusellen Winter Series is a running series for everyone, whether you are an experienced runner, a recreational runner, or simply looking to get outside for some fresh air. The series consists of six races over the winter months, all on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar. The races focus on activity, achievement, and socializing, and everyone is welcome regardless of pace—you can run, jog, walk, or combine them. Participants who take part in at least four of the six races receive a finisher’s prize. The event offers a friendly atmosphere, with gingerbread and cordial at the finish.
course_highlights: Six races on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar
The course is suitable for running, jogging, and walking
A social and motivating winter series focused on achievement and activity
additional: A finisher’s prize is awarded to everyone who takes part in at least four of the six races. Participants are encouraged to wear a Santa hat, and gingerbread and cordial are served at the finish. The member price applies to members of corporate sports clubs and individual members of the Innlandet Regional Corporate Sports Association. Everyone is welcome, with an accessible format and room for all levels. Registration is available for individual races or the entire series.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 4
description: Åsane running series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, Bergen, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified, suits all levels, and is led by experienced coaches. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected on site before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course, measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured and certified by Ivar Andreas Sandø
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The races take place on Thursdays. Start time: 19:00. Race numbers can be collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. The start and finish are at the rear of the IKEA building, facing south.

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 2027 Løp 4
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified and suitable for all levels, with experienced coaches leading the way. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers group training sessions for members. Bibs are collected in IKEA’s car park before the race, and participants can enter individual races or the full series.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear on the south side
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022
additional: Bibs are collected in IKEA’s car park between 18:00 and 18:45. Bibs must be worn visibly, and the tags must not be folded or damaged. Participants can enter individual races or the full series. The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Runners use their bib at every race. The prices listed on the information page apply to 2026 and are therefore not included as prices for 2027.

name: BackYard Ultra Warmia
description: BackYard Ultra Warmia is a unique and extreme “Last One Standing” ultramarathon, regarded as the best race of its kind in Poland, with world-class results. The race takes place in Warmia, where Poland’s highest results are achieved and champions of this format are made. The atmosphere is legendary, with long, cold nights, rain, a blazing campfire, and the dark mood of the Warmian forest. It’s the perfect place for those who want to take on the best competitors and push beyond their own limits of endurance.
course_highlights: Course through the dark Warmian forest
Extreme weather conditions: long, cold nights and rain
A blazing campfire and a legendary atmosphere
additional: BackYard Ultra Warmia is a “Last One Standing” race with record-breaking results in Poland. The event is known for its difficult conditions, including cold nights and rain. Participants have the chance to qualify for the National Team and represent Poland at the World Championships and at Big Dog’s Backyard Ultra in the USA. The race follows international Backyard Ultra rules. Outside assistance is prohibited during the loop.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is an annual running event held on the second Saturday in March in Skatås, Gothenburg. The classic race course is the “gravel eight,” a course just under 8 km long where participants can choose to run one, two or four laps. Since 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail has also been held, a new trail race of approximately 16 km in the Skatås and Delsjö area. The event offers a well-organized and varied running experience, with water stations and prize ceremonies for the fastest runners in each category.
course_highlights: The “gravel eight” race course in Skatås, approximately 7.8 km per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running in the Skatås and Delsjö area
Water stations with water and sports drink on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse. Timing is recorded using a disposable chip on the back of the race bib. Changing and shower facilities are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. Prize ceremonies take place in the finish area shortly after each category finishes. Live results are available during race day. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vartavlingarna.solvikingarna.se/): 2027-03-13 — "Vårtävlingarna arrangeras andra lördagen i mars varje år." (was estimated 2027-03-06)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Vårtävlingarna arrangeras andra lördagen i mars varje år.

name: Frozen Lake Marathon
description: Frozen Lake Marathon is a unique running event held on the frozen surface of Lake Tisleifjorden in Norway, 819 meters above sea level. Participants run entirely on ice, on a course with the flattest elevation profile in the world, making it an unforgettable experience. The race is limited to 500 participants and offers both a half marathon and a full marathon. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal for all finishers, with warm soup and bread served after the race. The course is carefully monitored and laid out just days before the race to ensure safety on the ice.
course_highlights: 100% ice surface on Lake Tisleifjorden, with ice about 80 cm thick
The flattest elevation profile in the world
Energy stations at several points, offering sports drinks, water, energy bars, dried fruit, and chocolate
additional: Limited to 500 participants. Transfer is included only for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; shuttle service is available at a cost from Storefjell Resort. Parking near the race area is very limited; studded tires are recommended for driving. Bag-drop service is available with a bib tag. Basic changing tents and portaloo toilets are provided. Warm soup with bread is served after the race. Arrival by train to Gol is recommended; the official race hotel is Oset Fjellhotell. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal, and warm soup with bread is served after the race. Transport is included for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; parking near the race area is very limited.

name: 6. Ekeberg Backyard Ultra
description: Ekeberg Backyard Ultra is a classic backyard ultra race held in Oslo’s “central park” at Ekeberg. The race takes place during the dark and cold time of year, giving participants the opportunity to run together with the ultra-running family in beautiful surroundings, with views of Oslo’s skyline and the Oslofjord. The event offers a unique atmosphere with live music, good vibes and facilities such as changing rooms and tents. A maximum of 110 participants can take part, and everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful scenery with views of the Oslofjord and Oslo’s skyline
The event takes place at Bekkelagshøgda Tennis Club, with access to changing rooms and tents
Live music and good vibes with the ultra-running family
additional: Participants receive a race bib and tracker for automatic live recording of lap times. Drinks, snacks and some hot food are provided. Maximum 110 participants. Everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal. The race starts at 09:00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026 at 00:01. Participants receive a tracker for lap times, access to the venue and changing rooms, drinks, snacks and hot food. Medals are awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, offering accessible road races in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are run on officially measured courses in sunny spring weather. Buying a series pass makes it easy to take part in all the events without registering separately each time. The event has a long tradition and also offers the opportunity to join running classes and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast, high-quality winter races
Races are held in sunny spring weather and attract a wide range of participants
additional: A series pass covers all five events, with no separate registration required. Race numbers must be collected from the race office and returned after each race. Changing distance is possible at the information desk up to half an hour before the start. Members of Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry can take part with a series pass at no cost once their membership fee has been paid. Exact event details and results; no direct mention of the price or any special course features.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55!!! is a birthday ultrarun held to honour the 55th birthday of Vidas Totilas, a long-time advocate of running. The event takes place at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai, Kaunas District, and aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania and grow the long-distance running community. The course follows forest and field tracks, with sandy sections; the start and finish are at the same location. Anyone may participate, regardless of age, gender or nationality, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Forest and field tracks
Sandy sections along the course
Start and finish at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai
additional: Registration is available online and on race day from 9:30 to 10:55. Participation is free. All finishers receive commemorative medals, with awards in the overall and age-group categories. After the finish, participants can enjoy hot soup, snacks and drinks, as well as a sauna and hot tub. The event is part of the Bėgimo namai race series, is held annually and attracts experienced ultrarunners.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: 10 KonstantyNOVA Dycha by Night
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 11th KonstantyNOVA DYCHA by NIGHT is a unique 10-kilometer race through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District. In 2027, its night edition will be held for the second time, with runners taking on the 10 km distance after dark and required to wear headlamps or carry flashlights. Children’s and youth races take place during the day over shorter distances tailored to different age groups. The event is inclusive and charitable, with an opportunity to support a local association when collecting race packs.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District
Night edition of the main 10 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Children’s and youth races start at 16:30. Participants in the main race are required to have a headlamp or flashlight. When collecting race packs, participants can voluntarily support a local association by putting a donation in the collection box. The main race will take place on March 20, 2027; children’s and youth races are scheduled from 16:30. When collecting race packs, participants will be able to make a voluntary donation to support an association from the Municipality of Mosina.

name: 14 Luboń Track
location: Stadion Miejski w Luboniu, Luboń, Poland
description: The 15th Luboń Track is an athletics competition held at the municipal stadium in Luboń. The event is scheduled for Saturday, August 29, 2026, and includes races over 3,000 m and 1,609 m, as well as children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. Runners are divided into heats based on their submitted times, with results classified by gender and age category. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, and each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. The detailed timetable will be published on the event’s official Facebook fan page.
course_highlights: Races at the municipal stadium in Luboń
Heats divided according to submitted times
Results classified by gender and age category
additional: Each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. Heats are assigned based on submitted times. Timing is provided by PZLA judges, without photo-finish equipment. Children’s races are held in different age categories, with separate classifications by gender. The detailed timetable is published on the Facebook fan page two days before the competition. Heats are determined based on submitted times. The 1,609 m and 3,000 m races are for participants aged 13 and over.

name: 40 Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin
description: Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin is an annual 15 km race held in Kołobrzeg, commemorating Poland’s Wedding to the Sea and the end of the fighting for the city. Certified by the Polish Athletics Association, the course runs along scenic seaside promenades and city streets, offering participants beautiful views and sporting competition. The race has a rich tradition dating back to 1987 and attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out. The organizers provide a great atmosphere, support from partners and sponsors, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Three laps: two longer laps of approximately 6.4 km each and one shorter lap of approximately 2.18 km
Scenic seaside promenades and Kołobrzeg streets with sea views
additional: The course consists of three laps: two longer laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are by the IKAR and Perła Bałtyku sanatoriums. The race commemorates the 82nd anniversary of the end of the fighting for Kołobrzeg and Poland’s Wedding to the Sea. The organizers provide medical and recovery support for runners. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The 41st edition is scheduled to start on 20 March 2027 at 11:30. Registration is open; the rules and course information are also available. Holders of the Kołobrzeska Resident Card can receive discounts.

name: Ultramaraton Zielonogórski
description: The Zielona Góra New Borders Ultramarathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque Piast Hills in Zielona Góra. As part of the anniversary edition, participants can choose between two distances: 13 km and a new, demanding 23 km course featuring technical sections, numerous elevation gains, and beautiful views. It is an excellent option for trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience a mountain atmosphere without leaving the city. The event has a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners, promising sporting excitement and unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: The 13 km course features dynamic changes of pace, forest singletrack, and demanding climbs
The new 23 km course features technical sections, numerous climbs, and fast descents
Picturesque trails in the Piast Hills, with beautiful views and a natural trail-running character
additional: The Ultramarathon offers several running distances: 23 km, 48 km, and 103 km, as well as a solo 103 km duathlon and a 103 km cycling race. The 48 km and 23 km courses start at checkpoints in Nowy Kisielin and Jarogniewice. The organizer provides professional catering during the event. GPX course files are available to download. Information on the official website refers to the 12th edition on 21 March 2026; a GPX track for the 103 km course is available.

name: Wiosna z kompasem
description: Wiosna z kompasem is a 10 km race held in Bobrowniki, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for a spring race using training plans tailored to your individual level and VDOT. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and support from experts, helping you prepare optimally for the race. The event is aimed at runners looking for a challenge on a moderately difficult asphalt course.
course_highlights: Asphalt course
10 km distance
Intermediate level
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s level and VDOT. Expert support and detailed training instructions are provided. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The date of 21 March 2027 listed in calendars is tentative; it has not been confirmed whether the event will take place.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Forest To The Bay Blokhus
Hamburger Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
Pyrzycka Szybka Dycha Bieg Smoka - Pyrzycki Bieg Dzieci
description: The Dragon Run is a special running event for children aged 1 to 12, held alongside the Pyrzyce Fast Ten. The run aims to encourage the youngest participants to be physically active and promote a healthy lifestyle. Children start in age categories and start waves, and every participant receives a commemorative medal. An additional attraction is a contest for the most interesting dragon costume, adding a unique and joyful touch to the event.
course_highlights: Course adapted for children aged 1–12
Start waves and age categories
Contest for the best dragon costume
additional: The Dragon Run takes place on March 21, 2027, in Pyrzyce, alongside the Pyrzyce Fast Ten. Children start in age categories and start waves. Every child receives a commemorative medal. A contest for the best dragon costume is held, with prizes. Registration opened in December 2023. The participant limit for both distances of the Pyrzyce Fast Ten is 1,000 people. Entries may be transferred to another person until March 14, 2027. During registration, participants can optionally purchase insurance and support a charity campaign. Race numbers can be collected in Szczecin and Pyrzyce two days before the race. Every child who finishes the run will receive a commemorative medal. The event is scheduled for March 21, 2027.

name: 5 Cross Krotoszyński
price_range: Bieg główny: 70–90 zł; biegi dziecięce: 40 zł
description: The 5th Cross Krotoszyński is a race held in the forests near Krotoszyn, attracting fans of outdoor activities. The event is a special anniversary edition and takes place annually, giving participants the chance to compete in scenic woodland surroundings. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and spend time in nature alongside other runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through the forests near Krotoszyn
Scenic woodland trails
The anniversary fifth edition of the race
additional: Information about fees, entry limits and packages applies to the 2026 edition. Registration was handled through DataSport; the main race had a limit of 500 participants, and the children’s races had 200 places.

name: III Sulmierzycka Wiosenna 10
description: Sulmierzycka Wiosenna 10 is an annual celebration of sport and a healthy lifestyle held in Sulmierzyce. The 10-kilometre race, which has been held since 2024, is a great opportunity to welcome spring actively and bring residents together. The event has become a permanent fixture in the municipality’s calendar, promoting a sporting spirit after the winter months.
course_highlights: The main race covers 10 km.
A 10 km Nordic Walking event takes place on the same course.
Children’s races are planned over 200, 600 and 1,000 m.
additional: Sources give different dates: the municipality’s website and registration refer to 22 March 2026, while the race calendar lists 22 March 2027; 21 March 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: Tropem Wilczym
location: Stadion Miejski im. Henryka Wobalisa, Lidzbark Warmiński, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lidzbarku Warmińskim
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Lidzbark Warmiński, commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The run takes place at the Henryk Wobalis Municipal Stadium and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and to honor an important part of Polish history. The organizers provide professional event management and warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: In previous editions, the start and running events took place at the Henryk Wobalis Municipal Stadium.
The 1,963 m distance refers to the year the last soldier of the independence underground was killed.
The program in a previous edition included races for children and youth, as well as a 5 km main race.
additional: Available information about the courses and fees relates to a previous edition, not the 2027 event.

name: XII Ostrowski Półmaraton
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Sportowy ICE MAT TEAM Ostrów Wielkopolski

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pierwszych trzystu zapisanych i opłaconych uiści opłatę w wysokości 60zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: pozostali uczestnicy opłacą swój udział w zawodach w kwocie 80zł

description: The 12th Ostrów Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Ostrów Wielkopolski, attracting both amateur and professional runners. The 21 km half-marathon course is certified by PZLA and consists of three fast laps that are conducive to setting personal bests. The event also includes a 7 km fun run. It is organized by the ICE MAT Team Sports Club, which promotes running and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: Course certified by PZLA
Fast, flat course conducive to setting personal bests
Three laps totaling 21 km
additional: The race pack includes a commemorative mug, a cap, and a trophy medal made of stone and metal. The half marathon is part of the Grand Prix of Greater Poland Half Marathon, where participants can earn the crown. The course is flat and certified, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The available registration page and results are for the edition held on March 22, 2026, not the stated date of March 21, 2027.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and encourages residents and visitors to spend time actively outdoors. It is recreational and community-building in nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sports activity in the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the previous edition
The event takes place in the evening
The route is in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening activity is recreational and community-building in nature.

name: Lillestrøms Høyeste Trappeløp
description: Lillestrøm’s Highest Stair Race takes place at Scandic Lillestrøm, with its 12 floors, and offers a real challenge for anyone who wants to test themselves, their friends, family, or colleagues. The race is suitable for all levels and is open to participants aged 13 and over. The event starts at 18:00, with race bibs and timing chips available for collection from 17:00. EMIT timing chips record start time, split time, and finish time, and results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor.
course_highlights: The race goes up 12 floors at Scandic Lillestrøm
EMIT timing chips record start, split, and finish times
Results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from 17:00. Warm-up is self-directed, outdoors or indoors where space is available. Luggage can be left in a hotel meeting room at your own risk. Toilets are on the 1st and 2nd floors. Using public transport is recommended, as Scandic Lillestrøm is 50 metres from the train station and 150 metres from the bus station. Parking is limited, but commuter parking in the parking garage or at Varemessen (approx. 200 m away) is recommended if arriving by car. Group registration and a single invoice are available for corporate sports clubs and businesses. Timing is done using EMIT chips.

name: Påskekonrad
description: PåskeKonrad is a short race with a mass start from Brunstad, formerly Nærbutikken, in Velledalen. The race is held annually and attracts both locals and experienced veteran runners. Participants can register on race day or in advance via EQ-timing, which helps the organizer with planning. After the race, participants can shower and change at Tandstad School, where an informal gathering is also held. Everyone is warmly welcome to take part in this enjoyable event, whatever their pace.
course_highlights: Mass start from Brunstad, by the former Nærbutikken
A short race with variable weather conditions, often rain and wind
Showers and an after-race gathering at Tandstad School
additional: Registration is available on race day from 09:00 and in advance via EQ-timing. After the race, showers and dry clothes are available at Tandstad School, where a small gathering is also held. Weather conditions can vary, with rain, wind, and snow later in the day. Registration can be done on race day or in advance via EQ-timing. There is a simple after-race get-together at Tandstad School.

name: Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a spiritual, nighttime hike of approximately 40 km, undertaken in silence and contemplation. Participants follow the route alone or in small groups, focusing on prayer and reflection rather than sports competition. This unique event aims to inspire inner transformation and take participants beyond their comfort zones, offering a profound spiritual and personal experience. The route may be approximately 30 km if the elevation gain exceeds 500 m. EDK is a way of life and a path to changing yourself, not just covering the distance.
course_highlights: 40 km at night in silence and contemplation
A route of approximately 30 km when the elevation gain exceeds 500 m
The Way of the Cross with spiritual reflections, without sporting or social elements
additional: Participants set out at their own risk. It is recommended that they download the official EDK app, which includes route maps, GPS navigation, and the Way of the Cross reflections in text and audio, and also works offline. Silence and contemplation are observed along the route; picnics and social stops are not part of the event. Participants should be prepared for varying weather conditions and bring suitable clothing, food and drink, and a phone with a power bank. EDK takes place at participants’ own risk. Registration and route selection are available through the EDK service.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy the distinctive atmosphere and test their abilities on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course within the airport grounds
additional: The event is intended for school pupils, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking spaces may be available for students. The event takes place in a setting organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027; the distance is 3 km; the location is the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. Registration details were not specified.

description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
location: Kościół przy ul. Kościelnej 2, Bezrzecze, Poland
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a demanding route from the church at 2 Kościelna Street in Bezrzecze to the cross by the church in Bezrzecze. The route is interesting and varied, passing partly through woodland and partly through urban areas. Most of the route is on paved surfaces, so soft-soled footwear is recommended. It is a spiritual and physical challenge for participants, combining reflection with outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Partly woodland and partly urban route
Most of the route is paved
Start and finish by the church in Bezrzecze
additional: Soft-soled footwear is recommended because of the varied terrain. The route description recommends soft-soled footwear. The Extreme Way of the Cross takes place in silence and contemplation, with reflections on the Stations of the Cross.

name: Grand Prix Cross Polska cz.1
location: ReMi fish fry, ul. Lipowa 31, Stegna, Poland
organizer: Gmina Stegna i Valdano Organizacja Imprez Sportowych
description: Grand Prix Cross Polska Part 1 is a prestigious running event held in the picturesque coastal municipality of Stegna. The event opens the Grand Prix Cross Polska 2027 series and offers participants a unique atmosphere of sporting competition against the beauty of the amber coast. The organizers look after runners’ comfort by providing a race office and a post-race meal at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and fair play, bringing together the local community and athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: A route through the coastal scenery of the Municipality of Stegna
Start and finish near the “ReMi” fish bar at 31 Lipowa Street
The event is organized and concludes at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre
additional: The race office, post-race meal, and awards ceremony take place at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre. The event is held under the patronage of the Municipality of Stegna and the Polish Olympic Committee. The route passes near beach access No. 69 from Lipowa Street. The organizers provide comfortable conditions and opportunities for participants to connect. In the 2026 edition, the start and finish were at the “ReMi” fish bar, 31 Lipowa Street, while the race office and closing events were at the Municipal Cultural Centre at 60 Gdańska Street. These details do not confirm the organization or program of the 2027 edition.

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Stęszew Municipality, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolski National Park, mainly along forest trails and field tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: The route is 95% forest trails, field tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one forest loop by Lake Lipno and in Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race is two loops of the same route
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 27.03.2026, from 19:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, 28.03.2026, from 8:30 to 11:30 (for the main race and Nordic Walking) and from 8:00 to 10:30 (for the children’s races). The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno. The participant limit is 300. Net timing is measured using a chip. The route is not certified by the PZLA. The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available at the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races at distances tailored to age and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

name: Tropem Wilczym
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Olsztyńska, Dobre Miasto, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Wolność i Demokracja; lokalny organizator: OSiR w Dobrym Mieście

description: Tropem Wilczym – the Remembrance Run for the Cursed Soldiers in Dobre Miasto is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The race takes place at the municipal stadium on Olsztyńska Street and consists of two events: an individual 1.963 km run and an 8 km relay held on the stadium’s tartan track. The event is both sporting and patriotic, and participants can expect commemorative medals and T-shirts. The organizers provide timekeeping and professional race-office services.
course_highlights: The individual race course runs on the stadium’s tartan track
The 8 km relay consists of 20 laps of the stadium
Time limit for the individual race: 20 minutes
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 at the Municipal Stadium. The relay starts at approximately 13:00. Each participant collects their race number and race pack in person. The team captain receives a relay baton with a timing chip. Timing chips are returned at the finish. Participant limit: 150 people (70 individual runners + 20 four-person relay teams). In the previous edition, relay teams consisted of 4–6 people; each participant had to cover at least 400 m. Information about distances, fees, and registration for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: XI Maraton Gocki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Lokalna Grupa Działania Sandry Brdy
description: The 11th Gothic Marathon is an annual running event held in Wojtal, in the heart of the Tuchola Forest, near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry. The event features three distances: a marathon, a half marathon and a 10 km race, attracting running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and exceptional location, combining sport with the region’s unique natural surroundings and landscapes. It is organized by the Sandry Brdy Local Action Group and the Municipality of Czersk, and is part of the region’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of the Tuchola Forest
Near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry, associated with Gothic culture
Picturesque landscapes and the unique natural surroundings of the Tuchola Forest
additional: The event is organized as part of the implementation of the Local Development Strategy (LDS) and the LEADER/Community-Led Local Development component. There are three distances: the marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The event takes place in a picturesque location with a unique atmosphere and a friendly spirit. The 11th edition described here took place on March 28, 2026, with half-marathon and 10 km distances. The Municipality of Czersk was a co-organizer.

description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held at the end of March. Competitors can choose from three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic Walking event. The marathon course is a cross-country route consisting of four loops, passing through forest tracks in the forest district and built-up areas just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The event is small-scale, with a limited field of 50 participants, highlighting its distinctive character and local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A cross-country course along forest tracks in the forest district
The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop
additional: The race office is located in the Sports and Entertainment Hall and will be open on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The field is limited to 50 participants, with places allocated in order of registration. Registration will close once the limit is reached, and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The organizer’s information concerns the 17th edition, scheduled for 28 March 2026; it does not confirm a race on 27 March 2027. In 2026, the limit was 50 places, and registration was open until 20 March or until the limit was reached.

name: IX Cartusia Półmaraton
location: Stadion Miejski w Kartuzach, Kartuzy, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej / Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby
description: Cartusia Half Marathon is a prestigious race in the heart of Kashubia, held on a certified, fast half-marathon course (21.0975 km). The route passes through the picturesque landscapes of the Kartuzy region, including lakes, forests and glacial hills, combining sporting competition with the region’s rich historical heritage. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy, and participants can expect extensive facilities and regional Kashubian cuisine. The event is a celebration of running for the whole family, with accompanying races and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Certified, fast half-marathon course (21.0975 km)
Picturesque landscapes of the Kartuzy region: lakes, forests and glacial hills
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy, with full facilities
additional: Race packs include commemorative items and access to a recovery area at the finish. The organizers provide support from emergency services (firefighters, police, municipal police and medical services), as well as volunteers. Valuable prizes are raffled among participants in the main race. Tasting regional Kashubian cuisine is an integral part of the event. The start and finish of all races are at the Municipal Stadium, and facilities are available at the nearby Primary School No. 1. The 2026 edition’s program included accompanying races, including children’s races. The information provided relates to the 9th edition planned for 2026; details of the race dated March 28, 2027, have not yet been confirmed.

name: Kibolska Dycha
description: Kibolska Dycha is the fourth edition of the Kolejorz supporters’ race, which will take place at the Malta Regatta Course in Poznań. Participants will cover a 10-kilometre route that includes almost two laps around the lake. The race is open to everyone, with a maximum time limit of 120 minutes, making it accessible to less experienced runners too. The event also includes Children’s Races, which will start earlier, at 10:00. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, preceded by a commemorative group photo.
course_highlights: The route includes almost two laps around Lake Malta
Distance: 10 kilometres
Maximum time to complete the route: 120 minutes
additional: The event is organised by the Kolejorz Supporters’ Association. Before the main race starts, all participants will take a commemorative group photo. The event also includes Children’s Races starting at 10:00. The maximum time to complete the route is 120 minutes, allowing people with lower fitness levels to take part too. Information about the route, schedule and time limit comes from the 2026 edition; it does not confirm the details of the 2027 event.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
location: Ulica Generała Józefa Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The European Masters Indoor Championships are a prestigious athletics competition for masters athletes, taking place in Toruń on Bema Street. The event is held indoors, and the 5 km is one of the running events. It brings together experienced athletes from across Europe, offering high-level competition and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: An indoor 5 km race
Events for masters age categories
Location in central Toruń, on Bema Street
additional: The competition takes place from 27 March to 2 April 2026. The event programme is available as a PDF on the organiser’s website. No information about entry fees or online registration is available on the pages reviewed. The available information concerns the 15th edition of the championships, scheduled to take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026, not the stated date of 31 March 2027.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Sandtangstafetten
description: Sandtangstafetten is a traditional relay held at Sandtangen in Bryne. The race has four legs on varied surfaces, including forest floor, gravel and grass, and offers both a short and a long course for different age groups, from age 7 to seniors. The event starts in the evening and lasts approximately one hour and fifteen minutes, with a focus on team spirit and a great atmosphere. It is a family-friendly race, with many mixed teams as well as all-girls and all-boys teams competing in different categories.
course_highlights: Short course for ages 7–10, with 110 m legs on forest floor, gravel and grass
Long course for ages 11 and older, with 370 m and 420 m legs on varied surfaces
Four legs per relay team, with changeovers at Sandtangen
additional: Start times for the different categories are from 18:00 to 18:36. Participants are advised to arrive 45 minutes before the start for a course and changeover briefing. Parking is available at Vianor Bryne (north) and Storstova (south). Registration is available via a link or by emailing pamelding@brynefriidrett.no. Parking at Vianor Bryne or Storstova.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular trail race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a lovely Easter tradition, attracting participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a celebration of running with a focus on community, and children’s and youth races make it a day for the whole family. Alongside the race, there’s a wonderful atmosphere, prizes for the top finishers in each category, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of trail running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy and fast to run
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and all participants are entered in prize draws. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Vänersborg. The race is a celebration of running focused on community, attracting both elite and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is a women’s fun run offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in the lovely spring surroundings of Slottsparken. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, and welcomes participants regardless of their fitness background or level of ambition. You can enter individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset is an inclusive and inspiring movement for recreational running that has been promoting women’s health and well-being since 1989.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Slottsparken
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Emporia in the days before the event. You can choose not to have your time recorded. Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Bag storage is available in a tent at the race bib collection point. The start and finish are on Kung Oscarsväg in Slottsparken. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. Teams receive a picnic after the finish. Registration is binding and can be completed up to one hour before the start on race day.

name: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra

description: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra takes place in Gressvikmarka, starting Saturday, April 3 at 08:00. The race consists of up to 12 laps on a 6.7 km course through varied and challenging terrain. Participants run one lap every hour and continue for as long as they can, aiming to complete as many laps as possible or all 12. All participants receive a medal, and those who complete every lap can log over 80 km in their training diary. Facilities include a heated shelter, toilets, changing rooms, and some fruit and baked goods.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course through varied terrain
Up to 12 laps, with over 80 km for those who complete them all
The course is marked with red and white ribbons
additional: Check-in and registration from 07:00 on race day. To continue, participants must be ready for the next lap at the top of each hour. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms are available. Bring a change of clothes, drinks, food, and possibly a headlamp. The course may be wet and muddy; a camping chair is recommended for the break area. The previous edition had a maximum of 77 participants. The race started at 08:00, and runners had to be ready at the start at the top of each hour to continue. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms were available. Sources give conflicting information about the date in 2027.

name: Holmestrand maraton
description: Holmestrand Marathon is a friendly running event that has been a regular fixture on the race calendar since 2013. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter and offers beautiful, easy-to-run courses along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city’s charming streets. Distances are available for all levels, from 5 km to the marathon, and the course has been officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and also includes a free children’s race called Miniton.
course_highlights: Easy-to-run, personal-best-friendly 5 km loop course
Course along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city streets
Officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics
additional: All children can take part in the free Miniton children’s race. The race offers the option to run with or without a time. There are food and drink stations, prizes, and opportunities to follow the race along the course. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and the free Miniton for children. For the 5 km, you can choose to run with or without a time. The event also offers the combinations marathon + 10 km and half marathon + 5 km.

name: Drammen 10K
description: Drammen10K is Norway’s fastest 10-kilometer race, taking runners through downtown Drammen on a fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain. The race is for everyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience in an urban setting. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and also offers fun digital competitions beforehand. Welcome to a great race weekend in Drammen!
course_highlights: Norway’s fastest 10K race
Fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain
The race takes place in downtown Drammen
additional: Green race bibs indicate that a medal was purchased in advance. Children’s races are also held on the same day, including Minimila. There is no telephone contact; all communication takes place via email and the contact form. A digital triathlon with prizes and a live announcement on social media is held beforehand. Transferring a race bib or changing the participant costs 100 NOK.

name: Bergen Ultra - Maratonkarusellen
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
