description: The Värmland Relay in Karlstad is a relay race where teams of 5–15 participants compete together on a flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres long. All teams start and finish at the same time and have two hours to carry the relay baton as far as possible, changing runners after each lap. The relay is open to everyone, and teams can be mixed freely, creating a fun, social competition that promotes community and health. There is an awards ceremony after the race, and light refreshments are available on site. First-time participants buy a team baton featuring their team logo, which is used at every competition.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres per lap
Asphalt surface
Runners change over with the relay baton in the exchange zone by the arena
additional: Each team must buy a baton featuring its team logo in its first year, for 500:-. After the race, results can be engraved on the baton for a fee. Team leaders collect race bibs, chips and the baton at the arena. Paid parking is available at Sundstabadet. Changing rooms and showers are available at Idrottshuset. The card-payment refreshments stand opens at 16:30. Medical services and toilets are available at the arena. Teams may bring their own tents and beach flags to decorate the arena. Teams consist of 5–15 participants. Runners change after each lap, and the same person may not run multiple laps in a row. The baton costs 500 kr in the first year (750 kr for late registration).

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar 15-17 km

description: Pop up Run Åkulla Beech Forests is a magical spring trail run in Åkulla, where the greenery is in full bloom and nature is teeming with life. The race offers a fairytale-like run past charming little lakes, Bexell’s Talking Stones, and through the beautiful beech forest. With a distance of 15–17 km and several pace groups, it suits both experienced and recreational runners looking to make memories for life. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm.
course_highlights: Run through Åkulla’s beech forest
Pass charming little lakes
Pass Bexell’s Talking Stones
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. There are 2–3 different pace groups. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating it is available. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm, at participants’ own expense. Meeting at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. Lunch afterwards is optional and paid for by participants. The organizer recommends carpooling and can help coordinate it.

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: RISEN-loppet is an annual running race organized by Genarps IF, starting and finishing at Ekevallen sports ground in Genarp. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10.7 km. The 5 km route runs mostly on asphalt through the village, while the 10.7 km route is split between the village and Risen Nature Reserve. The course is challenging, with steep elevation changes, and the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup. Participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug at the finish. There are water stations along the course, followed by an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is 95% asphalt and 5% natural trail through the village
The 10.7 km course runs 50% through the village and 50% in Risen Nature Reserve
Steep elevation changes on both distances
additional: Electronic timing, with gun time from the start signal. Race numbers must be collected on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly on the chest. Water and energy drinks are available at 3 km and 8 km (water and squash). At the finish, water, squash, recovery drink (Gatorade), and bananas are available. Rådjursloppet, a 700 m race for children up to age 9, starts at 12:15. All participants receive a medal, and registration is available on site at no charge. On-site late registration is possible for an additional fee of SEK 100, payable via Swish. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30, after the children's race. All participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug; gold mugs go to approximately the first 25% of finishers in each distance, and silver mugs to the rest. A children's race of approximately 700 metres is also offered. Previous editions have started and finished at Ekevallen sports ground; details of registration and prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
location: Gurkbänken, Vessigebro, Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a scenic trail-running race that takes you on a unique journey through Ätradalen, with views of the Ätran, birdsong and lush deciduous forest. The race is held in central Vessigebro at Gurkbänken and offers 5 km and 10 km classes, for runners both with and without dogs. It’s a perfect race for anyone who wants to experience Halland’s beautiful nature in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A unique journey through Ätradalen
Views of the Ätran and birdsong
Runs through lush deciduous forest
additional: Classes are available for runners both with and without dogs. The race is held at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The start and finish are at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The published race information applies to 2 May 2026 and does not confirm the date of 1 May 2027.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultrarun held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosa River. The aim is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour allowed per lap. Participants can start again every hour if they have completed the lap. It is a festive, social race with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the event. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and attractive medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to completing multiple laps
700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free Umara silicone cup at bib collection. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, sandwiches and sweets are provided at each lap checkpoint. In the team competition, the three best results from each club count. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is sold out. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches, sweets and food are served during the race. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a scenic trail race that winds through the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the arrival of spring in a beautiful setting rich in wildlife. The event welcomes both families with children and adults who want to combine running with nature experiences. Nordens Ark is a non-profit foundation that works to protect endangered animals and their habitats, giving the race an especially meaningful purpose.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Eco Park and its scenic surroundings
Run in a beautiful, wildlife-rich setting by Åbyfjorden
Trail running suitable for families with children and adults
additional: The 2026 edition of Nordens Ark TrailRun has been cancelled. The park is cashless; payment is by card or Swish. The park has a café and food outlets during the peak season. The park is open daily, with opening hours varying by season.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2027 in Strandbjörket, Växjö. This is a running festival for the whole family, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners. The courses offer a scenic running experience featuring asphalt, forest roads and beautiful views around Lake Växjö and the Bokhultet Nature Reserve. Växjöloppet is a traditional, friendly race that puts the joy of exercise and community at its heart.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket, with the first kilometre on asphalt
A scenic route through the Bokhultet Nature Reserve, mostly among deciduous trees
The final 3.5 km on asphalt around Lake Växjö, with a shared finish on Lagunvallen
additional: There are water stations on the 10 km course (4 stations) and the 21.1 km course (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers four different distances for younger runners, with no timing. Participants receive a race bib, medal and fruit, or a T-shirt and certificate, depending on the distance. The finish line is on Lagunvallen, approximately 300–400 metres from the finish at Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet is not timed. Registration and payment for the children’s races take place on site at Lagunen in Strandbjörket.

name: 1. mailøpet
description: Welcome to the 64th May 1st race in Åheim, a traditional cross-country race starting and finishing at Olivinhallen. The race offers several distances for different age groups, from the youngest recruits to seniors and veterans. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a kiosk, cakes, a tombola, and prizes after the race. The senior, junior, and veteran races start at 13:00, while the recruits start at around 14:05.
course_highlights: Cross-country race starting and finishing at Olivinhallen
Several distances from 220 metres to 3,000 metres
Courses for all age groups, including seniors, juniors, veterans, and recruits
additional: The start and finish are at Olivinhallen, which also houses the event office and changing rooms. Payment can be made by bank transfer, VIPPS, or in person, but VIPPS payments are not registered as entries. A paid athletics licence for participants aged 13 and over gives a NOK 20 discount on registration. Traveling trophies are awarded to women and men; they must be won three times to be kept permanently. The event office and changing rooms are at Olivinhallen. Earlier information states that late registration on race day costs an extra NOK 50; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Steinsland Bygdemaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startkontingent er 400 kr. (350 kr for kondismedlem)

description: Steinsland Village Marathon is a long-standing race that starts in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland. The course passes through the scenic municipalities of Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes, with a choice of distances: marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The race offers a wonderful experience in nature, with several refreshment stations along the way and kiosk sales in the start and finish area. An earlier start is available for those who wish to walk the course, and transport and accommodation can be arranged if needed.
course_highlights: The marathon course passes through Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes
10 refreshment stations along the course
Start and finish in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland
additional: Start times: 08:00 marathon for walkers; 09:00 marathon for those who expect to take more than 4.5 hours; 11:00 half marathon for walkers; 12:00 start for the half marathon and 10 km. Kiosk sales are available in the start/finish area. Transport and accommodation can be arranged by contacting the organizer. Distances are marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The start and finish are in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit, with kiosk sales in the start/finish area.

name: Skifjelløpet
description: Skifjelløpet is held annually on May 16, starting at 18:00 from Lillesand IL’s clubhouse. The race is approximately 6 km long and takes place over varied terrain with natural trails and rocky sections. The course is well marked and offers a challenging route that includes steep hills and a rocky section, finishing in front of the clubhouse. Participants can register in advance or on site from 16:30.
course_highlights: Start outside the clubhouse, with an uphill section to the right of the garage
The course crosses the Skifjell rocky section on natural trails
Finish in front of the clubhouse after running around the stadium
additional: Registration is available in advance via Webscorer or on site from 16:30. The course is marked, and a GPX file is available for mobile apps. Participants must run around the stadium before finishing. The organizer’s page lists advance registration via Webscorer and on-site registration from 16:30. Previous editions have been held in May; details for 2027 may differ.

name: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race in Drammen where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour, with the first start at 10:00 on May 1. It is an endurance challenge: runners must complete each loop within an hour to continue, and the last person standing wins. Children’s races are also held on both days, along with an additional race on Sunday where participants run one loop as fast as possible. The festival offers facilities including changing rooms, showers and a kiosk. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory for runs after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop starting every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Running in the dark, with reflective vests and headlamps required after 21:00
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Changing rooms, toilets and showers are available at Ebbestadhallen. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Pizza will be served to participants at 19:30. Start numbers can be bought and sold through Racetracker. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday. Contact: Einar Hagemann (einarhagemann@msn.com).

name: Olavstafetten
description: Olavstafetten is a traditional relay race held on historic ground in Trondheim, starting and finishing at Trondheim Stadion, Øya. The race consists of 10 legs totaling 11,300 metres and is a popular running festival that also includes the “Family and Friends of Olav” category for teams of all sizes. The event features leg times, course records and leg records in all categories, and serves as preparation for the Norwegian Athletics Championships. It is a social, informal relay suited to both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 legs on historic ground, totaling 11,300 metres
Leg times and course records are recorded in all categories
The course follows the Olav route, starting and finishing at Trondheim Stadion
additional: There are dedicated children’s categories (Mini-Olavstafetten and Lille-Olavstafetten) with short legs at the stadium. Family and friend teams can enter the “Family and Friends of Olav” category, with flexible team line-ups. The kiosk opens at 12:00, and prizes are awarded to the children’s and youth categories early in the day. Runners may run multiple legs for multiple relay teams. The main relay starts at 13:00 and is for participants aged 13 and over. A family and friends category is also offered.

name: Råskinnet
description: Råskinnet is a challenging trail race around Sognsvann in Oslo, featuring bogs, trails, steep hills and two water crossings. The race is known for being tough, wet and muddy, and is suitable for the whole family, with separate distances for children and young people. Everyone who finishes can call themselves a true Råskinn. The event has a long tradition and is met with great enthusiasm by participants and volunteers.
course_highlights: Two crossings of Sognsvann, with water reaching thigh or chest height
Steep hills in old ski jumps from 1942 (Kollbakkene)
The course’s most beautiful section, with old-growth forest and bogs by Godbekken
additional: Race bibs are sent by SMS and must be collected at the start area no later than one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available in the basement at NIH; bring your own padlock. There is free parking at Sognsvann and paid parking at NIH. Bags and luggage can be stored in an unattended tent at the venue. Råskinnet’s 10 km race starts in waves according to expected finish time (from 13:30 to 13:50). The children’s races, Knøttetassen and Råtassen, have separate start times at 11:45 and 12:20–12:35. Distances: 900 m for ages 6–9, 3 km for ages 10–15 and 9 km from age 15. Starts are divided into waves. Sognsvann is accessible by metro line 5.

name: Nupen halvmaraton
description: The Nupen Half Marathon in Harstad is a long-standing race that marks the start of the season for the local running community. The race takes runners through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord and offers a great half-marathon experience for both local and visiting runners. Runners of all ages and levels come together for a social and sporting day in early May.
course_highlights: Half marathon through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord
Season opener for Harstad’s running community
The race takes place over varied terrain with great views
additional: Kasfjord is approximately 12 km from Harstad. The distance information is confirmed for 2026; information about 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Esefjorden Rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med heilårslisens

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med eingongslisens ( kr.30)

description: Esefjorden Rundt is a beautiful 8.5 km road race on asphalt, with no major elevation changes, around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes. The race starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds, near the centre of Balestrand. The event has a long tradition and attracts recreational runners and competitive runners of all ages, with a festive atmosphere and beautiful scenery, including the mountains Tjugatoten and Keipen around the fjord. Participants can take a shuttle boat from the centre of Balestrand to the start area, making for a unique experience.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course with no major elevation changes
Starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds
The course goes around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes, with beautiful mountain views
additional: Shuttle boats run between Holmen (Balestrand town centre) and Tjugum (the start area) from 09:00 to 16:00. Boat transport ends at 16:00. Shuttle boat tickets cost NOK 80 for adults, NOK 40 for children under 15, and NOK 200 for a family. Parking is available at the finish area, in the town centre, at Tjugum Church and at Bygdahuset. The relay competition has three legs, with a map available. Race numbers must be collected at Tjugum Church within the specified times. A licence is required for participants aged 13 to 80, with a one-time licence available when registering. Recreational and competitive categories. A shuttle boat from Holmen in Balestrand town centre to Tjugum is an option; the finish area at Balahaugen is about 1 km from the town centre.

name: SA-løpet
description: SA-løpet is an open and inclusive running event in the beautiful Kulåsparken in Sarpsborg, suitable for all ages and levels. The event offers several distances, both timed and untimed, and focuses on community, personal achievement, and the joy of running. It is well organized, with dedicated volunteers, good safety measures, and accessibility, and aims to give all participants a positive experience. Welcome to an active day filled with smiles and the true joy of running!
course_highlights: Course in the beautiful Kulåsparken, Sarpsborg
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Safe, well-organized event with a clear course
additional: The start and finish are in Kulåsparken. The children's race starts at 10:00, the 10 km starts at 10:30, and the 2.5 km and 5 km start at 10:35. Race numbers are handed out only on race day from 08:00. Toilets are available in the Service House in Kulåsparken. Bag storage is provided during the race. Participants must be 11 years or older to take part in the timed races; younger participants may take part without timing. Registration is listed as open from 1 February to 29 April 2027, with late registration on 30 April and until the race starts on 1 May. Timed categories have an age limit of 11; younger participants may take part without timing or in the children's race.

name: Heim FrontYard Ultra
description: Heim Front Yard Ultra is a unique ultrarace that combines speed and endurance in a social, informal atmosphere. The race takes place on a 3 km loop with a variable time limit per lap, and participants must complete each lap faster than the previous one to continue. The race starts at Sodvinhallen in Ånesøyan, and the course features a mix of gravel and asphalt with approximately 20 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event is suitable for anyone looking for a challenge in an inclusive setting, with light refreshments and facilities available.
course_highlights: 3 km loop with approximately 20 metres of elevation gain per lap
The course is 50% gravel and 50% asphalt
Start and finish at Sodvinhallen, with access to changing rooms and toilets
additional: The race starts with 30 minutes for the first lap, after which the time is reduced by one minute per lap. Light refreshments are offered during breaks. Parking is available at Sodvinplatået or by the community centre. Spaces are limited. Toilets and changing rooms are available, and light food is served during breaks. All participants receive a medal.

name: Backyard Lampeland Ultra
description: Backyard Lampeland is a unique ultrarace held in Lampeland, Flesberg. The race consists of a gently rolling 6.7 km loop run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of twelve laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start wins the race. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to participation, and offers a rest area, refreshments and changing rooms. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who run the ultra distance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Gently rolling 6.7 km loop per lap
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total
The race starts every hour on the hour
additional: Bringing your own cup is mandatory. A reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap. Baked goods, snacks, coffee, water and sausages are served after the seventh lap. A rest area and changing rooms are available in the hall. Maximum 500 participants. Race bib collection is Friday 15–20 and Saturday 08–09:15 at Friluftsbua by Lampeland Hotel, or in the hall at the start from 09:30. Using a race belt for the race bib is recommended. The start and finish are at Skattekista, the school and multipurpose hall in Lampeland. Maximum 500 participants. Bringing your own cup is mandatory; a reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap.

name: Perseløpet 50 km, 100 km, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås school in Hammerås. It features a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop offering good opportunities for fast times. Participants can choose from seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km, including 50 km and the marathon. The race has a unique concept, with a dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap, and a friendly atmosphere where personal records are celebrated by ringing a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to set personal records
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official refreshment station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning split times. Race-bib collection, changing facilities and toilets are at Ås school, less than 100 metres from the start. Free parking is available.

name: Ulfstindmila
description: Ulfstindmila is an annual cross-country race held on 1 May, starting at Tønsvik bridge and finishing at Skittenelv School in Vågnes. Known as the “world’s shortest 10K,” it covers 8.7 km and has a long tradition dating back to 1972. There are two categories: a recreational category without timing and a competitive category. Mini-Ulfstindmila and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are also held for children, with shorter distances adapted for the youngest participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the beautiful Tønsvik Valley
Starts at Tønsvik bridge and finishes at Skittenelv School
The race is 8.7 km long and is known as the world’s shortest 10K
additional: Ulfstindmila has two categories: a recreational category without timing and a competitive category. Mini-Ulfstindmila (approx. 2.5 km) and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are held for the youngest children. The race has been held annually since 1972, with a few exceptions. Previous editions have offered changing facilities, parking, a café and an awards ceremony at Skittenelv School. The organizer has also offered transport for bags from the start to the finish. Practical information and prices listed for 2025 may change for 2027.

name: Konradløpet 2027
location: Velledalen, Sykkylven, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

name: Meldorfer Brückenlauf/ Westküstenhalbmarathon

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. The full marathon has been held in the past but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated leaders and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter, surrounded by scenic landscapes
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Late entry for the full marathon is closed due to low participation. Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km remains open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club's website.

name: Goslarer Altstadtlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.5 km

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Voss Løpskarusell 2
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races held on Mondays in 2027. The course starts and finishes at Idrettsplassen in Voss, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational participants and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, and a discount is offered for registering for all six races before the second race. The races start at 19:00, except for the final race, which starts at 18:30.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Race along the waterfront promenade
additional: The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the final race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. You can register for individual races or for all six together, with a discount for early registration. The course can be viewed virtually in a video on the website. Registration is via EQ Timing. A discount is available for registering for all six races by the second race.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 2
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for registering for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races at a discount by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Registration is online via EQ Timing. There is a discount for registering for all six races by race 2; otherwise, you register for each race individually.

name: Tinestafetten Gjesdal IL Friidrettsbane 2027
location: Gjesdal IL Friidrettsbane, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway

name: Tordenskioldløpet
description: Tordenskioldløpet is an annual running event organized by Sportsklubben Freidig, traditionally held on the first Tuesday in May at Lade in Trondheim. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races as well as a children’s race, and is suitable for all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. It has an inclusive profile with an easy entry point for participants, and focuses on the joy of sport, personal achievement, and community spirit. The aim is to bring together many participants and help as many people as possible experience the joy of physical activity.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes starting and finishing at Koteng Arena
The route passes through Lade Allé, Fagerheimbakken, Olav Engelbrektssons Allé, and several local roads
Children’s race and multiple distances with an easy entry point for participants
additional: The venue opens at 17:00. The children’s race and untimed 5 km/10 km races start at 18:30. Warm-up with 3T at 18:35. Official starts: 5 km at 19:00 and 10 km at 19:15. Prize ceremony at 20:15. All participants have access to changing rooms at Koteng Arena. For the 2026 edition, the start and finish were in the Koteng Arena area at Lade, with changing rooms available at the venue. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen, Halmstad, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med Halmstad OK och andra idrottsklubbar
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a spring-themed fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve, by the Civil Airfield at Aleskogen. The event is open to everyone. The recommended minimum age is 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the 5 km. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line goodie bag and a race bib, with timing available for the 5 km. Teams that register are offered a shared picnic after the finish, making for a pleasant social gathering. Race bibs are distributed in advance at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: The route goes through Alet Nature Reserve/Skepparegatan
Certified 5 km course
Event area at the Civil Airfield by Aleskogen
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 are offered a picnic after the finish. There is a water station and toilets in the event area. Participants are advised to change at home, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Valuables can be handed in in an A4 envelope. Parking is available at Kattegattskolan and Skepparegatan, but eco-friendly transport is encouraged. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. In 2026, race bibs were collected at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden; information for 2027 has not yet been provided in the sources.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun fitness event for women held at Studenternas IP in Uppsala. Participants can choose to run or walk 2.5 km or 5 km on a certified course. The event is all about the joy of exercise and togetherness, with a fantastic atmosphere and entertainment along the course and in the event area. After the finish, teams that have registered five people are treated to a picnic, making it a social and enjoyable spring evening together.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Bib collection takes place May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. A picnic is provided after the finish for teams of five. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. Participants are advised to arrive changed; changing facilities and showers are available. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. Parking is available south of the arena, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. According to the local race information, registration can be completed online until race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing for the 5 km can be opted out of. Teams of five participants are treated to a picnic after the finish.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a spring-inspired fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden, with the start and finish at Sanden. The event is open to everyone and welcomes both individual runners and teams of five. After the finish, teams are treated to a picnic, creating a wonderful sense of community and a springtime atmosphere. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Timing is available for the 5 km course, but participants can also choose not to be timed. Race bibs are distributed in advance to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden
Start and finish at Sanden in Vänersborg
Certified 5 km course with timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the event. Teams that register receive a picnic after the finish, and the picnic voucher is on the team leader’s race bib. The event area is easily accessible on foot, by bike, bus and train. There is a facility for leaving warm-up clothing at the venue. Race information is emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Registration is binding and can be made up to one hour before the start. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. Information about the location and event format is based on details for 2026; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is an initiative that combines the joy of running with the fight against poverty, with a particular focus on Kenya. Participants are encouraged to run, walk, cycle or move in any way they choose, contributing to a shared virtual running journey that raises awareness of how women, with support from Hand in Hand, are lifting themselves out of poverty through entrepreneurship. The event is open to everyone and aims to engage more people in the fight against poverty through physical activity. Run for Change has become a well-established initiative and also includes an iconic tattoo worn by both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: A virtual running journey where every kilometre counts
Focus on entrepreneurship and fighting poverty in Kenya
Open to all kinds of physical activity — run, walk, cycle or crawl
additional: Participation is flexible and can take place whenever and wherever you like. You can join a Strava club where every kilometre is logged and contributes to a shared distance. Run for Change also includes a temporary tattoo as a symbol of commitment, worn by both recreational and elite runners, including Swedish Championship gold medallist Carolina Wikström. Participation is flexible: you can run, walk or cycle and log kilometres in a shared Strava club.

price_range: 125 kr för vuxna; gratis för barn och ungdomar upp till 16 år

tiers.description: Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focusing on the joy of being active rather than the fastest time or lap. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 900-metre Minivarvet for children born in 2016 or later. It’s a community celebration with entertainment, activities, and food, perfect for families, groups of friends, and companies looking to build team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarvet for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities including basketball, football, table tennis, and boules, as well as food and drink. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for building team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30. The official information currently available describes the 2026 edition: the race starts at 18:30, and activities in Kullaparken begin at 16:00. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Revetal Halvmaraton
description: Revetal Half Marathon is a race offering a fast, officially measured 21.1-kilometer half-marathon course that is almost completely flat, with only 24 meters of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, with a focus on even pacing and negative splits. The start and finish are at Re-torvet, a short distance from changing facilities, parking, and refreshments, making for a compact and pleasant race experience. A 5 km race and a children’s race are also held, giving people of all ages and abilities the opportunity to participate.
course_highlights: An officially measured 21.1 km course that is almost completely flat
Two turnarounds, with a total of 24 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the same location, a short distance from facilities
additional: Bib distribution from 09:00 at Sport 1 Revetal and Re-torvet. Children’s race at 10:45, with free entry and a medal for everyone. Maximum of 600 places in total. Early registration is recommended to avoid stress. The course follows Bispeveien to Real Våle and back. Events include a half marathon, 5 km, and free children’s race. Pacers are available for the half marathon and 5 km. Stated capacity is 600 participants, with registration closing one hour before the start.

name: Tjomsevannet Rundt + Backyard 12 timers
description: Tjomsevannet Rundt is held annually on Ascension Day and is a popular race for all ages and levels, starting and finishing at Søgne gamle prestegård. The event offers a social and enjoyable day with several distances, including a children’s race, a youth race, and a 6.5 km fun run. New this year is registration via EQtiming.com with live timing, and the popular Backyard 12-hour race returns, offering the opportunity to run around Tjomsevannet for up to 12 hours. Group training sessions are also held every Monday at Søgne stadium for all levels.
course_highlights: Run around Tjomsevannet, starting and finishing at Søgne gamle prestegård
Off-road races for children and youth over short distances
Backyard 12-hour race, with the opportunity to run every hour for 12 hours
additional: Group training every Monday at 18:00 at Søgne stadium for all levels. Registration for the children’s race, youth race, and untimed race takes place on-site on the day, with payment via Vipps. Live timing via EQtiming.com for the main race and the Backyard race. Start and finish at Søgne gamle prestegård. Prices vary by race, and a license fee may be added.

name: Ekebergstafetten og Ekebergløpet 2027
description: Ekebergløpet and Ekebergstafetten are an annual running festival held at Ekebergsletta in Oslo, with a long tradition and an inclusive atmosphere for runners of all ages and abilities. The event takes place on Ascension Day and offers several distances, including relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is more than just a race, with activities for children and young people, food and drinks from local vendors, as well as music and entertainment that create a lively atmosphere. Bækkelagets Sportsklub is the organizer and welcomes everyone to a day filled with activity, achievement and fun.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings around Ekebergsletta
Several distances: relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km
Recreational race with national age-group categories for adults
additional: Start times: 11:30 Children’s relay, 12:00 Youth relay, 14:00 Children’s race for ages up to 10, 15:00 5 km, 15:10 10 km. The event includes activities for children and young people, food and drinks from local vendors, as well as music and entertainment. Previous editions have featured a children’s race of around 700 metres. Ekebergstafetten has been held as a mixed relay for 7–16-year-olds with five legs. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: VR-Bank Abendlauf
location: Neuenkirchen bei Bramsche, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Sangerhäuser Citylauf
distance_verbose: 12 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 1500 Meter, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event taking place on 9 May 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish at Nolhaga Park will be celebrated with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event is aimed at everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, with beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultramarathon has substantial total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2–9 people per team), with stages of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish at Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, runners can enjoy a finish-line celebration and After Run, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 ahead of race weekend.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Änggårdsbergen nature reserve. The race offers two distances, 7.5 km and 12.5 km, where participants can experience technical trails, hilly terrain and magical viewpoints in the city’s wilderness. The course passes through varied environments such as Vitsippsdalen, Ljungheden and Västerberget, with coniferous forest, heaths and rocky outcrops. It’s an adventure for both beginners and experienced trail runners who want to enjoy nature and challenge themselves.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain in Gothenburg’s nature reserve
Fantastic viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg
The course passes through varied natural landscapes, including a wood anemone valley, heathland and coniferous forest
additional: Three start waves with friend seeding: the 12.5 km race starts at 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. There is an aid station only on the 12.5 km course, after approximately 7.5 km. Start and finish at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. Race bibs can be collected at the venue from 09:30 or at Icebug in Gothenburg. Spiked shoes are prohibited. Everyone who completes the race receives an exclusive wooden medal inspired by Ljungheden. Public transport is recommended; parking is limited. Children aged 8 and up can run with a parent or guardian. Choose between 7.5 and 12.5 km. The organizer recommends trail shoes with a sturdy sole; spiked shoes are not permitted. Public transport is recommended.

name: Koster Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Platser utan mat och dryck kostar 950kr inkl. moms.

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race through Kosterhavet National Park on Nordkoster. The race features a technically demanding course of approximately 15 kilometres, with stones, cliffs and many beautiful viewpoints along the coast. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy craft beer, homemade food and a refreshing saltwater swim. The race is organised by Kosterhavets Ekobod, with a focus on sustainability and care for nature.
course_highlights: Technically demanding course with stones and cliffs
Sections along the coast and sandy beaches
Many magical viewpoints on Nordkoster
additional: The start and finish are at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. There are two aid stations with Koster water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00. After the race, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and craft beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. Bag storage is available at the start/finish. There are no shower facilities at the finish. Participants are advised to have personal accident and liability insurance. Travel to Koster can be planned via Västtrafik. A cable ferry runs between Nordkoster and Sydkoster. For 2026, food and a drink of choice were included in the standard entry fee; an option without food and drink cost 950 kr. The race information states a limit of 200 entries, two aid stations and an age limit of 18. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a unique trail race offering a fantastic running experience in the Åstön Nature Reserve, surrounded by beautiful and dramatic scenery. The race offers four distances—1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km—with a mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Skeppshamn, where participants are welcomed by a great atmosphere and a scenic finish by the sea. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced trail runner, this race is a lovely challenge by the sea.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful and dramatic scenery of the Åstön Nature Reserve
A mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-trail terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn, with a scenic finish by the sea
additional: Four distances are offered: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are at Skeppshamn. Contact the race director at race.tyndero@gmail.com. Previous editions have included distances ranging from a children’s race to 14 km. Information about registration and distances for 2027 has not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in the spring. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. The race has two formats: a longer course with eleven legs and a shorter course with six legs, allowing both experienced runners and beginners to take part. During the race, teammates and spectators cheer on the participants. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service, with course marshals, a race announcer and timing. The race starts at 10:00, preceded by a joint warm-up.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 67.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 8.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 23.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 5.4 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with spectators and teammates cheering on runners
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead the group warm-up before the start. Course marshals will be stationed along the course, at relay exchanges, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times will be provided. The long course has a women’s class and an open class; the short course has an open class. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. Start at 10:00. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, approximately 200 metres north of Ölands Köpstad. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a grill plate.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a recurring running race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb in Hultsfred. The race welcomes runners to take part and enjoy a pleasant running experience in scenic surroundings. The event is part of the club’s race program and offers a friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Running along Lake Hulingen
Scenic course in Hultsfred
Spring race with a welcoming atmosphere

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections, with an almost entirely paved surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race that is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Route along the Svartån with a 99% paved surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to age 12. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and for exposure.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: IFK Sala i samarbete med Sala-Heby Energi
description: SHE Silverlöpet is a revived running tradition in Sala, organized together with IFK Sala. The race offers a beautiful, officially measured 10 km course through central Sala, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. There are three categories: the children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is a celebration for everyone, whether you run, walk or compete. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race, with prize draws for the 5 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured and sanctioned 10 km course through central Sala
Start and finish in Stadsparken
Running through Sala’s beautiful surroundings
additional: Nordic Wellness leads a warm-up for all participants before each start. Start times are 9:30 for the children’s race, 10:00 for 5 km and 10:20 for 10 km. SHE customers get a 50 kr discount on the entry fee via the “Mitt SHE” mobile app or customer service. All participants receive a medal, and it’s a celebration for everyone, including those with a stroller or who prefer to walk. Categories are available for children, 5 km and 10 km. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race; prizes are drawn for the 5 km race.

name: Spångaloppet
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race being held for the third year in a row and welcomes all participants. The race offers several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400-metre children’s race. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum, with the start and finish at Spånga IP. The goal for 2027 is to have more than 600 participants take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race
Start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: There are distances for both adults and younger participants.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Vellinge Beer Run 2026 is a 5-kilometer fun run that starts and finishes at the local craft brewery Vellinge Bryggeri in central Vellinge. The event combines running with socializing and local beer culture in a welcoming setting. It is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and features a scenic course through the Vellinge area. The race starts at 12:00 on May 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer fun run
Start and finish at Vellinge Bryggeri
The course passes through scenic surroundings in the Vellinge area
additional: The event is a fun run suitable for all levels, combining running with socializing and local beer culture. Vellinge Bryggeri is a meeting place for beer enthusiasts, with a focus on quality and sustainability. The brewery also offers tours and beer tastings, and is within walking distance of central Vellinge. After the race, there is an opportunity to sample the brewery’s craft beers.

name: Åre Halvmarathon
description: Åre Half Marathon is a half-marathon road race held in Duved, Jämtland. The race offers a lovely spring atmosphere and marks the start of the running season in the Åre Valley. The course is entirely on asphalt, and runners avoid running on the E14, making for a safe and enjoyable running experience. All proceeds from the race support Duveds IF’s children’s and youth activities. The race director is Hector Haines, and the 2027 event will be the race’s fourth edition.
course_highlights: Entirely asphalt course, with no running on the E14
Elevation profile between 375 m and 415 m
Start and finish at Duvedshallen in Duved
additional: All profits from the race go toward developing Duveds IF’s children’s and youth activities. The race director is Hector Haines. The race is organized by Duveds IF Teamet. The course has an elevation gain of approximately 40 metres. The start and event venue is Duvedshallen. The surplus goes to Duveds IF’s children’s and youth activities.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online-anmälan är öppen fram till fredagen den 8 maj 20:00

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: När du registrerar din hund, betalar du 50 kr och då ingår en fin Älmhult Fights Cancer scarf

description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race that brings participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances, with both runners and dogs welcome and special start times for dog owners. The event includes inspiring talks by prominent doctors and researchers, as well as a festive after-run at Grillen. It is a community where participants come together to support an important cause and enjoy a great running experience in Älmhult.
course_highlights: Choice of distances, with special start times for dogs in the 2.5 km and 5 km races
After-run party with a barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by experts from Lund University
additional: Online registration is open until 8 May at 20:00, with on-site late registration available from 08:00 on race day. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available. Dogs are welcome during special start times and must be kept on a leash. Älmhult Brukshundsklubb will be on site. The after-run party with a barbecue and music starts at 14:00 at Grillen. Accommodation and breakfast are available at IKEA Hotell during race weekend. Previous editions have offered on-site late registration subject to availability. Dog registration has cost 50 kr and included a scarf.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique running race held in the beautiful Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race involves running several laps of a 2.6 km course in a woodland park setting, with each lap to be run faster than the one before. It’s a challenge for everyone, focused on running farther and faster, with a clear time limit for each lap. Lilla Sommarro Snabbare also offers a child-friendly version where the youngest participants can run one untimed lap and feel like winners.
course_highlights: A 2.6 km course through hilly woodland park terrain, with gravel paths, fitness trails and a little off-road running
Start and finish on the lawn by Sommarro Värdshus
A timed challenge with progressively faster laps, focused on endurance and speed
additional: Lilla Sommarro Snabbare is for children born in 2014 or later. The children run one untimed lap and receive a medal at the finish.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied mix of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, with prizes for the top three finishers in each category and prize draws. A Mini Race is also held for children, featuring a fun course of approximately 650 metres. All participants receive a medal and a diploma.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs, with exchanges at the portal
Water station at the start/finish and after approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is done using data chips, and both total time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. There is a group warm-up before the start. The children’s Mini Race starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing the Mini Race, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink and fruit. Late registration for the Mini Race is available on site between 09:00 and 10:00. Proceeds go to Rotary’s international relief work and Ryssberget IK’s activities.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://humlestafetten.se): 2026-05-09 — "den 9 maj 2026" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a popular recreational race in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is a wonderful running celebration through the city’s parks and city centre, with a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and finishes inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, where participants can enjoy food and drinks from food trucks. Lundaloppet is a festive event that brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, energetic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km of running fun through springtime Lund
5 km route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly Little Lundaloppet, approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen the day before and on race day. The warm-up takes place at the start on Svanevägen, led by a running coach on raised platforms. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the race bib, and the finish is filmed. The official T-shirt can be purchased during registration or at the venue. Meal packages and food trucks are available after the finish. It is also possible to add training sessions with a running coach before the race. Official information lists water stations at 5, 10 and 15 km; the 2.5 km course has no water station. These practical details and prices on the information page apply to 2026 and have not been confirmed for 2027.
