name: Sunnhordland løpsfest
description: Sunnhordland Running Festival takes place in the centre of Leirvik on Stord and offers a wide range of distances for all runners, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, a children’s race and a Super Race for people with disabilities. The event is a community celebration that brings together runners of all ages and abilities for a day of running and camaraderie. The race starts on Borggata and is organised by Stord Athletics, which welcomes everyone to a great running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in the centre of Leirvik, with the start on Borggata
A great choice of distances from 5 km to half marathon
An adapted Super Race for people with disabilities
additional: The children’s race is approximately 450 metres. Registration for the standard distances and the Super Race is via EQ Timing; the children’s race has its own registration form.

name: Skogvokteren Ultra
description: Skogvokteren Ultra is a demanding 88 km trail ultramarathon with 3,500 metres of elevation gain, passing through varied forest areas in Grenland. The race starts and finishes at the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall and offers a mix of trails, gravel roads and asphalt in scenic, hilly terrain. The event has an accessible, authentic profile, with a focus on personal achievement and the joy of trail running. A six-stage relay is also held, offering teams and companies a great opportunity to take part together. The race includes electronic timing, tracking via intermediate timing points, five aid stations and a Skogvokteren medal.
course_highlights: 88 km with 3,500 metres of elevation gain across varied terrain
80% trail and 20% gravel/asphalt through three municipalities and two cities
The course links Grenland’s two largest cities in a green, winding loop
additional: The race has electronic timing and tracking via approximately 15 intermediate timing points. There are five aid stations along the route. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS device with the route loaded, hydration containers holding at least 1.5 litres, a wool or technical base layer, a reflective vest for running in the dark, a phone with the race director’s number saved, first-aid supplies and an emergency blanket. Accommodation is available with a 20% discount at Comfort Hotel Porsgrunn when booked before 9 April 2027. A pasta party will be held on Friday 7 May from 17:00 to 19:00, alongside race-number collection. The relay class has six stages with handovers in marked areas, and the baton is a timing chip passed between runners. Start at 05:00 from the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall. The course is not marked and must be followed using GPX; there are five aid stations. Mandatory equipment and an age limit of 18 apply. The relay has 25 team places.

name: Fløyen - Knarvik
location: Fløyen, Bergen to AMFI Knarvik, Knarvik, Norway
description: Fløyen-Knarvik is a hiking and running event of approximately 26 km, starting at Fløyen in Bergen and finishing at AMFI Knarvik. The route follows much of the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge. There is also a shorter starting option from IKEA in Åsane, covering approximately 13 km. The event is suitable both for families looking for a scenic outing and for runners seeking a challenging distance, with timing and prizes for the top finishers. The route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail, with a total elevation gain of 800 metres from Fløyen.
course_highlights: The route follows the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge
Approximately 26 km with 800 metres of total elevation gain from Fløyen
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel and trail
additional: The Fløibanen funicular ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. It is not possible to register on the day at the start. The running class starts at 11:00 from Fløyen with a mass start, and at 11:30 from IKEA Åsane. Free buses from Knarvik bus station to Bergen depart at 08:20 and 09:30. Return by regular scheduled bus from AMFI Knarvik. The route is staffed by course marshals and has Red Cross stations. Water and bananas are available at aid stations along the way. The finish area at AMFI Knarvik offers baguettes, bananas, water and coffee. Toilets are available at the start, IKEA Åsane and the finish area. Race numbers can be collected at the lower Fløibanen station or IKEA Åsane before the start. The route is marked with kilometre markers, arrows and tape. Good running shoes that have been worn a few times and weather-appropriate clothing are recommended. The Fløibanen ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. The Fløyen route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail. It is not possible to register on the day at the start.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi is an annual 10-kilometre running event starting from the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere. It gives runners the chance to enjoy a course that is traditional and popular with locals. The event is part of the running calendar organised by Team Rahola and attracts a diverse range of participants. It is a good opportunity to test your fitness in spring and experience the sense of community at a running event.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre course
Start and finish at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere
A traditional local running event popular with the community
additional: Team Rahola's Monday group runs from Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer an opportunity to train. No specific start times or prices are listed for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly events. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere, and participants can run or walk. The event offers a chance to enjoy exercise in surroundings that combine nature and the city.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting occasion that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path beside the Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. Taking part is above all about the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges, regardless of finishing position. The event also includes group activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging integration.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and discovering local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course features a variety of surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and a formal awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive feedback from participants in previous editions.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in picturesque Olsztyn. The route follows the charming trails of Warmia, along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively, both for experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can take part in the Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races. The event’s atmosphere encourages people to connect and share a sporting adventure.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Bygdøyrunden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Festivalpass SOLO Deltakere kr 1475,00 kr 1032,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Bygdøyrunden is one of eight races in the Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s lovely trails and scenic roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00 from Frognerkilen skatepark in Oslo. Participants can run alone or as part of a team, and it is possible to take part in several races to earn an overall medal. The course is marked only during the mass start, and timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib.
course_highlights: The race follows lovely trails and scenic roads in Oslo
Mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00
The course is marked only during the mass start
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Oslo sentrum at Pilestredet 7 from April 7. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, and participants must pass within five metres of the sensors. The course is marked only during the mass start. Participants can run alone (SOLO) or in teams (DUO, TRIO), with women’s, men’s and mixed categories. Participants who take part in at least five races can compete in the overall series. Start and finish at Frognerkilen skatepark. The race can be completed between April 30 and May 9, 2027; the mass start is on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00. SOLO, DUO and TRIO tickets are available, and the festival pass covers all eight races.

name: Strailøpet
description: Strailøpet is an inclusive spring trail race on the lit trails at Strai, Torridal, Kristiansand, organized by Torridal IL and secondary school students. The race offers four distances: a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km trail, and half marathon, all starting and finishing in the same area at Storemyråsen. The event combines competition with socializing, offers timing for those who want it, and also allows participants to walk in the recreational class. Proceeds go toward the students’ class trip and the Norwegian Cancer Society, and the whole village pitches in to create an enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 22.2 km with 474 metres of elevation gain, consisting of one 5 km loop and two 10 km loops
5 km and 10 km trail courses on the lit trails at Strai
Children’s race of approximately 1 km, untimed, with a medal and ice cream at the finish
additional: All distances start and finish at Storemyråsen, allowing family and supporters to follow runners across the different distances. The start order is half marathon first, followed by the children’s race, 10 km, and 5 km. There is a group warm-up and an announcer before each start. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day in the start and finish area. The children’s race is untimed, but all children receive a medal and ice cream at the finish. NOK 20 of each participant’s entry fee goes to the Norwegian Cancer Society. It is possible to participate in the recreational class without being ranked. The race is organized by volunteers, with support from parents, young people, and sponsors.

name: Halsahalvøya Rundt 2027
description: Halsahalvøya Rundt 2027 takes place on Sunday, August 22, in Halsa, starting at Halsa Church. This road race offers a great opportunity to experience the beautiful Halsahalvøya amid scenic surroundings. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, offering an active, social day for all participants. Tickets are sold via EQ Timing. Follow the organizer’s channels for updates on the start time and practical details.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Halsahalvøya amid scenic surroundings
Road race on varied terrain
Start and finish at Halsa Church
additional: Tickets are sold via EQ Timing. The start time will be announced on the organizer’s channels. The event is managed by Halsa IL. The 2026 edition had a 21.7 km course, starting and finishing at Halsa Church. Both a recreational class without timing and competitive classes are listed.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Alfonso Vietrinas, a pioneer of marathon running in Lithuania. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove Park, with the start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 10 km distances. The course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and welcomes everyone who has a doctor’s approval to participate.
course_highlights: The course runs through Oak Grove Park
The certified course is a 2.5 km loop
Start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: The 2.5 km race starts at 11:30, and the 10 km race starts at 12:00. Participants must wear their race number on the front of their shirt. Age-group winners and placing participants, as well as the youngest and oldest participants, receive commemorative cups. The use of vehicles and personal escorts is prohibited during the race. The event aims to encourage physical activity and build a community of running enthusiasts in Lithuania.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a slight uphill section on the connecting path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: The Wings for Life World Run App is a unique race held simultaneously around the world on May 10, 2026. Participants start at the same time wherever they choose, with the goal of outrunning a virtual Catcher Car that starts chasing them 30 minutes after the start. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the race. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 2000kr fr.o.m. 28 april fram till och med 4:e maj

description: Blodomloppet in Uddevalla is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old. Participants can register individually or as a team, and the event ends with a picnic together. Blodomloppet is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings together companies and individuals in a social, healthy setting while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km races start north of the grassy area in Museiparken and follow Kungsgatan eastward
Lilla Blodomloppet starts in the tree-lined avenue north of Museiparken and heads west
The course is suitable for both walking and running, with timing for the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Teams can fill vacant places until 1 May. Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on race day. You can pay using your workplace wellness allowance through Epassi, Wellnet, or Benify. T-shirt sizes may sell out, with priority given to those who registered in advance. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount, and the workplace wellness allowance can be used.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/uddevalla/): 2027-05-10 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! 10 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-10)

name: Vårruset Göteborg
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokala arrangören IK Vikingen
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a wonderful fitness festival for women, held in Slottsskogen, with the start and finish at Björngårdsvillan. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement, community and a fantastic atmosphere, with entertainment and encouragement along the course. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finisher’s bag, and teams that register also get a picnic after the finish. Vårruset is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and welcomes participants of all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A 5 km course measured for accuracy
Start and finish at Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online up to race day, no later than one hour before the start. Participants can opt out of timing when registering, which means their result will not be published in the results list. Teams consist of five people, and team members can run different distances. Teams that register get a picnic after the finish. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Race bib information is sent out approximately two weeks before the event. Five-person teams get a picnic after the finish. Timing is available for the 5 km and can be opted out of. Information about the course and event format is from the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
description: Chalmersloppet is an annual running festival on the Johanneberg campus in Gothenburg, welcoming students, employees, alumni and companies to take part in a community focused on health and wellbeing. The event offers several distances and a walk, so everyone can participate on their own terms, from experienced runners to those who prefer walking. It is a meeting place for networking and exercise in a relaxed, inspiring atmosphere, with a focus on health for all. Students can participate for free, and company participation creates valuable opportunities for future employers and students to meet. Chalmersloppet is organized by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and celebrates balance, wellbeing and community.
course_highlights: The race starts and takes place on the Johanneberg campus, with several distances: 9.82 km, 6.28 km, 3.14 km, and a 3.14 km walk
Start groups of runners and walking groups set off one after another from Chalmersplatsen
Runner Zone at Geniknölen features activities, networking and an awards ceremony
additional: Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen. A bag drop is available for runners’ belongings. Bib numbers and T-shirts can be collected from a tent at Teknologgården the day before and on race day. Fysiken leads a group warm-up. The awards ceremony takes place at Chalmersplatsen. Runner Zone is a central meeting place featuring companies and activities. Students participate free of charge. The event includes activities in a Runner Zone.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.chalmersloppet.se/): 2027-05-11 — "See you on the 11th of May 2027!" (was estimated 2027-05-11)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: See you on the 11th of May 2027!

name: Kanada Rundt
description: Kanada Rundt is a traditional annual road race in Sylling that has been held since 1981. The race offers 3 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, with the start and finish at Syllinghallen. The classic 12 km course runs around Kanada and is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Association. The event also includes Syllingløpet for children, with no timing, and prizes are awarded for course records, sprints, and youth categories.
course_highlights: Classic 12 km course around Kanada, officially measured at 12,040 metres
The 6 km course follows the main route to Kyllerudsvingen before returning to Syllinghallen
Route: Syllinghallen, Kyllerud, Trolldalen, Kanada, Tronstad, Skjeggerud, Syllinghallen
additional: Start and finish at Syllinghallen, with changing rooms available. Participants in the recreational category can walk or run without timing, with starts between 17:00 and 18:00. Syllingløpet for children aged 0–11 starts at 18:00 without timing; all participants receive a medal. There is a sprint prize at the Learn sprint point, approximately 3 km into the course, as well as course-record prizes and youth prizes. Participants who finish multiple times receive anniversary prizes and mugs. The Lier double prize is for taking part in both Kanada Rundt/Syllingløpet and Lierskogen 6-timers. Previous editions have offered registration through EQ Timing. The start, finish, and changing rooms have been at Syllinghallen.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Strandtorgetløpet
location: Strandpromenaden, south of Strandtorget, Lillehammer, Norway
description: Strandtorgetløpet is part of Sørdalskarusellen and takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget in Lillehammer, by the red artwork. The race offers an inclusive, accessible atmosphere where both elite runners and recreational runners can take part. The event focuses on the joy of running and togetherness, and is suitable for anyone looking for an enjoyable race experience in scenic surroundings. Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent by the art installation, and facilities include toilets on Strandpromenaden.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget by the red artwork
Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent on Strandpromenaden from 17:45
Toilets are available on Strandpromenaden
additional: Registration closes at 18:00 on race day, one hour before the start. Prices increase from 13:00 on race day. Parking at Strandtorget is limited to 2 hours, or 3 hours for shopping centre members. An SMS with information about race bibs and start times will be sent at approximately 16:00. Remember to bring your race bib if you have registered for the whole series. Listed with a start time of 20:00 on 12 May 2027. Virtual participation is listed for 8–11 May.

name: Søreideløpet
description: Søreideløpet is being held for the first time and offers a running festival in Søreide, Bergen. The race follows sidewalks, with a course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic. Participants will receive a race bib, and a race medal will be awarded at the finish. Children and young people will also receive a buff from Fjordkraft, and gift cards for Puma products will be drawn among participants. The team with the highest percentage of its members participating will receive NOK 5,000 for its team fund.
course_highlights: The race follows sidewalks in Søreide, marked with white arrows
Course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic
Start and finish at Rema 1000 Søreide
additional: Race bibs will be handed out from 18:00. The registration deadline is 18:15 on race day. Rema 1000 Søreide provides bottled water at the finish. All participants receive a race medal. All children and young people receive a buff. The team with the highest percentage of its members participating wins NOK 5,000 for its team fund. Previous editions have awarded medals to all participants. Information about the 4 km distance and price applies to the 2026 edition; information for 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Medåkersloppet
location: Parkuddens IP, Medåker, Arboga Municipality, Sweden
description: Medåkersloppet is a classic trail race held annually since 1979 in the beautiful forests around Parkuddens IP in Medåker. The event offers several distances, including a new 14 km race, as well as a children’s race and a mini race for the youngest participants. It is a festival welcoming both runners and walkers, with refreshments and activities in the start and finish area. The mini race and children’s race are untimed and open to all children; participants in the mini race receive a medal.
course_highlights: A trail race through forest terrain, with both wide and narrow paths
The route runs along gravel roads and through the forest
The children’s race follows the exercise trail and is suitable for strollers
additional: The mini race is untimed and requires no registration. The children’s race is also untimed. Refreshments are available in the start and finish area.

name: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“

description: The festive “Kuršėnams 463” run is a traditional running event held in Kuršėnai, Šiauliai District. The event aims to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle, inviting runners of all ages to take part. The races take place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, with three distances on offer: approximately 463 m, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, and the event concludes with awards and a joint finish at around 21:30.
course_highlights: A symbolic route of approximately 463 m by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
A 2.5 km loop that 10 km runners complete four times
The races take place in an urban setting, with a convenient start and finish
additional: Race schedule: 19:30 — 463 m start; 19:40 — 2.5 km start; 20:00 — 10 km start. Awards take place after the last participant finishes, at around 21:30. Participants must be healthy or have a doctor’s clearance to exercise. The health and conduct of underage participants are supervised by accompanying adults. The race takes place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge; registration and race-number pickup are by the bridge; participant age groups; COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: Skärholmsloppet
price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: NIK Arena (Näsvikens skidstadion), Näsviken, Hudiksvall Municipality, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a scenic trail race along the Borgarleden trail between the Dellen lakes, finishing at NIK Arena in Näsviken. The course features varied terrain, with a long climb at the start, followed by a downhill section, an easier middle section and a challenging finish with technical trails and steep hills. Participants in the 13 km class are bussed to the starting point, and there are several water stations along the course. After the race, kolbulle and a well-stocked coffee table are offered to everyone except the children’s class, which receives cordial, a bun, a banana and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: The course follows the Borgarleden trail, with beautiful views over the southern part of Lake Dellen
The terrain includes a long climb, downhill running, and technical trails with steep hills
Water stations are located at 6.2 km, 9.9 km, 13.8 km and 18.7 km
additional: Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). The 13 km starting point is at Simabobacken; participants are bussed from the ski stadium to the start. Online registration closes on Thursday evening before race day. After that, on-site registration is available until one hour before the start, with payment by Swish only. Race bibs are collected on site. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s classes, and to everyone in the children’s class. The cutoff is at Borgarberget (19 km) after 3:30 hours. Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). Participants in the 13 km classes are bussed to the start at Simabobacken. In 2026, kolbulle and a coffee table at the finish were included in the entry fee, except for the children’s class.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out & Back is a unique and friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back routes. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a social and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the race centre. The start, finish and race centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow ski track in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and fuel; there is no support along the course. The race centre will have an aid station with water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the race centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, a maximum of 100 participants and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and fuel; support is permitted only at the race centre. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: TIF-terrängen is a traditional cross-country race organized by Trollhättans IF Friidrott. The race has a long history and attracts runners who appreciate challenging terrain and the beautiful natural surroundings of Skidstugan in Trollhättan. After the 2026 race was cancelled, the event is planned to return in 2027, with more information to come later.
course_highlights: The courses start at Skidstugan in Trollhättan.
Distances are 800 metres, 2.3 kilometres, 5.2 kilometres and 10.4 kilometres.
The 10.4-kilometre distance consists of two laps of the 5.2-kilometre course.
additional: The 800-metre race is for children up to 9 years old.

name: Hälleforsterrängen
description: Hälleforsterrängen is a running race organized by Hällefors Running Club and held in Hällefors. The race is part of the club’s annual competition program and welcomes runners of different age groups and ability levels. The club provides financial support to members taking part in running races and encourages carpooling and wearing club clothing. Hälleforsterrängen offers a great opportunity to run in scenic surroundings and take part in a well-organized local running event.
additional: The club reimburses entry fees and mileage expenses for children, young people and juniors at running races, as well as 50% of the entry fee for seniors and veterans in races in Närkes Långloppscup. Wearing club clothing is required to receive reimbursement. Carpooling is recommended. The club also reimburses the entry fee, accommodation, mileage expenses and food for participation in Vasastafetten. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km and children’s races. This information applies to 2026 and does not confirm the format for 2027.

name: Örbyhus half-marathon (10K) - Örbyhus
location: Örbyhus, Tierp Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden

name: Ølmedal Rundt
location: Bygdahuset i Ølmedal, Imsland, Vindafjord, Norway
description: Ølmedal Rundt is a traditional race that started in 1984 and attracts 500–600 participants each year. The race follows an approximately 7 km paved route around Ølmedalsvatnet through gently rolling terrain, suitable for runners, recreational participants, wheelchair users and strollers. The event also includes a children’s race, recreational and family classes, and age-group competition classes. The start and finish are at Bygdahuset in Ølmedal, where food is available, along with a drinks station, showers and changing rooms. Ølmedal Rundt is a community celebration with a wide range of participants and good facilities.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km route around Ølmedalsvatnet on paved roads
Gently rolling terrain suitable for everyone, including wheelchair users and strollers
Children’s course of approximately 400 metres near Bygdahuset
additional: Drinks station after approximately 4 km. Medal for all children’s race participants. Prizes for the top three in the competition classes. Access to showers and changing rooms. A large food sale with grilled food, sveler, cakes and coffee at Bygdahuset. The start and finish are at Bygdahuset in Ølmedal. There is a drinks station after approximately 4 km, and food, showers and changing rooms are available. The race is traditionally held on the second day of Pentecost.

name: Vestmarkaløpet
description: Vestmarkaløpet takes place on May 15, 2027, in Vestmarka in Bærum and offers trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The race offers two distances, 10 km and 21 km, on trails and forest roads with varied terrain and elevation changes. It is suitable both for those looking for an experience in nature and for those who want to test their fitness early in the racing season. The start and finish are at Vestmarksetra outdoor recreation parking area, with ample parking and public transport nearby.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 219 metres of elevation gain and 1 water station
21 km course with 413 metres of elevation gain and 2 water stations
Trail running on paths and forest roads in Vestmarka
additional: Start and finish at Vestmarksetra outdoor recreation parking area. Parking is available on site, and bus 245 runs to Kattås, about a 1.5 km walk from the race venue. Water, sports drinks and bananas are available at aid stations along the way. Live results will be available on race day. Information about bib collection, baggage storage and awards will be published closer to race day. Start and finish at Vestmarksetra. Parking at the race venue, or take bus 245 to Kattås, about 1.5 km away. Poles and listening to audio are not permitted.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The 12th Commandos Quarter Marathon is a uniformed-services race organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk. The 10.55 km course runs through the grounds of the 650th Anniversary Stadium and the Northern Wood, offering extreme racing conditions for uniformed services and running enthusiasts. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, competition, and the training of uniformed services. The race is scheduled to start on May 16, 2026, at 12:00, with a participant limit of 999.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail race organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile (4 km and 828 metres) course runs along dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and is open to people over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event brings people together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
organizer: Fundacja Mocni na starcie, Biegaj Leszno, Wojewódzki Szpital Wielospecjalistyczny w Lesznie
description: Mariuszowa 5-ka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, offering distances of 5.3 km (one loop) and 10.3 km (two loops). In addition to the main races, there is a 4 km Nordic walking event, as well as youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is located in the administrative building of the Regional Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each event.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The V Szczecinecka 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to a range of runners and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and active recreation.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual race held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. The event includes a main race and Nordic walking, attracting both runners and outdoor enthusiasts. It is open and welcoming to participants, with clearly specified entry fees and professional organization. The start is scheduled for 08:30, and the event runs until 14:20.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

location: Eikenosa, Ålesund, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

name: Perseløpet ¤2 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners set new personal records. The race takes place on a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop, with seven distances to choose from, ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making race nutrition simple and personal. The event offers good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking, and has a friendly atmosphere where everyone who sets a personal record gets to ring the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own personal nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race numbers are collected on a self-service basis at Ås School approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official aid station, which also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. The venue is close to public transport, with live bus departure information and train connections via Entur. The start and finish are at Ås School, Hammerås. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: 24h Rawicki Festiwal Sportu
description: The 24-hour Rawicz Sports Festival is a unique sporting event held in Rawicz, bringing amateurs and professionals together for a competition that lasts all day and night. Since 2011, the festival has continued to grow, offering a range of sports, with the 24-hour relay race as its main event. It is the largest sporting initiative in the Rawicz municipality and is organized through the cooperation of numerous institutions and volunteers. Participants can also enjoy a range of non-sporting attractions during the festival weekend.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail running event taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional event management for a competition with nationwide reach while ensuring a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: Blodomloppet is Sweden’s largest recreational running event, held in 24 locations across the country, including Malmö on May 17, 2027. The event aims to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers with friends and coworkers. The event is open to everyone and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in an urban setting
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old
A shared picnic bag for all registered teams
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a registration discount. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event for an additional fee. The start and finish are in Museiparken in Malmö. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the registration fee.

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: The Gerstewitz Mill Day Run is a long-standing running event offering various distances, from 400 m for children to 10 km for adults. After a pandemic-related hiatus, the run has become very popular and combines sporting ambition with regional Pentecost traditions. The event is organized by SFG Nellschütz e.V. and offers runners of all ages an appealing competitive opportunity in the Lützen region.

description: Blodomloppet in Kristianstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children of different ages, with shorter distances inside Tivoliparken. The course passes through the scenic Vattenriket, with a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. Participants can take part with colleagues or friends, or on their own, contribute to a good cause and finish with a shared picnic in the event area.
course_highlights: Scenic course extending into Vattenriket
A mix of grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 inside Tivoliparken
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 12 May. Late registration is available on site in Tivoliparken from 16:00 on 19 May. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km courses have a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. There are several cheer stations along the course. The event area offers picnic facilities, and the event concludes with a shared picnic. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances for children aged 1–12. Teams can have a maximum of five participants.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running competition held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The event is open to all runners from Lithuania and abroad and takes place in five stages at different locations. Participants compete in both the overall standings and age groups, while the routes pass through various parts of Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day.
course_highlights: Five stages at different locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
Starts and finishes at various locations, including Jonava Central Stadium and eldership buildings
Races take place in the evening, with the start at 19:30 and race-number collection from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration is carried out separately for each stage. Participation is free. The event is open to all participants, offers online registration and different routes, and takes place in five stages from May to September.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Stafettvarvet
description: Stafettvarvet is an exciting relay race taking place on 19 May 2027 in Slottsskogen, Gothenburg. Each team consists of four runners, all of whom run the same 3.1-kilometre course through beautiful Slottsskogen, finishing at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is popular with companies and friends looking to do something fun and healthy together, with a lovely picnic included after the finish. The race starts at 18:00, with self-seeding to place runners according to pace. Stafettvarvet offers a magical atmosphere before, during and after the race.
course_highlights: 3.1-kilometre course through Slottsskogen
Start, relay exchange and finish at Slottsskogsvallen
A picnic box is included for each team after the finish
additional: The start uses buddy seeding, with runners lining up according to pace. Runners 1 and 2 can enter the start area between 17:00 and 18:00. At the relay exchange, the baton is handed over at exchange barriers divided into zones by race number. Each team receives a picnic box to enjoy after the finish. A corporate village, with tents available to book, is located in the entrance park outside Slottsskogsvallen. One picnic box is included per team. Women's, men's and mixed teams can register; mixed teams must include at least one participant of the opposite sex. It is free to watch the race along the course.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities from 4 May to 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, while teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, in line with the recommendations for each distance.

There is also an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for individuals and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: The Kėdainiai race “Babėnų Spring 2026” invites all active-lifestyle enthusiasts to take part in the 5 km and 10 km distances at the Babėnai Forest recreation area. The event aims to encourage physical activity among participants of all ages and provide an opportunity to compete and put their running abilities to the test. The courses follow forest trails and paths, and every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. The competition is organised in cooperation between the Kėdainiai Sports Centre and the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association.
course_highlights: The courses follow trails and paths in Babėnai Forest
5 km and 10 km distances
The competition takes place at the Babėnai Forest recreation area, at the end of Aušros and Budrio streets
additional: Additional registration will be available at the start area from 17:00 to 18:15. Race numbers will be issued starting one hour before the start, with distribution ending 15 minutes before the start. Winners and runners-up in each age group will be awarded, as will the three fastest participants in the 5 km and 10 km distances. All finishers will receive commemorative medals. The event is planned for 26 May 2027, but no details about the courses or entry fee have been provided.

The race is open to both individuals and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free on public transport in Östergötland on race day.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The 13th 5 MILE Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9,260 m), organised in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Association of Polish Navy Officers, in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4,630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees and civilian runners who have been verified in advance. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 3. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a traditional recreational race organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrandsmarka on a 4.4 km course, with set start times for walkers and the main field. It is a social and inclusive race series with prizes, refreshments and sveler for participants. The race has a long history, with extensive statistics and records, and several races are held throughout the year, including Christmas and New Year’s races.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course in Valestrandsmarka
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000 from HTB
additional: Registration takes place at Furubakken sports ground until the start. Sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand are provided. The race does not require a license, and payment can be made via Vipps to 121337. A Christmas race is also held on 26.12 at 12:00 and a New Year’s race on 31.12 at 14:00. Race statistics and results are available from 1981 onward. Registration is open until the start. Start times are 18:45 and 19:00. Payment via Vipps 121337.

name: Endless Shore Ultra
description: Endless Shore Ultra Trail is an ultramarathon along the coastal path from Jeløy in Østfold to Nesodden in Akershus, offering an unforgettable journey through varied and scenic terrain. The race offers three distances: 50 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles, with challenging elevation profiles and spectacular views of the Oslofjord. It is organized by a nonprofit, volunteer-run organization that emphasizes sustainability and a great race experience for ultra-running enthusiasts. The start and finish are at Berger Stadium on Nesodden, with bus connections to the start locations and Oslo city center.
course_highlights: Varied coastal terrain with smooth rock, pine forest, and oak forest
Fantastic views of the Oslofjord and towns such as Son and Hvitsten
Run through the night on the 100-mile distance, with historic and scenic stops
additional: Bus transport is available from the finish area at Berger Stadium to the start locations (Drøbak for 50 km, Moss for 50 miles and 100 miles) and can be booked during registration. Medals are made from locally sourced wood, with ribbons made from recycled fabric. The race focuses on environmental responsibility, with no littering on the course and a requirement to bring your own cup to aid stations. The distances award ITRA points (50 km = 2, 50 miles = 3, 100 miles = 5). Registration includes a race bib, timing chip, food and drink stations, and a medal. Bag transport from the start to the finish is available, and a bus from Berger Stadium to the start in Drøbak can be booked for the 50 km distance. Bring your own cup; mandatory safety equipment is required.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional “Laisvės taku 2026” run will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas District, to mark the 117th anniversary of the birth of General Jonas Žemaitis. This is an 11 km cross-country race starting at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and honours the memory of a Lithuanian freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: An 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post
Bus transport to the start from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School
additional: Participant registration is open from 9:00 to 9:30. Bib pickup is on 2025-05-23 from 9:00 to 9:30. Registration venue: Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School. The bus to the start leaves from the school at 09:45. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or have had a health check. Results will be published publicly. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will take place at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School; age groups and online registration are available.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Borgloher Weiherlauf
location: Borgloher Weiherlauf, Hilter am Teutoburger Wald, Germany

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km celebration of running in Gothenburg, bringing together tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race passes through the festival atmosphere of Slottsskogen, continues along Hisingen’s quays and by the buzz of Avenyn. The course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and numerous spectator and music stations along the route. Information about start groups and other details is sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes Hisingen’s quays and Avenyn
More than 200,000 spectators and numerous music stations along the route
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m), and the course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer. There are water stations along the course, and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to race day. Start groups are assigned according to seeding rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located at Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seeding rules and start groups are available; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, runs along Hisingen’s quays and goes by Avenyn; the race is part of Varvet Week.

name: Sidsjö Trail
organizer: Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 tillsammans med morron
description: Sidsjö Trail is a challenging and fun trail race set in the scenic surroundings of Sidsjön and Södra Berget in Sundsvall. The race offers several distances, from a 1 km children’s race to 12 km, and is suitable for both seasoned trail runners and beginners looking to test their limits. The courses feature varied terrain, beautiful views, forests and lakes, with nature at the heart of the experience. The event is documented with photos and video, and children receive a Kexchoklad wafer bar at the finish. Sidsjö Trail is organized by the local football team Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 together with morron, helping support the team’s activities and community involvement.
course_highlights: A trail race through varied natural surroundings around Sidsjön and Södra Berget
Beautiful views, forests and lakes along the course
Distances include a 1 km children’s race, 3 km, 6 km and 12 km

name: Tolvanloppet 12km
description: Tolvanloppet is a city race with a friendly, charming atmosphere and events for all ages (in 2026, participants ranged from 2 to 98 years old). Adults can choose between two distances, the main event being 12 km (the shorter distance is 6 km). The course winds through the old residential neighborhoods of Bromma and is described as beautiful but challenging, with quite a few hills. Along the route, expect plenty of support from residents, including their own water stations (in addition to the course’s four official ones) and refreshing sprinklers. All this makes the race Stockholm’s most charming street race.
