tiers.description: Prisen for 10km økes med 100,- til 400,- 14 dager før løpsdagen.

description: Graabeinløpet is a family-friendly race held at Sletta athletics track in Sætre. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a free children’s race, and is suitable for children and adults of all ages. The courses are measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association, and run along both gravel and paved roads in scenic surroundings. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners and the fastest boys and girls under 13. The event also has a kiosk, toilets, and medical personnel on site for a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs along gravel and paved roads through central Sætre and the Chemring Nobel factory area
Start and finish at Sletta athletics track, with one 5 km lap and two laps for the 10 km
The course is measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, the 10 km starts at 13:00, and the 5 km starts at 13:25. There is a kiosk and indoor toilets at the stadium. The Red Cross is on site with medical personnel. An announcer makes announcements before the start, and course marshals are stationed along the entire route. Parking is available about 150 metres from the start area, with space for more than 100 cars. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners in classes with at least 3 participants. The children’s race is free, and all participants receive a medal. The 2027 date has not yet been confirmed; the organizers say it will be set after summer 2026.

name: The Arctic Run
description: The Arctic Run is a unique island marathon held on Hadseløya in Vesterålen, Northern Norway. The race offers a scenic and varied course with a maximum elevation of 300 meters, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between a full marathon, a half marathon with views of the sea and mountains, and a 10K route that combines urban and natural landscapes. The event highlights the region’s stunning natural beauty, including views of Langøya, the Lofoten Wall, and the mountains in Bø, making it a memorable experience for all runners.
course_highlights: Marathon route around Hadseløya island with 300 meters maximum elevation
Half marathon with views of the sea, Langøya, and the Lofoten Wall
10K route through the city center, residential areas, and natural landscapes, with 79 meters of elevation
additional: The event includes a free 600-meter TAR Family Run at 10:00 AM on race day, with no timekeeping. Bib pickup is available from 08:00 to 09:45 AM at Hurtigrutemuseet. Food and drink stations are located at several points along the course and offer energy drinks, juice, water, bananas, nuts, chocolate, cookies, and dried fruit. Toilets are available at the start, finish, and along the course. Camp TAR offers drop-in showers, with passes available for purchase. Photographers will capture moments from the race, which will be available to purchase after the event. Shuttle buses run from several hotels to the race. The information page also covers food and drink stations, toilets, baggage storage, and pacers. A free 600-meter family run is also held.

name: Skurdalen Trail 2027
description: Skurdalen Trail is a trail race in scenic surroundings near Fagerli Leirskole in Skurdalen. The course offers challenging mountain terrain with spectacular views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda, including the well-known Hovdetrappa. The event offers distances for the whole family, from a fun Kids Trail to a challenging 18 km course with demanding trails and mountain scenery. After the race, participants can enjoy a social gathering with a barbecue buffet, sauna and concert, making it a complete experience for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: The course passes via Hovdetrappa, with great views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda
Trail running in challenging mountain terrain with bogs, climbs and mountain farms
Shared start and finish at Fagerli Leirskole, followed by a social get-together and After Trail
additional: Shared start and finish area at Fagerli Leirskole. Soup is served at the finish. GPS tracking of the races is available. After Trail includes a sauna at Bygdebadstua and a barbecue buffet at Fagerli, with a concert and social gathering. Mandatory equipment for the 12 km and 18 km includes a downloaded GPX course file and first-aid equipment. Participants must bring a mobile phone with the organizer’s number. Pacing and outside assistance are not permitted. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are at Fagerli Leirskole. Accommodation is available at Fagerli for race weekend. The race distances listed are 18 km, 12 km, 5 km and Kids Trail.

name: Lyngstadfjellet rundt
description: Lyngstadfjellet Rundt is a long-standing race organised by Hustadvika Sportsklubb that goes around Lyngstadfjellet. The race is approximately 12 km long, starting and finishing at the clubhouse in Lyngstad. It is a recreational class with timing, and all participants receive a commemorative pin. The top three in the women’s and men’s classes receive prizes.
course_highlights: Race around Lyngstadfjellet
Approximately 12 km
Start and finish at the clubhouse in Lyngstad
additional: All participants receive a commemorative pin. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. Recreational class with timing. The race began in 1976 and returned in 2026 after a long hiatus. The date 5 June 2027 is not confirmed in the sources.

name: Haugesunds Avis halvmaraton 2027
description: Haugesunds Avis Half Marathon and Fun Run is a long-standing recreational race held in Haugesund, with the start and finish at Haugesund Athletics Stadium. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, relay, 5 km fun run, and a children’s marathon for the youngest participants. The course runs partly along sidewalks and inside the stadium, offering recreational and more experienced runners alike the chance to take part in a well-organized race in scenic surroundings. The event is inclusive, with options for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: The half marathon and relay start at Haugesund Athletics Stadium
The 5 km fun run follows a certified-distance loop, starting and finishing on the athletics track
Children’s marathon of approximately 750 metres for children aged 0 to 12, starting at the stadium
additional: The children’s marathon starts at 11:30, the 5 km fun run starts at 12:00, and the half marathon and relay start at 13:00. The 5 km course is a loop on the same route as the half marathon, adjusted to the correct distance inside the stadium. Previous editions have also included a 5 km, relay, and children’s race. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed by the organizer.

name: Stomperudløpet 2027
description: Stomperudløpet is an annual race held at Sørum Stadium in Akershus. The race offers two distances, 6 km and 15 km, with the longer course recently changed from 16.5 km to 15 km following positive feedback. The course passes through varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails and sections of the old route, and offers scenic surroundings, including Flaenhytta and the shelter at Jultonåsen. This race is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners looking for a challenging and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs from Lørenfallet via Aasgaardveien (gravel road) to Bølerteiet
Trail up to Tømtekoia and onward to Svartputtveien
Up to Flaenhytta and the shelter at Jultonåsen before returning to Lørenfallet
additional: Information about the distances and course applies to the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Peura Trail
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, 37 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The routes follow the motocross track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The organiser, Valgamaa Sports Association, welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: The Olympic Day running events in Kaunas invite city residents and visitors to take part in a range of free sports activities. The event offers several running distances: a 500-metre children’s run, a 1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile, and 5- and 10-kilometre races. In addition to running, participants can try an extreme obstacle run, orienteering, and a 3×3 basketball tournament. The event aims to bring communities together and promote an active lifestyle, while also offering the chance to meet professional athletes and Olympians.
course_highlights: 500-metre children’s run
1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile
5- and 10-kilometre races
additional: More than 15,000 prizes will be handed out to participants. Visitors can also take part in educational and Olympic education events and games, and meet Olympians. The event is free and focused on mass participation and bringing communities together. More than 100 activities, runs, tournaments, educational events, a concert, and a film screening.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre course from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and a sense of community, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite sports. The fastest relay teams take around 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at approximately 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging in distance from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams entering the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. Race packs can be sent by post (the shipping option can be booked until 31.03.2026) or collected at one of two collection times (22 May, 10:00–18:00; 29 May, 13:00–20:00). The race starts at the Hafenspitze in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route includes 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at level crossings. Relay marathon, registration opens on 13 June 2025, various stages, team and individual participation, refreshments and accommodation on site

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a varied running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for Bambini runners to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a slight cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all ages, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a slight cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon
additional: The €3.00 late-entry fee does not apply to the 400 m and 1,500 m events for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in all weather. Age groups are determined in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, participation in all weather, various age groups

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in the Solling region near Dassel. The event offers a range of distances from 400 m to the 42.5 km Leaders Akademie Solling Marathon. The routes pass through the varied landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for both competitive and recreational runners, as well as walkers. The event is organized by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
description: The Below Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup classification. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied program of running events for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green oases and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. In addition to the main distances, there are age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, its start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied track running competition behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers various races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and awards ceremonies are provided for the top runners.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main event is a 10 km race for runners in the U20 age group and older, supplemented by shorter races for young people and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at the Badestrand InselseeHeidberg and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique experience of nature and running right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional supporting program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau
Wremer Deichlauf
description: The Wremen Dike Run is the traditional highlight of TuS Wremen 09’s sports season and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts. Two distances are offered: a short 5,300-meter loop and a long 15,900-meter course through the green marshland. The routes run mostly along paved cycling and farm roads and also pass outside the dike, directly alongside the water and tidal flats. The short loop also features a separate walking event.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who value scenic routes and a sporty atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race is divided into start groups with participant limits, ensuring a comfortable experience and smooth organization. Special emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique road race set in the magical surroundings of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as Nordic walking, and there is also a special race for children, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Power Explorers”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packages.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in various races, including children’s races and a team race. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a wonderful atmosphere, with activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected on site, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food bag after the finish, making it a fun, social running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with access to toilets and water refill stations
additional: Race bibs are collected on site in Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food bag after the finish. Toilets and water refill stations are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Race bibs are collected in Vasaparken. Teams of four can receive a food bag/picnic after the race.

name: Rekordmila
description: Rekordmila is a fast, flat 10-kilometer race in beautiful Buvika, perfect for anyone looking to set a new personal record. The course starts in central Buvika, follows the old road towards Øysand and returns. It is optimized for fast running, with a small roundabout at the turnaround to minimize time loss. In addition to the main race, there is a children’s race of approximately 500 meters, suitable for children of all ages. Rekordmila is also a race with heart: participants are encouraged to do good deeds in their local community as part of the event.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 10 km course from central Buvika to Øysand and back
The start has been moved 350 meters back, with a net downhill
Children’s race of approximately 500 meters along the path towards the water
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00, approximately 90 minutes before the main race. Race bibs for the 10 km can be collected at Skaunhallen from 09:30 on race day. There are changing facilities at Skaunhallen. Water, squash, buns and bananas are served in the finish area, but there is no water station along the course. The course is closed to car traffic during the race. Pacers are available for various finish times, and photographers on the course offer photos for purchase. Cash prizes go to the top three men and women, with bonuses for a course record and for running under 30 minutes. A children’s race is also held. Previous editions have offered the option of paying the entry fee with a good deed in the local community.

name: Steinkjermila
description: Steinkjermila is a fun run and a festive event for the whole family, held in the heart of Steinkjer city centre, with the start and finish at Steinkjer Square. The course winds through many of the city’s most beautiful spots and offers a varied and enjoyable route. The event includes the Mila and 5`ern distances, as well as the children’s race Minimila, which is free for children aged 0–12. It is a social and inclusive event with a group warm-up, prize-giving and activities for all ages.
course_highlights: The course runs through Steinkjer city centre, starting and finishing at the square
The Mila distance consists of two laps of the same course
The children’s race Minimila crosses the bridge, goes through Holmen and returns to the square
additional: Race numbers can be collected in advance at Steinkjer Kulturhus on Friday 4 June and Saturday 5 June from 11:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 09:30. There is a group warm-up for children at 10:30 in the square. Bag storage is available in the Sparebank 1 SMN tent by the church tower. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. Gift cards are awarded to the top three men and women in the Mila and 5`ern. The Red Cross and race marshals ensure safety during the event. Water, cordial and bananas are available at aid stations in the finish area and along the Mila course. Toilets and showers are available at Samfunnshuset. Minimila is approximately 700 metres and is free for children aged 0–12. Race numbers can be collected at Steinkjer Kulturhus on Friday 4 June and Saturday 5 June from 11:00 to 17:00.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: The Father’s Day run in Tauragė is a festive event inviting all running enthusiasts to take part with family and friends. It is a great opportunity to celebrate Father’s Day actively and have fun as part of the city festival. The event takes place during Tauragė City Festival, offering a chance to experience community spirit and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: A festive run during Tauragė City Festival
A friendly atmosphere for families and friends
A chance to celebrate Father’s Day actively
additional: The event is part of Tauragė City Festival, takes place outdoors, and encourages active leisure and family participation.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf on 7 June 2026 is a varied popular and cross-country running event in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all abilities. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes follow the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, passing through the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trails and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trails along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon routes
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training club grounds in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number collection are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are offered for the Fun Run (1 km), Schoolchildren’s Run (2.5 km), Everyone’s Run (5 km), Main Run (15 km) and Half Marathon (21.1 km). A raffle with great prizes is held for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running programme with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic course follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere. Special and team classifications add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A range of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
The Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services will be stationed at the finish and along the course. Late entries are possible online until 11 June 2026 and on the day of the event until 1 hour before the respective start. Photos and videos will be taken by a commissioned service provider and may be published. The Deichlauf in Greven drew over 800 participants in June 2026, with distances from 2 km to 10 km, including climbs, and suitable for all age groups. The event is a community event with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge von 1862 e.V.
description: The 14th TSV Neustadt City Run on June 7, 2026, is an accessible community race in Neustadt am Rübenberge that promotes community and inclusion. The event celebrates togetherness and brings friends together through shared exercise. Every step strengthens social ties and signals support for an inclusive future. The race is open to all age groups and combines a sporting event with social commitment.

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race taking place on 7 June 2026 in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail routes, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organised by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are ranked according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with special age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. On June 7, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including 5 kilometers, 10 kilometers, a fun run, and a Bambini run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, THW, and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun, and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Eversten Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg, taking place on June 7, 2026. Various races are offered, including student races, a 6.3 km company and fun run, and a 10 km public race. The course runs through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and ambitious runners.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Run is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place on June 7, 2026, in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Athletics Association of Saxony-Anhalt (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register via the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and distance recommendations apply.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau takes place for the 36th time on June 7, 2026, offering races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for setting personal bests, with the start and finish at TSV Ratekau’s sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a school cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great importance on safety, with road closures, and offers refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
description: The Run Beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, recreational runners, and families, with races over various distances as well as a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and its tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
description: The 10th Festival of Runs of Northern Poland and Physical Activity in Wdzydze is a celebratory, tenth edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region. The event takes place on June 5–7, 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and celebrates local culture and nature. The programme includes races of various distances, Nordic walking, and cycling rallies.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie, organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, running through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous, fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can look forward to a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes will receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 3
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a friendly running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up, and a discount is available when registering for all six races in the series. This is a great recreational race in the beautiful surroundings of Voss.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: All races start at 19:00, except the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. Registration is online only via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology takes place on June 9, 2026, offering runners a sporting challenge on the campus grounds. The event features several race distances, including one lap and three laps, as well as a children’s race. This popular university sports event welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun is a trail race organized by Vretstorps IF Löpning. The race features a more challenging course with plenty of trails and forest terrain, offering a demanding and scenic running experience. After the race, participants can enjoy some social time with hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities and is appreciated for its great atmosphere and well-organized arrangements.
course_highlights: A more challenging course with plenty of trails
Forest terrain and scenic surroundings
Hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine after the race
additional: After the race, hot dogs in buns are served, and participants can swim in the evening sunshine. Previous races have had around 65 registered runners and included great prizes from sponsors such as Vitamin Well and Nocco. The 2026 edition had a 10 km race category. After the race, hot dogs in buns were served, and participants could go for a swim.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run Knattelopp
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an evening trail race held at Dalahästen Ski Center in Avesta. The race offers two distances, 3.33 km and 10 km, which mostly follow the trails on the esker around the ski slope. It is an enjoyable and challenging trail course suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The event is part of Dalaportens OL’s race program and offers a unique evening running experience.
course_highlights: Trail race of 3.33 km or 10 km
The course mostly follows the trails on the esker
Runs around the ski slope at Dalahästen Ski Center
additional: Participants receive a medal and Festis. The sources describe the race as part of Avesta Night Sky Run but give race dates different from the stated date of 2027-06-09.

name: Borgenløpet
description: Borgenløpet is organized by Borgen IL and offers an inclusive running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event includes a 7 km trail route called Åsmarkarunden, as well as a shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it. A children’s race is also held as the finale of the sports school’s running series. The event features an open kiosk, an announcer and a great atmosphere, inviting everyone to a pleasant community celebration at Borgen.
course_highlights: 7 km trail route called Åsmarkarunden
Shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it
Children’s race for the youngest runners as the finale
additional: An open kiosk, an announcer and a lively atmosphere throughout the event. The race is open to everyone, from recreational runners to elite athletes. The event concludes the sports school’s running series with a children’s race. The information found applies to the 2026 event and does not confirm details for 9 June 2027.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf on 10 June 2026 is an open-to-all run at a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walkers. The start is at 7 p.m. in the center of Marklohe, and the finish is at the heated Wietzen outdoor pool, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is a maximum of 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km; the walking route is a maximum of 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf

price_tiers.distance: 5,0 km, 10,0 km, Walking, NordicWalking (Schüler und Jugendliche unter 18)

description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place on June 12, 2026, in Uelzen and offers a varied programme for runners of all ages. There is something for everyone, from short taster runs for children to the main 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking. The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The event is well established and supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous regional sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre
The 10 km circuit is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and across the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately one hour before each event; the late entry fee is €3.00 (except for the taster run and hiking). All children’s and schoolchildren’s races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. All events start on Albertstraße in front of the turning circle. Race routes, registration, sponsors, volunteers, virtual runs, parking, start on Albertstraße, registration deadline: June 9, 2026

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all ages, from Bambini to adults, and runs through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured in accordance with DLV rules and promises an attractive route through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured in accordance with DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Race-pack collection on 10 and 11 June 2026; timing by transponder (timing fee €3.00, waived if you have your own BMS chip); race number is non-transferable and must be worn on the front of your sportswear; Holstenkösten cup can be pre-ordered (€12.00) and collected at race-pack collection. Participation is available for various age groups; registration online or on site; race-number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening.

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Firefighters’ Race in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels on June 12, 2026. From short, free Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and firefighters’ race, there is something for everyone. The flat, paved courses run through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km route through the countryside at the same time.
course_highlights: Flat, paved courses through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km laps for the team and firefighters’ race and walking
additional: The Bambini race (450 m) and schoolchildren’s race (1.2 km) have no entry fee. The schoolchildren’s race is for participants up to age 11 in the standings; the fun run is for those up to age 15. The team and firefighters’ race consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start at the same time as the firefighters’ race from the back to avoid disrupting the runners. Various race distances, online registration, race brochures available to download, special categories for firefighters and teams, results on TimeTeamJung

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtruper Volkslauf on June 12, 2026, in Osnabrück offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis up to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races follow a very scenic route, with several refreshment stations to look after participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe, smooth experience; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic race with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The routes are designed to be scenic.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run on June 12, 2026, is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all ages and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The routes pass through Rathausplatz and the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Lake Berenbostel. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from 12 to 26 June 2026 in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donop Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied 7,777-meter course around the Donop sports ground in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines athletic challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: The Alpaca Race
description: The Alpaca Race is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Hisingsparken. It is a technically demanding race, and only a few runners have completed the full distance. The race offers a unique nature experience and a challenge for both recreational runners and experienced trail runners. Preparations include course test runs and group training sessions that foster community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Technically demanding trail course in Hisingsparken
Running on forest trails with varied elevation changes
Scenic natural setting in Gothenburg
additional: Test runs are usually held three times a year, with no advance registration required. The start and meeting point is at IF Kville’s clubhouse, which has toilets, changing rooms and showers. Participants are encouraged to travel to the event sustainably. A GPX file is available to download for personal training on the course. All participants receive a medal.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race on simple trails through a magnificent old-growth forest in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. There are two distances: the original long race of 19.7 kilometres, starting in Backe/Berg and finishing at Bigvallen in Björna, and a shorter 6.6-kilometre race that starts and finishes at Bigvallen. The race is always held on the Saturday before Midsummer weekend and partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail. Björnadagen, with activities and an awards ceremony, takes place alongside the race. The terrain is uneven in places, with logs, rocks and wet sections, providing a unique running experience close to nature.
course_highlights: Run on simple trails through old-growth forest
Partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Uneven terrain with logs, rocks and wet sections
additional: The race starts in Backe/Berg, with bus transport from Björna. Depending on the number of participants, there are two start groups, starting at 11:00 and 11:30. Timing is by wrist chip, with a split time at 11.5 km. At the finish, there are changing rooms and showers, as well as the option to buy food for those who pre-ordered. Shoes with spikes are not allowed in the changing facilities. Parking is available at Björna School, and carpooling is recommended. The race has four checkpoints with drinks and light refreshments. The terrain is wet and uneven in places, so runners should be prepared. The 19.7 km course has four checkpoints. Registration, parking and changing facilities are at the school in Björna, and bus transport to the start in Berg is included for registered participants.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon where endurance matters, not speed. The challenge is to run one lap of an approximately 6.7-kilometre course every hour on the hour, for as long as you can. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge in Piteå, and the race continues until only one runner can complete another lap. It is a test of both physical and mental strength on a technically demanding forest course.
course_highlights: 6.7-kilometre loop with approximately 65 metres of elevation gain
The course includes forest trails, running tracks, gravel road and approximately 500 metres of asphalt
Technically demanding sections, clearly marked with signs and course tape
additional: Registration takes place from 07:30 to 08:30, with the race briefing at 08:30. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge, with a grassy area for participants’ equipment. There are two small changing rooms, one shower and two toilets at the event area. The site map shows the start area, lap checkpoint, finish, race management, refreshment area, participant area and recommended parking. The race starts at 09:00 and continues every hour on the hour. Registration is listed as 07:30 to 08:30, and the race briefing at 08:30. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn is a half marathon organized annually by Edstjärns Idrottsklubb in Gagnef. The race is open to everyone and runs through scenic areas around Flosjön and Edstjärn. It is a well-established event that promotes sport and community, especially among young people. The club encourages participation in various sports and offers a great opportunity to experience beautiful scenery while running.
course_highlights: Half marathon around Flosjön and Edstjärn
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized by the volunteer-run Edstjärns IK, with a focus on youth sports
additional: All registrations are binding, and participation is at your own risk. Personal data is handled by Edstjärns IK and Mitt Lopp. Names and results are published at www.eik.one. The organizer may stop the race if necessary to protect participants’ health and safety.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Öllsjö Running Festival is a family-friendly and welcoming recreational race for participants of all ages and a range of physical abilities. The event offers several distances, including children’s races and longer routes, and focuses on the joy of movement and community. It features music and activities for the whole family, as well as a team competition with chip timing. This recurring running festival creates a wonderful atmosphere in Öllsjö every June.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 450 m and 1,700 m
5 km and 7.5 km trail-mix races
Automatic chip timing and a team competition
additional: The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00. Bib pickup starts at 10:00. STC Härlöv leads warm-ups before the children’s races and the longer races. A candy shower for children takes place at 12:20. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:10 on the event area’s stage. Showers, changing facilities, and bag drop are available. The event has offered several different races and chip timing.

name: Birkebeinerløpet
description: Birkebeinerløpet is Norway’s largest trail race and will be held on Saturday, 12 June 2027, for the 29th time. The race starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium in Lillehammer and finishes at Håkons Hall. It offers varied forest terrain, with trails, cart roads and ski trails from the Olympics. The course is 20.2 km long, with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent, giving participants a wonderful nature experience and the joy of running. Anyone aged 16 or older in 2027 can take part, and the race is part of Birkebeinertrippelen.
course_highlights: Varied terrain including trails, grass, cart roads and ski trails from the 1994 Olympics
The course is 20.2 km long, with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent
Finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: Intermediate timing points are located at Sjøsetervegen (approx. 7.7 km) and Kroken (approx. 14 km). The course may have some wet sections and steep descents, so take extra care in wet conditions. The race is part of Birkebeinertrippelen. Participants must be at least 16 years old as of 31 December 2027. Participants must be at least 16 years old as of 31 December 2027. The race is part of Birkebeinertrippelen.

name: LøpeBirken 12km
description: LøpeBirken 12 km is a trail race being held for the 20th time on Saturday, June 12, 2027. The race runs from Birkebeineren Ski Stadium to the finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer, with varied terrain including trails, gravel roads, and ski trails from the Winter Olympics. Participants can enjoy the true Birken atmosphere, challenges, and beautiful nature in a race that combines the joy of running with a sense of achievement. The race is open to everyone aged 16 and over with timing; 15-year-olds may participate without timing.
course_highlights: Starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium (525 m above sea level), with varied surfaces including grass, trails, and a wide ski trail
First refreshment station at 4.14 km, with water and Maxim
The course includes gently rolling terrain, steep hills, and marsh sections, and finishes at Håkons Hall
additional: Participants aged 16 and over may take part with timing; 15-year-olds may participate without timing. The course has two refreshment stations, and participants are advised to watch out for wet conditions and traffic when crossing local roads. The race finishes at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. Participants aged 16 and over may run with timing; 15-year-olds may participate without timing. Food and drink along the course and at the finish are included in the entry fee. A free shuttle bus runs from Håkons Hall to Birkebeineren Ski Stadium.

name: UltraBirken løp
description: UltraBirken Run is a 60 km ultramarathon from Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena to the finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race offers a tough running challenge across varied and demanding terrain, and is suited to runners who want to test their limits. It is held annually and is part of the Birkebeiner Triple, is approved as a qualifier for the UTMB 50K, and awards 2 ITRA points. The race continues to attract more participants and has a rich tradition of achievement and community.
course_highlights: Starts at Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, with 2 km of gravel road before the trail crosses high-mountain terrain over Sjusjøfjellet and Lunkefjell
The route crosses Krigsfjell, Hitfjell, Pellestova and Nevelfjell, the course’s highest point at 1,072 metres above sea level
The course ends with demanding, rocky and steep sections before reaching the finish on a gravel road outside Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: The race awards 2 ITRA points and qualifies for the UTMB 50K. Participants must be at least 18 years old as of 31 December 2027. The race is part of the Birkebeiner Triple. The route has a total of 1,258 metres of elevation gain and 1,873 metres of descent. There may be muddy and wet sections, as well as steep and rocky sections where reducing your pace is recommended. Start time: 08:00. Participants must be 18 years old by 31 December 2027. The race awards 2 ITRA points and is approved as a UTMB 50K qualifier. Food and drinks at the stations are included in the entry fee.

name: UngdomsBirken løp
description: The UngdomsBirken Run is an approximately 5 km race for young people aged 12 to 16, starting at Stampesletta and finishing at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race gives participants the chance to experience the true Birken atmosphere and cross the same finish line as thousands of other participants. It will be held for the 22nd time in 2027 and focuses on achievement, community and the joy of running, whether it is your first time or you have taken part before. The course passes through varied terrain, including gravel paths, a floodlit trail and scenic surroundings near Maihaugen.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km from Stampesletta to Håkons Hall
The course follows gravel paths, crosses Finnabrua and runs alongside the Mesna River
Finish at Håkons Hall in the true Birken atmosphere
additional: There is a drinks station with squash and water after approximately 2.5 km, as well as a food and drinks station at the finish serving water, squash and sausages from Gilde. Participants with special dietary needs are advised to bring their own packed meal. Everyone is encouraged to drink plenty of fluids before and during the race. Elevation figures for the course vary depending on GPS equipment and map data. For participants who turn 12–16 by 31 December 2027. Drinks are available at approximately 2.5 km, with food and drinks at the finish.

name: Haslummila
description: Haslummila is a road race starting and finishing at Bekkestua in Bærum, offering distances of 400 metres for children, 5 km for ambitious runners and 10 km for keen runners. The event is an inclusive, energetic running celebration focusing on time, personal achievement and the local community. The course winds through varied streets and paths, with several underpasses and scenic areas, and there are drink stations along the way. All participants receive a medal, and children receive ice cream as a prize. The event encourages the use of public transport and offers good parking options nearby.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Bekkestua, with the 400 m children's race in Bærumsveien
The 5 km course passes through underpasses beneath Kirkeveien and Bærumsveien, and by Haslum Klubbhus and Nadderud VGS
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km route
additional: Drinks will be available at the finish and at one station along the course (5 km runners pass it once; 10 km runners pass it twice). All participants receive a medal, and children receive ice cream. Participants are encouraged to use public transport; both a bus station and a metro station are within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking garages are located nearby. Information about race bibs, clothing storage, toilets and AfterRun will be provided later. Drinks are available at the finish and at a station along the course. All participants receive a medal, and children also receive ice cream.

name: Fana Backyard
price_range: 600 kr individuelt; 1000 kr per lag på to
description: Fana Backyard Ultra is organized by Gneist Friidrett and follows the classic Backyard Ultra rules, with a start every hour on the hour. The course is 6.706 km long and consists of asphalt, trails and gravel, with a total of 12 laps run within a time window from 09:00 to 21:00. The event takes place at Gneist Arena in Bergen and offers a challenging, sociable ultra-running experience with both individual and team classes. All participants have access to a base camp with facilities such as snacks, drinks, changing rooms and toilets, and finishers receive T-shirts.
course_highlights: 6.706 km course with asphalt, trails and gravel
Starts every hour on the hour, following Backyard Ultra rules
12 laps in total, covering 80.472 km
additional: Teams consist of 2 runners who take turns running every other lap throughout the competition. All 12 laps must be completed for a valid overall time. The final lap must be completed by 21:00. Everyone who completes 1 to 11 laps receives an official participant T-shirt, while everyone who completes all 12 laps receives an exclusive black T-shirt. Spectators are welcome outside and inside Gneist Arena, but do not have access to the runners’ base camp. Pedestrian crossings must be used when crossing roads, and marshals direct traffic at some points. The start and base camp are at Gneist Arena. The base camp has snacks, drinks, toilets and changing rooms. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2011 or earlier).

name: Hell Løpefestival
organizer: Hell Ultraløperklubb, med bistand fra flere idrettsklubber i Stjørdal
description: Hell Running Festival takes place on 12–13 June 2027 at Øverlands Minde in Stjørdal and offers a wide range of races for all levels. The festival includes Stjørdalsmila, with 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as ultrarunning events of 6, 12 and 24 hours and a marathon. The races are held on certified courses with asphalt and tartan surfaces, and Øverlands Minde offers good facilities, including showers and changing rooms. With the Trøndelag midnight sun as a backdrop, this is a highlight for running enthusiasts in the region.
course_highlights: Stjørdalsmila: certified 5 km and 10 km courses through central Stjørdal and along the promenade at Tangen
Ultrarunning on a 1,185.6 m loop with asphalt and tartan surfaces at Øverlands Minde
The races take place outdoors, with facilities including showers and changing rooms at Øverlands Minde
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Øverlands Minde on Friday 11 June from 18:00 to 21:00, on Saturday 12 June from 09:00, and on Sunday 13 June until 12:45. Registration for Stjørdalsmila closes at 12:00 on race day. The ultrarunning events have a support area with tables and tents, and the running direction is reversed every 6 hours. All participants must have a licence (insurance). The race takes place outdoors, with the midnight sun as a backdrop. The festival runs over two days, 12–13 June 2027.

name: Moan5ern
organizer: Sprek Treningssenter, Berg Eiendom, Intersport, Alti Magneten og Markabygda IL
description: Moan5ern is an inclusive race in Levanger, Trøndelag, offering a running festival for all ages and levels. The event is organized in collaboration with local partners such as Sprek Treningssenter and Markabygda IL, and aims to provide a wide range of recreational running opportunities. The race includes a children’s race, a untimed fun run, and competitive waves for the fastest runners. Moan5ern is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to take part in a social and active event.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Levanger
500-meter children’s race
Competitive waves based on expected finish time
additional: The children’s race starts at 12:00, with free entry and no registration required. The untimed fun run starts at 12:30. Competitive wave 1 (faster than 20 min) starts at 13:00, and wave 2 starts at 13:05. Previous editions have had wave starts for competitive runners. The children’s race has been free and has not required registration.

name: Gjesdal Backyard
location: Gjesdal IL stadion, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway
price_range: 800 kr; stafett fra 1500 kr per lag

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 800,- kr. Dette inkluderer bevertning og pleie gjennom hele dagen.

description: Gjesdal Backyard is a unique and different kind of race where participants run a 6.7 km loop up to twelve times, starting and finishing at Gjesdal IL stadium in Ålgård. The course offers varied terrain, including asphalt, farm tracks and flowing trails, as well as a challenging hill and scenic valleys. Each lap starts on the hour, and your pace determines the length of your breaks between laps. The event also offers a relay option, with teams of 2–6 people sharing the 12 laps. Refreshments, entertainment and good facilities are available at the stadium.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the tartan track at Gjesdal IL stadium
Varied terrain with asphalt, farm tracks and flowing trails
The course’s toughest and longest hill comes early in the lap
additional: Bib collection from 07:30. Group information and race briefing at 08:45. A new lap starts every hour from 09:00 to 20:00. A personal chair in the “Storsalen”, with refreshments, entertainment and surprises. Good changing-room and toilet facilities. Medical staff on site. Food and drink included: water, fruit, cordial, crisps, jelly sweets, cola, filled sandwiches, hot food after lap 6 and a Jæder burger after lap 12. Minimum age: 16. Runners must bring suitable shoes, a headlamp and weather-appropriate clothing. Start and finish at Gjesdal IL stadium in Ålgård. The race is limited to 12 laps (80.4 km) and has a minimum age of 16. Relay teams can consist of 2–6 people, and each participant must run at least two laps. The official website lists 12 September 2026 as the race date, not the stated date of 12 June 2027.

name: Hovlandsnuten Opp
description: Hovlandsnuten Opp is a traditional uphill race from Risvoll School to the summit of Hovlandsnuten, 931 metres above sea level. The approximately 6.7-kilometre course offers varied terrain, with Sherpa steps, beautiful views over the fjord and a challenging climb. The race is suitable for everyone, young and old, and family entertainment is provided at Trollplassen. The event also has a dedicated Sherpa/firefighter class with additional weight to carry. After the race, there is a social gathering with music, awards and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sherpa steps built by Sherpas from Nepal
Water stations at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten
Panoramic views from the summit at 931 metres above sea level
additional: The recreational walk starts at 08:30 from Risvoll School, with the option to start from the alternative parking area in Nordstøldalen. The competition starts at 12:00. Race numbers (vests) are handed out before the start. Medals are presented by Mayor Håvard Handeland. There is a race announcer and several family activities at Trollplassen, including face painting, a pirate show and music. Participants in the Sherpa/firefighter class must carry at least 20 kg of additional weight. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and trousers, and poles are not allowed on the Sherpa steps or in the open mountain terrain. The course is marked, and there are Norwegian Red Cross stations with defibrillators along the course. Water stations are listed at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and windproof trousers; poles are not allowed in the competition class. The Sherpa/firefighter class requires at least 20 kg of additional weight, and all participants must have a licence.

name: 3 toppsløpet på Jeløya (3TL)
description: 3toppsløpet on Jeløya is a trail race held annually around Midsummer, starting and finishing at Sølystranda on Jeløya in Moss. The race offers four distances: Mini 1TL (1 km), 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km). Runners alternate between forest trails and scenic beaches. The course includes the three well-known peaks Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen, offering a technically challenging and varied terrain experience. The event is run by volunteers and has a low entry fee. Any surplus supports children affected by war and conflict through a partnership with Right To Play.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths, forest roads, beaches and some paved sections
Includes three well-known peaks: Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen
The course follows much of the shoreline around Jeløya
additional: Mass start for 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km) at 10:00 from Sølystranda. Mini 1TL (1 km) starts at approximately 09:30. An early start for 3TL and the marathon is available at 09:00 for runners expecting to take longer. 3TL requires runners to check in at all three peaks; 1TL requires a check-in only at Rødsåsen. There are no aid stations for 3TL, so participants must bring their own food and drink. 1TL has an aid station at Kasekilen. Carrying a charged mobile phone is mandatory, and running with a backpack is recommended. The 2027 edition will take place on Saturday, 12 June, with the regular start from 10:00 at Sørlystranda.

name: Ålesund Maraton
distance_verbose: Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: Ålesund Marathon is an annual celebration in the city centre of Ålesund, offering races for all ages and abilities. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, 5 km relay, and the Children’s Mini Marathon, which has two distances. The courses run through the city streets, starting and finishing at Skansekaia, with spectators creating a great atmosphere along the route. The event encourages both personal bests and the enjoyment of running together, with starting groups suited to different expected finish times. The Children’s Mini Marathon gives the youngest participants a fun and inclusive start to the race-day festivities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Skansekaia in central Ålesund
The half marathon is run over two laps; the marathon over four laps
The 5 km relay course has three possible changeover points
additional: Starting groups for the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are based on expected finish times. The Children’s Mini Marathon has two distances (500 m and 800 m), with the option to change distance during the event. Free entry to Bybadet for children on 6 and 7 June upon presentation of a medal, race bib, or receipt. Relay teams can have 2–6 participants, with at least 40% women required on mixed teams. Traffic and parking in the city centre will be affected during the event; public transport and parking at Aksla are recommended. The Children’s Mini Marathon distances are 500 and 800 metres. Registration for the 2027 race has not yet opened.

name: Backyard Larvik Ultra
description: Backyard Larvik is a unique ultrarace where participants run a 6.7 km loop on the hour, up to a maximum of twelve loops. The race combines strategy and endurance: the last runner to start a loop wins. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to entry, with break facilities offering food and drink in a warm indoor venue. Participants who complete twelve loops receive a cup, and those who complete seven loops receive a wooden medal. The race takes place at Fagerli School in Larvik, with race bib collection and a race briefing on the day before and on race day.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop run on the hour
Maximum 12 loops, 80.4 km in total
Break facilities with food and drink in a warm indoor venue
additional: Race bibs and ankle chips can be collected at Fagerli School on Friday, June 12, from 18:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, June 13, from 07:45 to 08:30. The race briefing starts at approximately 08:30 in the hall at Fagerli School. Bringing your own cup is mandatory. The ankle chip and Velcro strap must be returned after the race; a fee applies if they are not returned. The Red Cross will be present with an ATV to provide assistance. The maximum number of participants is 350. A race bib can be attached with a race belt to make changing clothes during breaks easier. Maximum 350 participants. Bringing your own cup is mandatory. The organizer’s information about the race format and price reflects the published details and may change before the 2027 edition.

name: Sommernattsløpet Bergen
description: Sommernattsløpet Bergen is a summer road race held in beautiful surroundings around central Bergen. The course offers fast and relatively flat laps around Lungegårdsvann, with the start and finish in Nygårdsparken. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km consisting of two laps of the same course.
