The race is suitable for all levels and offers a festive atmosphere with music, cheering, and the chance to set a new personal best.
course_highlights: Course around beautiful central Bergen and Lungegårdsvann
Minimal elevation gain; a fast, flat course
Start and finish in Nygårdsparken, with music and cheering
additional: Pacers are available in several pace groups from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Bergen or on race day for participants travelling from farther away. All participants receive drinks and a medal at the finish. Prizes from partners are drawn after the race. The 5 km start time is listed as 19:00. The 10 km has wave starts at 20:00 for an expected time under 50 minutes and at 21:30 for over 50 minutes. Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Bergen or on race day for travelling participants. Participants receive drinks and a medal at the finish.

name: Bergsdalen Halvmaraton
description: Bergsdalen Half Marathon is held annually, starting at Bergsdalen Church, and brings runners together for a wonderful half-marathon experience in scenic surroundings. The race has a reputation for being well organized and welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is organized in collaboration with Stanghelle IL, which also offers several activities for children and adults in the local community. Bergsdalen Half Marathon 2027 is planned for June 12, and runners can look forward to a day with a great atmosphere and a challenging course.
course_highlights: Measured and well-marked courses
Reported to have around 90 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the church in Bergsdalen
additional: Previous editions have featured a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a relay. The 2027 edition is planned for June 12.

name: Kvammen halvmaraton 2027
description: Kvammen Half Marathon is organized by Kvammen Sports Club and takes place on Saturday, June 12, 2027. This is a challenging and exclusive half marathon that gives participants the opportunity to experience much of Kvammen. The course passes through scenic areas such as Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes, before finishing back at Høgda. This race is suited to runners looking for a challenging distance in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course passes through Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes
Scenic surroundings in the Kvammen area
A challenging and exclusive half marathon with varied terrain
additional: The course information is for the 2026 edition; a detailed course map and video were announced but have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: The “Krakės - Laiko ratu” running event is a traditional national race held in the town of Krakės, Kėdainiai District. The race welcomes everyone, from professionals to beginners and recreational runners, with a range of distances for different age groups. The start and finish are in the town centre, at Laisvės Square. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and awards in various age categories. Participants are served traditional šiupinys, and wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Laisvės Square in the town of Krakės
Different distances for age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race on the Krakių garbės ratas for children and families
additional: Race numbers are issued from 11:00. The opening ceremony and the 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race begin at 11:30. All participants are served šiupinys prepared by the Krakės Community Centre. Wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event. Awards are given to age-group winners, the youngest and oldest participants, and the fastest 10 km runners. Advance registration is online, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer. Various distances and age groups are available, with games and activities also taking place during the event.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in addressing mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The event celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run for everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social services. The MUT-LAUF 2026 takes place on June 13, 2026, with registration via the Davengo portal. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable accompanying program will be provided.

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service will be available from 09:30 to get participants to the 11:00 start on time. Online late registration is possible until 12.06.2026, with a late-registration fee of 3 euros. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance they ran. Prizes will be awarded to the top individual runners and the top 10 teams. Parking is limited, so using the alternative parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs are allowed only on a short leash and may not participate as members of a team. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for local projects for every lap completed. Venue at Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors including Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in dedicated 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km races. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race, with teams from companies, clubs or other groups eligible to compete.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through the center of Haren
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings
Dedicated races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a finisher shirt. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race has a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children attending Haren's daycare centers and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded in the school competitions. Free entry for children on school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026, prizes for winners and teams, parking nearby

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large loops of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose calming low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race with manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The race routes connect important archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary, the Goseck Solar Observatory, and the find site of the Nebra Sky Disc. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, near the Sky Disc, considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. Alongside the marathon, half marathon, and 10 km Sky Disc Run, the event also offers walking, cycling tours, and hikes to the find site. Held under the patronage of the Minister-President of Saxony-Anhalt, the event offers an appealing blend of culture and sport.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is held under the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place on June 13, 2026, at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by a passion for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various running routes for children, young people, and adults, leading through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeerlauf in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at the Friedensstadion Halberstadt takes place on June 12, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the track continuously for the entire 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to take part. Alongside the run, there are traditional activities such as pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and will take place for the 10th time on June 13, 2026. The course runs through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special nature experience along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is shaped by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge, and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, and closes on May 31, 2026.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld takes place on June 13, 2026, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in various distances, from children’s and toddler races to short-distance and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a fixture on Harsefeld’s events calendar and, in addition to sports, offers a colorful children’s program and food stalls.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 takes place on 13 June 2026 in Zielitz and is organised by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V., Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race is held away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until 6 June 2026.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Senftenberg Lake takes place on June 13, 2026, offering runners a choice of distances around scenic Senftenberg Lake. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start from 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, comprehensive refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Registration is online via myRacePartner, with late registration available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalde Tower Festival takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026 around the Market Tower in Luckenwalde. It is a traditional town festival, open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their budget. The festival offers a varied cultural programme and invites guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city is committed to an open festival by the people of Luckenwalde, for the people of Luckenwalde, and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The course covers 21 kilometers and starts at 10:00 from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race bibs can be collected from 7:00 in the start and finish area. The race is suitable for participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadt Marathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on 13 June 2026 in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, marathon relay for pairs, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children’s races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic town of Altenburg, with varied sections including climbs in the town forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the accompanying programme offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Citizens’ Run takes place on June 13, 2026, at Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different ages and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Race number distribution begins at 3:00 p.m. on the event day, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds go to the Visbek Citizens’ Foundation, making this a sporting event with a social commitment.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of competitions for all age groups and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s race to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and earn recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by offering refreshments after the race and awarding the winners.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in woodland surroundings. The course consists of a 5 km loop that runs along forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. A 1.5 km fun run without rankings is planned for children. The start and finish are located in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyn zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open to runners with varying levels of experience who want to spend time actively and compete on a moderately challenging course. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table along the way. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. Race bibs are collected at a self-service station at the venue, which also has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. Perseløpet has a friendly atmosphere, and runners who set a personal best get to ring the bell by the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Personal nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås school with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected at a self-service station about two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station and raise money for their school trip. A countdown feature and lap-time calculator are available for planning. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays, and half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Trollheimsløpet
description: Trollheimsløpet is a traditional race held in central Rindal, starting and finishing at Trollbanen. The course is mainly on trails, with sections of grass, asphalt and gravel, and takes in the scenic surroundings of Igltjønna. There are several distances and categories, including a children’s race, competitive classes and a recreational class, making the event accessible to all ages and abilities. The event also has a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments for sale, changing facilities and awards for both children and adults.
course_highlights: The course is mainly on trails, with sections of grass, asphalt and gravel
Around picturesque Igltjønna in central Rindal
The recreational class can take an extra loop for a total distance of 8 km
additional: The children’s race (200 m) starts at 11:45 and is not timed. The 1 km competitive classes for ages 11–14 start at 12:20, and the 6 km race for older classes starts at 12:45. The untimed recreational class offers a choice of 1, 3 or 8 km, with start times between 10:30 and 12:00. All children’s race participants receive awards, and class winners aged 15 and over receive cash prizes. Participants celebrating milestones receive awards for taking part over several years. The race office is located at the start, changing facilities are at Rindalshuset, and toilets are available at the venue. Previous editions have included an untimed recreational class and a children’s race. Information about registration and prices for 2027 is not available in the sources.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, offering a simple and efficient setup for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option of having your own nutrition table along the course. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, so both beginners and experienced runners can find a suitable challenge. The event emphasizes personal-record attempts and community, with the option to celebrate personal records near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed on every lap
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs are collected by self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available from RaceDays.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedter City Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Barmstedt. The event features measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s races and Bambini races. The start and finish are at the Market Square in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, over a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits
Course through Barmstedt town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing uses a rental chip worn around the ankle (except in the children’s races); the chip is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Different age categories and minimum ages apply to the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; information will then be posted on the website. Courses are measured; online registration is available; no late entries; refreshments and medals included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place on June 14, 2026, around Lake Donatus at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers various race distances, from a 400 m Bambini run and 1,200 m children’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and well marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to the half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family run and Nordic walking as additional options
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place at the sports grounds immediately after each race. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus; online registration; parking at Erftstadt railway station; start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: The Handewitter Summer Run on June 14, 2026, offers a varied running event for the whole region, with distances for every ability level. From the Bambini race to 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic walking, relay, half marathon, and wheelchair race, there is something for everyone. The event takes place around the Wikinghalle in Handewitt and stands out for its excellent organization, great atmosphere, and unforgettable finish-line experience. The courses, measured by the DLV, are flat with few elevation changes, making them ideal for beginners and experienced runners alike.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some on loop courses and others as out-and-back runs. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region coming together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: The Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. All distances start and finish at the sports field. The event offers several distances: 400 m for children, 1.4 km for young people, and 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes pass through the village and the surrounding countryside, with the typically rolling terrain of the Börde region, on roads and paved farm tracks. Drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food are available, and after the finish there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: The Kappeln City Run is a traditional running event held annually in Kappeln in the Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run a varied course through the town and surrounding area. The run is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating, with a well-organized event and friendly support.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfeld Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event welcomes runners from across the region and is jointly organized by several local running clubs and the City of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the Market Square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using single-use transponders. In addition to the relay marathon, there is also a children’s run of approximately 700 m.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Gardens Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied selection of courses. Distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, complemented by 5 km and 10 km walking events. New to the program is a fun run for the youngest children, with no registration or timing required; participants receive an official medal at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and experienced runners alike to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Elblągu
description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office where participants can collect their race packs, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and compete on the city’s scenic routes.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of all ages and ability levels. The program includes children’s races, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sporting competition and community spirit.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children in Warmia and Mazury. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is suitable for everyone, including first-time runners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions. Taking part is not only a sporting competition, but above all a way to support children in need. The main race is scheduled to start at 16:30, and the scenic course is also accessible to those who prefer walking.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonava Running Cup - 2026, Stage 2 is a running event taking place in the village of Ragožiai, Jonava District. This traditional race is intended for active sports enthusiasts and offers various distances and the opportunity to test their endurance and strength. The event is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy running in nature. It is organized by the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association, which ensures the smooth running of the competition and participants’ comfort.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the surroundings of the village of Ragožiai
Different distances are adapted for runners of various levels
Nature and natural trails provide an enjoyable running experience
additional: The event is open to all active and sporty people in Lithuania. Among the different distances and obstacle courses, everyone can find a suitable challenge or activity. There is no specific information about the event course or the number of participants; registration takes place through the official platform.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with about 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through Vöppstedter Forest, by the Liebenburg forester’s lodge, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is intended for well-trained runners. Refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are available in a covered room.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running celebration in the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, inviting runners, families and colleagues to kick off Midsummer week together. The race is 7.2 km long and follows easy-to-run gravel paths with beautiful views and two wooden bridges over the Lillån River. The youngest runners can take part in an exciting 600-metre Kidsrun without timing. After the finish, the evening continues with a pleasant after-run gathering with food, drinks and good company at Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7.2 km through the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve on easy-to-run gravel paths
Two wooden bridges over the Lillån River
Two longer hills near Venastugan
additional: The Kidsrun starts at 17:45, with runners gathering at 17:40. Race numbers can be collected from 16:00 to 18:00 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder, which is lent out at race-number collection and must be returned after the race. Water and sports drink are available at 3 km and 5 km. Toilets are available near the race area and at the refreshment stations. There are no changing facilities or showers on site. An after-run gathering with food and drinks is offered after the race (not included in the entry fee). Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Members of certain running clubs may receive a discount through the members’ pages. Group registration is available by contacting info@epictrail.se. After-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps Gård with food, drinks and good company.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Mesnaelva opp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: For klassene 0-11 år, 12-15 og 16-19 år kr 80,-

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Familie koster kr 250,- pr løp pr familie

description: Mesnaelva Uphill is a challenging uphill race held in scenic surroundings along the Mesna River in Lillehammer. The course climbs 360 metres over approximately 4 km, starting at Strandtorget and finishing at Kanten kro. It is the first uphill race in the Sørdalskarusellen and has been held since 2008. In addition to the main course, there is a shorter 2.3 km course for younger participants with 241 metres of elevation gain. The event offers both virtual participation and evening mass starts in waves.
course_highlights: 4 km course with 360 metres of elevation gain, from 123 metres above sea level to 483 metres above sea level
The course follows the Mesna River through scenic areas of Lillehammer
Short course for younger participants: 2.3 km with 241 metres of elevation gain and a 10.2% gradient
additional: Mass start in waves: Wave 1 starts at 19:00 for men aged 12–39; Wave 2 starts at 19:01 for women aged 12–39 and men aged 40–49; Wave 3 starts at 19:02 for the remaining categories; and Wave 4 starts at 19:00 for the youngest participants on the short course. There is a drinks station in the finish area, clothing transport from the start to the finish, and medical services at the finish area. Results are sent to participants' mobile phones immediately after they finish. Participants can also take part virtually from 15–17 June and record their time via My Page under the self timing tab. There is also a short course for children, starting at Badedammen.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Ski Lodge Tänndalen, Tänndalen, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a spectacular 161-kilometre ultrarace on easy-running asphalt through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway. The race starts at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen and takes you across vast mountain expanses, alongside sparkling waters and all the way to the World Heritage city of Røros, before returning to the finish at Ski Lodge. The race offers magical midsummer light and a unique mountain experience for ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 161 km of easy-running roads through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway
The route includes a loop to Funäsdalen and the World Heritage city of Røros
Start and finish at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen
additional: The race starts at 19:00. The organiser’s information says sunset is around 23:00 and describes the race as one of the few 100-mile races where a headlamp is not needed. Prize money is offered to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen is a long-established running race held in Torsby every Midsummer’s Eve, with a 42-year tradition. The race follows an 8.5-kilometre asphalt course through central Torsby and welcomes runners of all abilities, from elite athletes to recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in the 1.5-kilometre Minijoggen. There is also a popular team event, Lagjoggen, where three participants compete together and the team’s combined time is counted.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course through central Torsby
1.5 km Minijoggen for children and young people
Water stations at 2 km, 4 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: Mass start for Minijoggen at 9:30 on Östmarksvägen. Mass start for Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00 on Östmarksvägen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Torsby Ski Tunnel and Valbergsstugan. Prizes are awarded for the sprint prize at 2 km, the mountain prize at Kollsberg after 5 km, and the top three finishers in the women’s, men’s and team categories. Traffic marshals and course guides are stationed at road crossings with traffic. Medical care is available at the finish, with emergency response ready on the course. Previous editions have had their start and finish at Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen and Lagjoggen have started at 11:00, and Minijoggen at 9:30. The prize and start times for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are an MTB and running event held every Midsummer’s Eve in Orsa. The event follows a route through the Ore River valley, with forest trails, gravel roads and a little asphalt, and gentle to moderate climbs over sand ridges. Race numbers are sent digitally the day before and can be collected at the venue or at Karl Hedin in Orsa. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Ore River valley on forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Gentle to moderate climbs over beautiful sand ridges
The route is marked with orange enduro arrows and kilometre signs
additional: Race numbers are sent digitally to your mobile phone the day before the event. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa on Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00, or at the start location on race day. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. No refunds in case of injury or illness. Parking is available at Lillåvallen. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation. Registration is online and closes one hour before the start; on-site entries are not available. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the respective start location on race day. MTB competition classes require a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.

name: Vikersundbakken Trappeløp. Vegard Hjelmesæths minneløp 2027
description: Vikersundbakken Stair Run. Vegard Hjelmesæth Memorial Run 2027 takes place on Friday, June 18, 2027, in Modum. This unique race offers 6-, 12- and 24-hour events, where participants run up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road on a loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible within the chosen time limit. There is also an option for a children's race and a single lap for those who wish to take part.
course_highlights: Run up the stairs at the Vikersundbakken ski jump
A loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Run down the road after the ski jump
additional: Tickets are sold via racetracker.one. The event includes 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as a children's race and the option to run a single lap. The loop has 200 metres of elevation gain and goes both up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road. Registration via racetracker.one. There is also a single-lap competition and a children's race.

name: Skagerrakmila
description: Skagerrakmila is a summer race in Arendal that passes through the city centre and along the waterfront. The course offers varied terrain, with both flat sections and challenging climbs, including a tough hill by the kayak club. The start and finish are in Pollen, and the race is suitable for recreational runners looking for a challenging 10 km in beautiful surroundings. The event is organised by IK Grane Arendal Friidrett and has a pleasant summer atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pollen, in central Arendal
The course runs along the waterfront with lovely views and passes several landmarks, including Barbu Church and Arendal Old Town Hall
A challenging climb up to Vollenetoppen and a steep hill by the kayak club
additional: The children's race starts in Pollen and follows a shorter route through the city centre. The start and finish have been moved approximately 100 metres to improve flow in the finish area. There is a key point on the course with crossing traffic between 5.5 and 6.5 km, where runners must keep to the right. A children's race is also held. The course information is based on the 2025 map, so the route for 2027 may be different.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf takes place on June 19, 2026, and offers runners distances of 3.5 km, 6.5 km, and 10 km through the idyllic Leine-Masch, with nature, water, and wide meadows. The event also includes a 1.2 km Bambini run and a 6.5 km walking category. The 10 km course includes a team classification for mixed teams. The traditional Laatzen Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweig Night Run on June 19, 2026, offers a diverse sports program for all age groups, from Bambini races to races for everyone. The races run through Braunschweig city center, with the start and finish on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it grow. The race bib serves as a ticket for public transport in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download certificates, and baggage drop-off is open until 11:30 p.m.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, held in a lively evening atmosphere. Depending on the distance, runners can complete one or two laps of the 7.5 km route around the Alster. There are special 1 km and 1.8 km races for children. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere, with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall bringing the Hanseatic flair to life at dusk.

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
description: The Brunsbüttel City Run is an urban running event in Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, featuring 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a short stadium run for children. The start and finish are at the Bildungszentrum stadium on Ziegelweg. The event is open to adults, young people, school groups, corporate teams, and children—not just club athletes. The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. The youngest participants can take part in an approximately 400 m children’s run in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.

name: Jemgumer Dörploop
description: The Jemgumer Dörploop is a versatile running event in Jemgum, Lower Saxony, offering various distances for all age groups. From Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to challenging 21.2 km courses and relay races with electronic timing, there is something for every runner. The event takes place at the sports centre in Jemgum and offers a friendly atmosphere, with refreshments in the finish area. The course consists of 5.3 km laps, which are run multiple times depending on the distance.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 2: 34. Wöbbeler Volkslauf "Rund um den Hahnenberg"
description: The 34th Wöbbel Fun Run is the second race in the 2025 Lippe Summer Series and takes place on June 19, 2026, in Wöbbel, a district of Schieder-Schwalenberg. The course runs around Hahnenberg and offers runners a varied challenge. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and promises a pleasant atmosphere, with typical June weather and mostly sunny conditions.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held on the Baltic Sea, amid the picturesque surroundings of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete over the middle distance, which includes a 1.9 km swim in the Bay of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km bike course across the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for competition. The event is an official qualifying race and takes place on June 19–21, 2026.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a city race offering two distances, a 21 km half marathon and 10 km, with a shared start and finish in the heart of Malmö. The course combines the city’s industrial charm with green stretches and beautiful waterfront views, creating an energetic and varied running experience. Crowd support and a fresh sea breeze help runners all the way to the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, fruit and drinks, and services include water stations and medical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: Measured and certified 10 km and 21.0975 km courses
A course with industrial charm, green stretches and leafy trails
Beautiful waterfront views and a fresh sea breeze
additional: Water stations provide water and sports drinks. A measured, closed course with race marshals. Medical assistance in the finish area and at several points along the course. A medal, fruit, a bar and drinks for everyone who completes the race. Toilets at the event area and water stations. Distance changes are possible for an administration fee. Folksam’s recreational race insurance is available to purchase. Strollers and wheelchair participants are permitted, but the course is not adapted for wheelchair racing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runmalmo.se/nyhetsbrev/): 2027-06-19 — "Lördag den 19 juni 2027 smäller det – Efter den fantastiska stämningen under årets lopp ser vi fram emot att välkomna di" (was estimated 2027-06-13)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Lördag den 19 juni 2027 smäller det – Efter den fantastiska stämningen under årets lopp ser vi fram emot att välkomna dig till ännu en oförglömlig löparfest.

name: Midnight Sun Marathon
description: The Midnight Sun Marathon in Tromsø is an Arctic running adventure beneath the midnight sun, with five distances offering a unique experience in the light of the sun that never sets. The race brings together thousands of participants from around the world and creates a festival atmosphere, with the whole city cheering on the runners. With spectacular mountain and fjord scenery, and an intimate atmosphere that only Tromsø can offer, this is one of the world’s northernmost marathons and a highlight of the racing calendar.
course_highlights: Run beneath the midnight sun, with daylight all night
Spectacular mountain and fjord scenery
A festival atmosphere, with cheers from across the city
additional: Bib distribution and the MSM Expo take place before the race. Bag storage is available at Kulturhuset and Havneterminalen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Gyllenborghallen. Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km and offer water, sports drinks and bananas. The Tromsø Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps has a medical station every 5 km and provides assistance and transport when needed. Warm-ups take place 15 minutes before the start of all distances. Bibs can be transferred in the event of illness or injury with a doctor’s certificate and an administration fee. The event offers five distances. The courses are officially measured and certified, and the Midnight Sun Marathon is a member of AIMS.

name: Sentrumsgateløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km kr 50,- (Under 12 år) + 10 kroner i adm.gebyr

description: Sentrumsgateløpet in Kongsvinger is an annual city festival and running event offering certified 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a children’s race. The course runs on both sides of the Glomma, with the start and finish at Rådhusplassen by the library. The event combines the joy of sport with activities and a lively atmosphere in the town centre, and is suitable for all ages and levels. All finishers receive a participant medal, and prizes are awarded to the top runners in various categories.
course_highlights: The course runs on both sides of the Glomma
The 10 km is run as two laps of the same course
Certified distances measured by an authorised course measurer
additional: Race numbers are distributed on event day, with distribution monitored. Water stations are available during the race. Toilets and changing rooms/showers are available near the start/finish area. Results are published on EQ Timing, the local newspaper Glåmdalen, kondis.no and the race website. A children’s race is held in Byparken, with distances of up to 500 metres. Start times for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Sommernattsløpet Oslo
price_range: Fra 490 kr per distanse, pluss gebyrer
description: Sommernattsløpet Oslo is the most fun street race of the summer, with fast courses and beautiful surroundings at Filipstadkaia. Choose between 5 km and 10 km, both with minimal elevation gain and a good chance of setting a new personal best. The race takes place at sunset, with music and cheering, and all participants receive a drink and a great medal at the finish. It is a social and inclusive event for both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is a fast-paced loop
The 10 km course passes Filipstadkaia and includes an extra loop
The courses have minimal elevation gain and fast sections
additional: Start and finish at Filipstadkaia by Skur 13. Race numbers can be collected the day before or on race day from 17:00. Pacers are available for various finish times in the 5 km and 10 km races. All participants receive a drink and a medal. Group registration is available for companies, with separate administration and a VIP package for more than 100 participants. The listed start times are 5 km at 19:00, 10 km for runners finishing under 50 minutes at 20:00, and 10 km for runners finishing over 50 minutes at 21:30. Start times may change depending on the number of entrants. Runner’s World will provide pacers in Oslo.

name: HOKA Norefjell Trail
description: HOKA Norefjell Trail is a spectacular trail race held at Norefjell Ski & Spa. The event offers three distances: 12 km, 22 km and 42 km, all featuring varied terrain with trails, gravel roads and mountain areas. Participants can expect challenging climbs, technical sections and beautiful views, especially on the 22 km and marathon distances, which reach the summit of Høgevarde at 1,450 metres. The event also includes a free children’s event with games and running around a small lake, making it a family-friendly experience.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with gravel roads, technical trails and open mountain areas
Challenging climb to Høgevarde at 1,450 metres (22K and 42K)
Beautiful mountain views and a downhill stretch towards the finish area
additional: Free parking at Norefjell Ski & Spa. Bus transport is offered from Oslo and Gardermoen and can be booked when registering. Aid stations are available on all distances with snacks, sports drinks and water, but participants must bring their own cup or bottle (at least 0.5 L). Age limits apply, and gear checks may take place. The children’s event is free and requires no registration. After the race, there will be a social gathering with an awards ceremony and an evening party. The race takes place on 19 June 2027 at Norefjell Ski & Spa. A free children’s race is also planned, and the participant limit is 1,200. The race weekend programme includes social runs, including a 5 km run.

name: Kristinaløpet og Kristinastafetten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1500,- pr lag frem til og med 30. april 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- pr lag frem til og med 30.april 2026

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 2500,- pr lag fra 1. mai til 19. juni 2026

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: 1000,- pr lag fra 1. mai til 19. juni 2026

description: Kristinaløpet and Kristinastafetten are traditional races held on the streets of Tønsberg, starting and finishing at Bystranda on Kaldnes. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, an untimed fitness class, a relay with five short legs, and the 500-metre Children’s Kristinaløpet. The courses feature a scenic loop that includes a full circuit out to Ilene, and the relay route passes through Slottsfjelltunnelen, among other places. Runners start in waves based on their expected finish time, and electronic chip timing begins when they cross the start line.
course_highlights: The 10 km course includes a full loop out to Ilene
The relay consists of five legs, covering 5 km in total, and passes through Slottsfjelltunnelen, among other places
Start and finish at Bystranda on Kaldnes, with wave starts to prevent runners from mixing together
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Olympia Sport store at Jarlsberg from 15 to 18 June and on race day from 10:00. The pedestrian bridge between central Tønsberg and Kaldnes closes shortly before the start. Runners start in waves based on their expected finish time to prevent them from mixing together. Timing begins only when the chip on the race number crosses the start line. The 500-metre Children’s Kristinaløpet is open for registration on the day. Children’s Kristinaløpet is approximately 500 metres, with registration on race day. A 40% discount on the main race is offered to participants taking part in both Kristinaløpet and Kristinastafetten, subject to further terms.

name: Nøsen Hundreds Ultramarathon
description: Nøsen Hundreds is an ultramarathon offering distances of 21 km, 50 km, and 100 km through beautiful and challenging mountain terrain in Valdres, Norway. The race follows historic trails in Stølsvidda, an area with a rich cultural heritage dating back to the Stone Age. Participants experience spectacular landscapes of mountains, rolling hills, and traditional trails that have been a lifeline for people for centuries. The race combines a physical challenge with experiences in nature and a sense of being part of a long tradition. In 2025, Nøsen Hundreds celebrates its fifth anniversary and promises an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Historic trails in Stølsvidda with cultural heritage dating back to the Stone Age
Varied terrain with mountains, rolling hills, and gravel roads
Challenging climbs and mountain crossings, especially on the 50 km and 100 km distances
additional: All races start and finish at Nøsen Yoga and Mountain Hotel. Mandatory equipment is required for the 50 km and 100 km distances, including a backpack/vest, windproof and waterproof jacket and trousers, a GPS device with a GPX file, a mobile phone with the emergency number saved, and first-aid supplies. Participants in the 100 km race receive drop bags. An optional Salomon Shakeout Session and an introduction to sports psychology are also offered on the evening before the race. Several accommodation options are available at a discount for participants, including the option to camp at the hotel. For the 100 km course, information from 2026 states that runners must navigate using a GPS device and a physical compass, and download the official GPX file before the start.

name: Solnedgangen
description: Solnedgangen is a fast 5 km race held annually in June, starting and finishing at Sola Strand Hotel. The race is suitable for everyone over 10, whether you are a beginner or an experienced recreational runner. The course is flat and follows the cycle path by the beach, with a short gravel section at the turn. Participants can follow pacers targeting different times, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and an official time from electronic timing.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course along the cycle path by the beach
Runs on pavement, with a gravel section at the turn
Start and finish at Sola Strand Hotel, with views of the beach
additional: Race bibs can be collected in advance at Anton Sport Forus or at the start area from 20:30 on race day. Parking is recommended at Regestranden, about 1 km from the start/finish. Toilets are available at the hotel and the parking area. Pacers are available for 20, 25, 30 and 35 minutes. There are refreshments, a great atmosphere and an awards ceremony at the finish. The listed race arrangements include electronic timing, pacers for 20, 25, 30 and 35 minutes, a medal for everyone who finishes, refreshments and an awards presentation. The organizer’s page mentions a race on 20 June 2026; the date 19 June 2027 is not confirmed there.

name: Nordmarka Skogsmaraton 2027
price_range: Halvmaraton: 590–1 090 kr; maraton: 690–1 090 kr; ultra: 790–1 200 kr
description: Nordmarka Forest Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 34th time in 2027. The race takes place in the beautiful Nordmarka, starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snow Park in Oslo. The courses are mainly on gravel roads with some trails, offering a hilly, scenic route that is gentle on the legs. The event offers three distances: marathon, half marathon, and ultra. The ultra combines the marathon and half-marathon courses. The race is known for good refreshments and a friendly atmosphere in the forest.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on gravel roads, with approximately 1.5 km of trail on the marathon course
The marathon course has approximately 770 metres of elevation gain; the ultra has approximately 1,195 metres
Beautiful natural surroundings in Nordmarka, with fresh air and good refreshments along the way
additional: Start and finish at Sognsvann Snow Park, with easy public transport access via the metro to Kringsjå station. Bag storage with staff on hand. Self-seeding, with wave starts based on expected finish time. A race shirt can be ordered during registration until 8 March. Ultra runners have a separate turnaround point, with the option to access their own food and drink and receive a medical check. There is no time limit for the marathon, but ultra runners must pass the turnaround by 13:30. The minimum age is 15 for the half marathon and 18 for the marathon. Race-day registration is possible if places are available.

name: Chicken Race / Bootcamp Survivor
description: Chicken Race is Norway’s largest obstacle race for the whole family, held at a former military camp at Helgelandsmoen near Hønefoss. The course is approximately 2 km long, with over 40 different obstacles suitable for both adults and children, including optional challenges and shortcuts for younger participants. Bootcamp Survivor also offers challenging obstacle races over 5 km, 8 km and 16 km, including elite classes that are official qualifying races for the OCR European Championships and OCR World Championship.
