name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Salomon 27K is a mountain-running event covering 27 kilometres and crossing three mountains, with a beautiful finish in Ottsjö. Many consider it one of Sweden’s most beautiful races, offering a unique mountain experience and pure poetry in nature. Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food are available along the course, and a safety team can provide rapid assistance if needed. Participants can also take a bus transfer to the start and back after the finish.
course_highlights: 27 kilometres of mountain running across three mountains
Beautiful finish in Ottsjö
Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food
additional: Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, as well as a return transfer after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A kåsa drinking cup is used at cup-free drink stations. A safety team is on hand to respond quickly to accidents. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A large portion of the entry fee goes towards upgrading the Fjällmaraton trails for sustainable development. The race is part of Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. It includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying events such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. The organizers offer a full program and attractive prizes, and the course runs through charming health resort grounds.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka — Summer Edition is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal shaped like a water lily, and the main race starts at 10:00.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K is a prestigious vertical race held annually on Tuesday evening as part of Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. The race starts with a mass start at Åre Torg and finishes at the summit of Åreskutan, gaining exactly 1,000 vertical metres. It is a demanding race, and participants can expect to give their all from start to finish. The course records to beat are 46:24 for women and 39:13 for men. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Mass start at Åre Torg
Finish at the summit of Åreskutan
Exactly 1,000 vertical metres
additional: Food and drink stations along the course featuring local food products. A kåsa is used for serving drinks at cup-free hydration stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and bus transfers back after the finish. Electronic chip timing. Safety team for rapid response in the event of accidents. Entry can be transferred for a fee of SEK 250. Insurance is recommended to cover refunds in the event of illness or injury. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. The course records are held by Emmie Collinge in 46:24 and Kilian Jornet in 39:13.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olümpiastarti is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletic Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in various age groups and include a range of athletics events. The 10th stage takes place on July 29, 2026, at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun, motivating competition environment.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton 100K is a classic mountain marathon that starts at dawn in Fångåmon and follows a beautiful, winding, easy-to-run trail to Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. The route then joins the classic Fjällmaraton course over Ottfjället and continues over Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste on the way back to Ottsjö. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with a recovery zone in the finish area where participants can relax in a sauna and recover with non-alcoholic beer. All participants must be self-sufficient during the race, with the option to refill water at official aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Starts at dawn in Fångåmon
Beautiful, easy-to-run trail via Nulltjärn and Vålådalen
Passes over Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste
additional: Food and aid stations along the course serving local artisanal food. The official drink is U Sport by Umara (lemon). Participants receive a Fold-a-Cup for use at the aid stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and back after the finish. Recovery zone with a sauna and non-alcoholic beer in the finish area. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A safety team is on hand to provide rapid assistance in the event of serious injuries. Participants are responsible for their own fluids and energy between the official aid stations.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup
description: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup is a 13-kilometre trail race featuring technical trails and varied terrain in beautiful Kvitfjell. The race starts at Kvitfjelleggen and finishes at Tyrihanstunet, with approximately 240 metres of elevation gain. Known for its challenging and fun trails, the race is part of Lauparfestivalen, which also includes several other races and activities. Participants can look forward to a great mountain running experience, a lively atmosphere and the option to buy food in the finish area.
course_highlights: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road
Technical and fun trail on the west side of Svinåa
240 metres of elevation gain over varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 11:00 at the start. There is a drinks and food station at Svinslåvangen after 8.5 km. Parking is not available at the start. Recommended parking locations are Skitorget, by Tyrihans, along the roads towards the top (west side), or at Gudbrandsgard Hotel (east side). Carpooling is organised, with participants meeting at 10:00 in the parking area at the bottom of Vestsideløypa. Food can be purchased from Tyrihanstunet in the finish area. The race does not provide sports drinks or gels, in order to keep the event simple and affordable. The festival website lists the event as 24–25 July, which does not match the stated race date of 30 July 2027.

name: Kvitfjell Langlaup
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival offers three challenging races through varied terrain in Ringebu, Innlandet. Kvitfjell Opp is a brutal uphill race up the Olympic downhill course, climbing 838 metres over 3.2 km. Langlaupet is a 25 km long-distance race with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of road, offering an extra challenge for those who want more after the uphill race. Stuttlaupet is a 13 km race with technical trails and gravel roads, perfect for those looking for a shorter but challenging mountain run. All races finish at Tyrihanstunet, where good food and a social atmosphere are also on offer.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Opp: 3.2 km uphill race climbing 838 metres up the Olympic downhill course
Langlaupet: 25 km through varied terrain, with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of gravel road; highest point approximately 1,100 metres above sea level
Stuttlaupet: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road; a technical and enjoyable course
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the start of each race. Kvitfjell Opp starts by the lift at the bottom, while Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet start from Kvitfjelleggen behind the summit café. There are refreshment stations along Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, as well as a refreshment station on Kvitfjell Opp at the mid-station. For Kvitfjell Opp, parking is recommended at the mid-station; for Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, parking is recommended at Skitorget or Gudbrandsgard Hotel. A children’s race starts at 13:00 on Saturday during the festival, with a medal and drink at the finish. Talks and an after-run event are also part of the festival. Langlaupet is part of Kvitfjell Running Festival, which also includes Kvitfjell Opp and Stuttlaupet. Weather conditions can change in the mountains.

name: Kvitfjell Lauparfestival 2027
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival 2027 takes place in Kvitfjell from 27 to 31 July 2027. The festival offers a varied programme of sport and culture, with tickets available through EQ Timing. The event starts early in the day and continues until late in the evening, offering participants a great experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Uphill follows the former Olympic downhill course up the mountain.
The approximately 25 km long-distance race traverses varied terrain, including trails and gravel roads.
The short race offers a shorter 13 km trail-running distance.
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The event runs from early morning until late evening. It takes place in Kvitfjell, with a map and directions available on the website. The programme also includes an uphill race for children, talks at Tyrihanstunet, and an after-run.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop course at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The run starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned race in the region.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp is a 10 km city race that passes through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery. The race is a community celebration and a running highlight in Halland, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners. The course is fast and easy to run, with fantastic crowd support along the way. The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, creating a smooth and enjoyable overall experience for participants.
course_highlights: 10 km through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery
Fast, easy-to-run course with two water stations along the route
Start and finish at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, with good facilities and crowd support
additional: The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats. A warm-up with Nordic Wellness takes place at 11:40 in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:00 in the finish area. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on the Thursday and Friday before the race, and on race day from 9:00. Changing rooms and bag drop are available on race day. Massage is offered in the finish area after the race. Falkenbergs Stadslopp is the 2027 district championship and is part of Tour de Falkenberg. Start groups are marked with flags according to runners’ estimated pace per kilometre, for safety. The kiosk is open 10:00–14:00. There are two water stations on the course, at 3 km and 8 km, as well as one at the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.falkenbergsstadslopp.se/anmalan/): 2027-07-31 — "I år anordnas loppet den 31 juli 2027." (was estimated 2027-07-24)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: I år anordnas loppet den 31 juli 2027.

name: Ottsjö 12k
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn i åldern 10 -13 får springa tillsammans med förälder eller annan vuxen och endast betalar 200kr

description: Ottsjö 12K is a 12-kilometer mountain trail race with 300 meters of elevation gain. It offers a beautiful and memorable course without being as demanding as the longer distances during Fjällmaraton Week. The race is a perfect first step for runners who want to challenge themselves in a mountain setting and perhaps later try Salomon 27K or Kia Fjällmaraton. Children aged 10 to 13 can run with an adult at a reduced price, and youths aged 14 to 18 receive half off the entry fee. The race is organized with a focus on sustainability and safety, with food and drink stations along the course and bus transfers to the start and back from the finish.
course_highlights: 12 km of mountain trail with 300 meters of elevation gain
Beautiful and memorable course in a mountain setting
Food and drink stations featuring locally made food along the course
additional: Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and return bus transfers after finishing. Electronic chip timing. Safety organization for a rapid response in case of accidents. A kåsa (traditional drinking cup) is used at cup-free drink stations. Children aged 10–13 can run with an adult. Half price for youths aged 14–18. The standard minimum age is 14. Children aged 10–13 can participate with an adult for 200 kr, and participants aged 14–18 pay half the entry fee. The adult must stay in contact with the accompanying child throughout the race.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: Jordbærdilten 2027
location: Valldal, Fjord, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic fans create an electrifying atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, rounds off the sporting night perfectly.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run, and the Polish 10 km Championships.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle course race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It’s a challenge for the whole family, including children, offering unusual entertainment and the opportunity to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among the elite events of its kind in Poland and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
description: The Wronka Run along the Way of St. James is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The competition includes various age categories, including 500 m races for children and main races of 5 and 10 km on gravel roads. Organizers provide a race pack containing a bib, medal, and voucher for a post-race meal. The event is family-friendly and community-oriented, with routes passing through the charming countryside around Wronka.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place on August 2, 2026, at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the joy of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Rund um Wellen Fun Run will take place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen. It is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races and has a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: the marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km, some of which are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, including forest paths and surfaces of different types. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and is supported by many volunteers from the village.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
organizer: Gminne Centrum Czytelnictwa i Kultury w Krasnopolu
description: Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól is a forest race held in the Krasnopol municipality, offering courses of approximately 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs exclusively along forest gravel and grass roads, offering a connection with nature and pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre in Krasnopol, and the race starts in the afternoon. The event is open to all and is organised for people who enjoy outdoor activities.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 4
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races that start and finish at Idrettsplassen in Voss. The course goes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade, and is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, and you can sign up for individual races or all six races together. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy Voss’s running community.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races by the second race; otherwise, you can register for each race individually. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Search for “Voss Løpskarusell 2027” on EQ Timing to register.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 4
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for signing up for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races together at a discounted rate if you sign up by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30, while the others start at 19:00. You can register for individual races or get a discount by signing up for all six races by race 2.

name: Skärgårdsloppet
description: Skärgårdsloppet in Holmsund is a fun 7.4 km recreational race set in a beautiful archipelago environment. It is a Fun Run, meaning it is a recreational race with no official results list, except for the five fastest men and women. The start and finish are at Bräntebacken, and the course makes one loop around Lövöudden. All participants receive a medal, and the fastest man and woman receive a winner’s trophy.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course in an archipelago environment
Start and finish at Bräntebacken
One loop around Lövöudden
additional: The race is a Fun Run with no official timing for most participants, but times are recorded for the five fastest men and women. No times are recorded in the children’s race, and everyone is a winner. All participants receive the Skärgårdsloppet medal. The fastest man and woman receive a winner’s trophy. The main race is a Fun Run, with participants timing themselves in most cases. The children’s race is untimed.

name: Stranda Fjord Trail Race
description: Stranda Fjord Trail Race offers a spectacular series of trail races in the beautiful landscape around Stranda, Møre og Romsdal. The races range from a fast and challenging 7 km on gravel paths to extreme 95 km ultramarathons with significant elevation gain. Participants experience technically demanding trails, magnificent fjord views and varied terrain, including alpine sections and bogland. After crossing the finish line, runners are invited to a barbecue and concert, creating a sociable and festive atmosphere. This is a race for both beginners and experienced mountain runners looking for a unique nature experience.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 370 m ascent and 500 m descent, with views of the Geirangerfjord
12 km course with 848 m ascent and descent, offering panoramic views of the fjord
25 km of technically demanding terrain with 1,800 m of elevation change, previously part of the Golden Trail World Series
additional: Registration includes admission to the barbecue and live concert after the race. GPX files for the courses are available in the race guide. The races range from 7 km to 95 km, with significant elevation changes and technically demanding terrain. The race guide contains course information and GPX files. The other distances are 7 km Ljøbrekka Express, 12 km Skurahornet Up ’n Down, 55 km and 95 km.

name: Meråker Mountain Challenge
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 50 miles, 70 km, 50 km, Halvmaraton, 8 km, 2 km
description: Meråker Mountain Challenge is a demanding ultramarathon offering distances from 2 km to 161 km, including a spectacular 100-mile loop around Meråker Municipality. The courses feature varied terrain with mountains, forests, marshland and several peaks over 1,000 metres, and are suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners. The event has a long tradition and also includes the Norwegian Championships in trail ultrarunning. The start and finish are at Teveltunet, and the race places a strong emphasis on safety, good logistics and runner support along the way.
course_highlights: The course crosses varied terrain with mountains, forests and marshland
The 70 km distance passes nine peaks over 1,000 metres in Meråker Municipality
The 100-mile loop goes around the entire municipality and features spectacular mountain sections
additional: All races start on Saturday, 1 August, except the 100 km and 100-mile races, which start on Friday evening. Race bibs are collected primarily at Teveltunet, and transport to and from the start is available by free bus with advance registration. Personal support is permitted on the 100K and 100M distances. Drinking water sources are not publicly monitored, and using a water filter is recommended. The event has offered several distances, including 8 km, 20 km, 50 km, 70 km, 100 km and 100 miles. On the 100-mile course, one drop bag may be handed in before the start and collected at Nøstmo after approximately 93 km.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer-evening running adventure at one of Europe’s most architecturally and historically valuable hilltop fortresses. The challenging 9.4-kilometre main course climbs 470 metres, with the final kilometres running across the fortress plateau and offering magnificent views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe. Alongside the main race, there is a 7.7 km course, as well as a mini run and an inclusive run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held at sunset in the fortress market square.

name: Kia Fjällmaraton 45 km
description: Kia Fjällmaraton 45K is a demanding mountain marathon across classic mountain terrain, held during Fjällmaraton Week in the Åre area. The race dates back to 2005, and for 2026 the course is planned to cross Ottfjället along the event’s signature trail. The race welcomes both experienced mountain runners and curious beginners looking for an unusual and scenic challenge. To earn the well-known wooden medal, you must finish within the “medal time” (the winner’s time + 30%); all participants must be self-sufficient on the course.
course_highlights: The course crosses Ottfjället over classic mountain terrain
Food and hydration stations at Edsåsdalen (12 km, 25 km), Tobaksdalen (35.5 km), and Hållvallen (40 km)
Finish in Ottsjö, with a shared post-race lunch for all finishers
additional: Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; the official hydration product at the stations is Umara (2:1 lemon, 120 g/l). Water and toilets are available at the start in Trillevallen. Support along the course is not permitted except at the official stations. In addition to drinks, the stations offer bars, bananas, buns, and, at later stations, hot dogs, coffee, and broth. The race is approximately 45 km long with around 1,200 metres of elevation gain (according to a race report). Participants are self-sufficient between aid stations; official food and hydration are available at Edsåsdalen, Tobaksdalen, and Hållvallen. Kia offers Fjälltransfer, with free transfers between the finish and the parking area, as well as a bus between the finish and Undersåker/Åre. Accommodation in Åre near Kia Fjällmaraton includes, among other options, Hotel Åre Fjällsätra.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-marathon/): 2027-08-07 — "Tid & datum 07 augusti 2027 Start kl 14:00" (was estimated 2027-08-07)

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a challenging last-person-standing competition held in scenic Bunketorp in Lindome, south of Gothenburg. Participants run a 6,706-metre course on pleasant, well-trodden forest trails and exercise tracks, with a start every hour on the hour. Each lap must be completed within the hour to continue, and the runner who completes the most laps wins. The course is hilly, with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap, and offers beautiful forest scenery and varied terrain. The event provides a welcoming atmosphere with good service and support for both runners and their companions.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre course on soft forest exercise tracks and trails
A hilly course with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap and three major climbs
Beautiful, varied terrain with no asphalt or gravel roads
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting at the same time. Participants must be in the starting pen at the start and may not cross the start line and then go back. The venue has changing rooms with showers and a sauna, toilets, a participant tent for storage and rest, an aid station, refreshments for companions, secure storage for valuables, and first aid. There is no age limit; participation is at your own risk. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men, and the best team (3 runners).

name: Nätra Fjällskogslopp
location: Hinnsjöstugan, Nätra fjällskog, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Sweden
description: Nätra Fjällskogslopp is a trail race organised by Nätra GIF youth since 2021. It has quickly become popular and sold out. The race offers four distances: 22 km, 15 km, 9 km and a 2 km children’s race, all through the beautiful and challenging terrain of Nätra Fjällskog. The courses follow trails and forest roads, cross bogs on boardwalks, and offer wonderful nature experiences with views of Hinnsjön and the coastal landscape. The start and finish are at Hinnsjöstugan, and the organisers ask participants to respect the nature reserves along the course.
course_highlights: Beautiful terrain with trails, forest roads and boardwalks across bogs
Climbs up Selshöjden and Västanåhöjden, with views of the coast and Ulvön
A downhill stretch with enchanting views over Hinnsjön
additional: Start times: 22 km at 9:30, 15 km at 9:45, 9 km at 10:00 and 2 km at 10:10. Bibs must be collected by 9:00. A clothes drop-off is available at Hinnsjöstugan. Recommended equipment includes a mobile phone, water/energy supplies and a map of the course. Parking is along the road past Hinnsjöstugan, a short walk from the start. Participants are asked to choose their starting position according to their ability, with those aiming to race at the front. The courses are marked with ribbons in different colours for each distance. Clear course markings and participant support.

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun is a fast, flat half marathon in Skara with approximately 70 metres of elevation gain, making it a perfect course for setting personal records. The race is organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners. The distance is 21.1 km, and the course is designed to be fast and easy to run. Runners who are not members of a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association can register through M Motion or K Motion.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Approximately 70 metres of elevation gain
Suitable for personal records
additional: The race is listed as fully booked. For questions or to join the waiting list: istrun@istrumssk.se.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026
location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 490 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 540 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: Kivijärviloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by Kivijärvi IF since 1970. The race is held in the village of Kivijärvi in Tornedalen and offers several distances, with a 12 km main event open to both women and men, with no age categories. The race is known for its long history, beautiful courses and generous prize table, thanks to its sponsors. Many well-known athletes have taken part over the years, giving the race strong local and national standing.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with several distances: 0.5 km, 1.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 12 km
Course markers in different colors for each distance: yellow, white, blue and red
The race has used the same courses since it began in 1970, except during Covid
additional: Courses are marked with colors for different distances: 0.5 km and 1.5 km (yellow), 5 km (white), 7.5 km (blue), 12 km (red). The race offers a generous prize table for children, adults and recreational runners, thanks to generous sponsors. Kivijärvi is about 15 kilometers south of Korpilombolo along the Övertorneå road. Information on the official website applies to 2026 and does not confirm the date of August 7, 2027.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6 Hours is a challenging ultrarace organised by Storådalens SK at Hagabacken School in Guldsmedshyttan. The race offers two distances, 6 hours and 3 hours, with participants running a 2,130-metre course featuring approximately 50 metres of elevation gain per lap. Sports drink and energy products are served at the lap point, and sausage rolls are available halfway through. All participants receive a T-shirt after finishing, and honorary prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Results are published live on race day at hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: 2,130-metre laps with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
After 20 laps, runners reach marathon distance with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres
During the final 30 minutes, runners complete a shorter lap
additional: The start, lap point and race centre are at Hagabacken School, which has showers, toilets, services and medical care. Parking for the 6-hour race is on the gravel football pitch behind the school; for the 3-hour race, parking is at Guldsmedshyttebruk, 500 m away, or at the start. Timing is by ankle chip, which must be returned after the race. Umara sports drink and other products are served at the lap point. Sausage rolls are available halfway through the race. All runners receive a T-shirt after completing the race. Honorary prizes go to the top three in each category. The race has been cancelled due to too few participants. The planned start times were 11:00 for the 6-hour race and 14:00 for the 3-hour race. Timing was to be by chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

name: Craft Syv Søstre Skyrace
description: Craft Seven Sisters Skyrace is a challenging and spectacular mountain race on the Helgeland coast in Nordland, traversing the iconic De Syv Søstre mountain range. The race features technical terrain with steep climbs and descents, and offers fantastic views of the Helgeland coast. There are two distances: Syv Søstre, approximately 23 km with 2,900 metres of elevation gain, crossing all seven peaks, and Dronningruta, approximately 13 km with 1,300 metres of elevation gain, crossing the two northernmost peaks. Both distances are ISF-certified and UTMB Index races, making this an internationally recognised skyrace. The race takes place on 7 August 2027 and offers a memorable day in the mountains for local and visiting runners alike.
course_highlights: Technical terrain with steep climbs and descents
Fantastic views of the Helgeland coast from several peaks
ISF-certified course and UTMB Index race for both distances
additional: The race has two distances: Syv Søstre (23 km, 2,900 metres of elevation gain) and Dronningruta (13 km, 1,300 metres of elevation gain). All participants are required to download and use a GPX file on a suitable device. There are cutoff points along the course to ensure safety and emergency preparedness. A minimum of 1 litre of fluid is recommended at the start. Wool base layers are recommended in cold weather. The descent from Botnkrona requires extra concentration, and fixed ropes are in place at some points. The minimum age for Dronningruta is 14; participants under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian. The race is organised by Stigningsløp AS, with the aim of providing a safe and well-organised mountain race. It takes place on 7 August 2027 in Alstahaug. Both distances are certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and are included in the UTMB Index.

name: Solan Gundersens Bergmaraton
description: Solan Gundersen’s Mountain Marathon is organized by Alvdal Sports Club and offers challenges for all ages and levels, from a children’s race to demanding distances for those looking to push themselves further. The race follows Alvdal’s popular hiking trails, starting and finishing at Steimoegga Sports Complex. Great atmosphere and enjoyable experiences for the whole family are a priority, with both recreational and competitive categories available. Participants may encounter familiar characters such as Solan Gundersen during the race, which also features food and drink stations along the course.
course_highlights: The race follows Alvdal’s well-used hiking trails
Start and finish at Steimoegga Sports Complex
Food and drink stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Participants can enter the recreational or competitive category. Distances include 1 km, 6 km, 22 km (half marathon) and 48 km (marathon+). Age limits apply: 15 years for 22 km and 18 years for 48 km. Changing rooms and showers are available at Steimoegga. Bibs must be worn visibly on the chest. A license must be purchased when registering. Food and drink can be purchased at the kiosk at the start/finish. Free parking is available at Steimoegga. Dogs are allowed in the recreational category for 22 km. There will be cutoff times for 48 km. The entry fee is paid when collecting the race bib or invoiced after the race. Participants can opt out of having their photos used in marketing. Registration is open until the start. The entry fee is paid via Vipps when collecting the race bib or invoiced after the race. Food and drink stations are available along the course, and free parking, changing rooms and showers are available at Steimoegga.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: The Lääne-Viru County Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The events take place in different locations across Lääne-Viru County, giving runners the chance to enjoy both urban and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: The “Jurbarkas 2026” running race, held to mark the Year of the Nemunas, will take place on August 8, 2026, in Jurbarkas, on Nemunas Street. Children, young people, and adults are all invited to participate, with three distances on offer: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km. The event starts at 11:00. All participants who finish will receive commemorative gifts, and the best athletes will receive trophies. It’s a great opportunity to mark the Year of the Nemunas actively and run together in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Three distances to choose from: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km
The race takes place on Nemunas Street in Jurbarkas
The 12 km distance consists of 4 laps
additional: Race bib distribution starts at 10:00. Age groups by distance: 400 m — B12/M12 (born in 2014 or later); 3 km — B14/M14, B18/M18 (older participants compete without age-group ranking); 12 km — men and women in separate age groups. All participants who finish receive commemorative gifts, and the best receive trophies. Race distances: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; age groups; advance registration; registration on the day of the event will not be available.

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Šilutė night run “ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026” is a nighttime running event for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle—from families and beginners to experienced runners. The event takes place in Šilutė, with an illuminated night course, music, a great atmosphere and various activities. Participants can choose the 1 km run for families, children and pets, or the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants will receive finisher medals, prizes will be awarded to the fastest runners, and tasty food will be available.
course_highlights: Illuminated night course
Location: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distances: 1 km, 5 km and 10 km
additional: Event schedule: 18:00 bib collection, 19:30 official event opening, 20:00 1 km run for families, children and pets, 21:30 5 km and 10 km runs. Participants can enjoy music, prizes for the fastest runners, various activities and tasty food. Registration is open until August 7, 2026. The event program includes various distances and activities, and participants receive medals and prizes.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the geographical center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for young and old as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and run along paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there is an age-group classification as well as on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp, by Auesee. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. The organizer is ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized and pleasant race atmosphere.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association to promote an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Śliwice and offers participants an attractive 10 km course. The race attracts both amateur and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and bringing the local community together.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, featuring significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the „SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6th Złota Dycha is a road race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest city in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining the excitement of sport with the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—and participants can compete on the city’s picturesque streets. It is organized by Złotoryja City Hall and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with support from the local running community.

name: Kullamilen
organizer: Höganäs Friidrott tillsammans med lokala föreningar
description: Kullamilen is an annual fun run on the Kullahalvön peninsula, welcoming runners, joggers and walkers of all ages and abilities. The races start and finish at the athletics stadium in Höganäs, with distances for children and young people of 2.4 km, as well as 5 km and 10 km for recreational and competitive runners. The courses run largely along the coast, with beautiful sea views, and are sanctioned by the Skåne Athletics Federation. The event is marked by a sense of community, cheerful volunteers and a friendly atmosphere, with the joy of movement at its heart.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows much of the Kullahalvön coastline and offers sea views
The 5 km and 10 km courses run on asphalt and gravel and are marked and staffed by volunteers
The children’s and youth races take place on the athletics track, covering 6 laps of the 400-metre track
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 09:30 and 11:30 at the race office at the athletics stadium, and no later than 30 minutes before each participant’s start. Bib numbers can be collected from 09:30 on race day. Water stations are located at approximately 3.5 km, 6.2 km and at the finish. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. The 10 km is offered in both competitive and recreational categories. The veterans’ competitive categories are part of the Skåne Veterans Cup.
