description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running
additional: Bib collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00. The half marathon starts at 11:00, and the other distances start at 10:00. Registration will not be available on race day. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing purposes. The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: TEMPLE Kaunas Half Marathon '26 is the hottest summer running celebration in Kaunas, taking place on August 29. The event offers four distances: a half marathon (21.089 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a 400 m children's race. It is not just a competition, but a complete experience full of excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit, welcoming both those aiming for personal bests and those looking to enjoy the atmosphere of a running celebration. The event fills the city with participants' smiles and invites you to become part of its story.

name: 32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run is a great opportunity to get active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen, Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. The run starts at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is on Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place on Saturday, August 29, 2026, in Schneverdingen. This traditional running event is held as part of the Heideblütenfest. Organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen, it offers runners of all ages the chance to experience the beautiful heathland. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings, with numerous volunteers and supporters helping ensure that everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the Volunteer Fire Brigade, and the Heide Queen. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is handled by TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website. Online registration opens on 01.04.2026. Start and finish are on Schulstraße in front of the town hall. Results and certificates are available online.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf on 29 August 2026 is a traditional running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and ability levels. The route passes through the town centre and by well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the course. The focus is on the enjoyment of exercise and community, not competition. There are various races for children, young people and adults, including walking, company and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes by well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered until 07 June 2026 for 20.00 euros, and thereafter for 25.00 euros (while stocks last). Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late registrations are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website. The event takes place on 29 August 2026.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is SV 1860 Minden’s largest running event, with more than 1,000 participants every year. The 50th anniversary run takes place on 29 August 2026, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. At the same time, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: A course featuring new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium, with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merger that formed SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration opening in May 2026. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers a range of races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs for all ages and children. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest trails and over the heights of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable purpose.

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an extraordinary relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers, from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic towns, and marshland with a sea breeze. The event lasts more than 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete it together. Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital map materials are provided before the race.

name: Birklauf
description: The MTV Gelting 08 Birk Run is a traditional running event taking place on August 29, 2026, from 3:45 p.m. at Birkhalle Gelting. The event celebrates sport, fun and nature, giving runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Times are recorded on all courses except the 750-meter Sprottenlauf, and all finishers receive a medal. Results are categorized by age group, and prizes are awarded to the top three runners.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a long-running race organized by Läuferteam Pretzsch. The race takes place every year in autumn near Leipzig and features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The race is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove yourself on a varied course.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on 29 August 2026. Organised by Müritzer LSV, the course circles picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused community race in Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied routes wind through breathtaking natural scenery around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for experienced runners and beginners alike. Alongside the competition, the event puts community spirit at the forefront, supported by an attractive program at the sports field. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening road race taking place on August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through central Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel Beach. The course is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with music and lighting awaits. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality. After a one-year break, it returns to Straszyn. The organizer is the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality Sports and Recreation Center, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses of 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses available as GPX files with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect. Maps and GPX files are available for the courses.

name: Røykenmila 2027
price_range: 400 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for deltakere under 16 år og Minimila

description: Røykenmila is a challenging trail race in Kjekstadmarka, taking place on Sunday, 29 August 2027. The race offers scenic surroundings with gravel roads and trails, and is suitable for the whole family, with activities and a market day. It is a social event aiming to encourage exercise and support good causes in the local community. The start and finish are at Kjekstad farm. Distances of 5 km and 10 km are offered, as well as the Mini Mile for children.
course_highlights: Trail race through scenic surroundings on gravel roads and trails
Water station on the 10 km course at Haukelia, about halfway around the route
Start and finish at Kjekstad farm, about a 15-minute walk from Røyken station
additional: The Mini Mile starts at 11:30, with prizes for all children. Family activity trail with a quiz and canoeing. Several stalls and entertainment throughout the day. Free treatment and storage of valuables for participants. Course marshals ensure the routes are clearly marked and safe. Strollers can be used on the Mini Mile and activity trail, but a child carrier backpack is recommended. Registration for the 2027 edition has not yet opened. The activity trail costs NOK 100 per family. The organiser says all proceeds will be donated to good causes.

name: Norgestesten 2027 2
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and simple running event held in Jessheim, with a mass start and many experienced pacers. The course is a flat 3,146-meter loop, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Distances range from an 800-meter children’s race to a half marathon, and the event focuses on community and an enjoyable running experience. Proceeds support sports for children and young people in the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-meter loop
Mass start with pacers at several paces
The race is held in Jessheim, with convenient logistics and parking nearby
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 m long. Self-service bib pickup is available from 09:00 in the start area. Toilets are available at Jessheim Friidrettsstadion and in the ice and multi-purpose hall. A table for runners’ own drinks is provided at the start, along with water and sports drink along the course. The half-marathon cutoff time is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Mass start with pacers. The train station and parking are approximately 300 meters from the start. Proceeds support sports for children and young people.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place on August 30, 2026, at the playground in Löwenruh Park in Tallinn. This family-friendly event features a 5 km main race as well as children’s races for participants up to 10 years old. The event centre, start and finish are located next to Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for people of different age groups.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event through the green heart of Lower Saxony’s state capital. The public race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making fast times possible. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass-Serie der Region Hannover.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg), at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place on August 30, 2026, at Arendsee Beach. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic natural setting. In addition to the race, there will be a small party on the evening before to celebrate sport and community together. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
description: The 6-hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course runs mostly over paved surfaces and partly over grass, and is easy to see from the start/finish area, keeping spectators on the edge of their seats. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with a separate classification for the marathon (42.2 km). The race is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier; for the first time, the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-meter run and earn the DLV running badge.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on August 30, 2026, offers five varied routes with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races pass through the picturesque Blankenese Treppenviertel, along the Elbe, and through varied parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and unique combination of urban and nature-filled running. At the finish, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal and a lively awards ceremony.

name: Grafschaftslauf
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied route rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passes historic buildings and runs through the town centre, then follows the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route continues through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Wald at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race features varied rural paths, enthusiastic spectators and a special connection between sport and regional history.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The route covers around 250 kilometres through the impressive natural landscapes along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg on St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in Bad, a district of St. Peter-Ording. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each covering several sections of the route, making the race a special shared experience.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on 30 August 2026 in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and ability levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park, with the start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly, with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates and prizes. The event is organised by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
description: The 6-hour SPARKASSENLAUF in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course is mostly paved, with some grassy sections, and is clearly visible from the start/finish area, adding excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual race, there are team and relay events, with a separate classification for the marathon distance (42.2 km). The race is open to participants born in 2008 or earlier, with special events for young people and children.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is for hiking enthusiasts and offers a great opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. It is a sociable and active event suitable for all age groups. Organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V., it is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and marked every kilometre, with times recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. The organizers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim, a fast and flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds—a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.

description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children and a sociable atmosphere with team registration and a picnic bag. The course is hilly and passes through beautiful natural surroundings in the area around Ymergården, making the event both challenging and scenic. It is a popular wellness activity for individuals and teams, with a focus on community and health.
course_highlights: 5 km run/walk on walking-friendly trails in hilly terrain
10 km run on hilly trails and roads between Ymer and Kype, with a new route
Lilla Blodomloppet — a child-friendly course where children can run, skip or walk
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event until one hour before the start, for an increased fee. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Late registration at the event area opens at 16:00. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 700 metres for children up to 12 years old. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount.

name: Terrengløp i Smidalen
organizer: Nidelv IL Friidrett og Nidelv IL Ski
description: Terrengløp i Smidalen is an accessible cross-country race for children and young people in grades 1 to 7, organized by Nidelv IL Friidrett og Ski in collaboration with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. The race takes place on a loop of approximately 1,000 meters, with distances adapted to each grade level. All participants start together, and the event encourages well-rounded training and competition in an inclusive environment. It is an important offering for children at Nidelv IL and a popular event with strong participation.
course_highlights: A roughly 1,000-meter cross-country loop
Race distance adapted by grade: grades 1–3 (1 lap), grades 4–5 (2 laps), grades 6–7 (3 laps)
All participants start together
additional: The races are held several times a year, with a focus on children and young people at Nidelv IL. Coaches and team leaders are encouraged to prioritize participation over their own training. The event is part of a sponsorship agreement with Kjeldsberg Eiendom AS. Details about the course and laps come from coverage of the 2026 edition; the information does not confirm that the 2027 edition will follow the same format.

description: Arnaløpet is a long-running race that was first held in 1977 on a challenging 13 km course. Since 1984, the course has run around Haukelandsvatnet, and since 1988 there has also been a shorter 3.4 km family course. The event is a major family gathering in Arna, combining competition and social activities, including music and a warm-up before the start. The race is suitable for both children and adults, with free entry for children under 12.
course_highlights: Course around Haukelandsvatnet
3.4 km family course
Historic course starting at Londalskrysset (former route)
additional: The Family Race starts at 19:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:30. The registration deadline for family and individual entries is Monday, August 31 at 18:30. Registration is online only. Race numbers can be collected at Øyrane Torg and Espelandshallen before and on race day. There will be music, socialising and a warm-up before the start. Many great gift prizes will be drawn using race numbers. Participants must use different race numbers when registering for both courses. The stated distances, prices and start times are from the 2026 edition and may differ in 2027. In 2026, the family course started at 19:00 and the 10 km race at 19:30.

description: Blodomloppet in Halmstad is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings participants together in teams and ends with a group picnic. It combines exercise with important civic engagement and has a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in scenic Tylösand
Lilla Blodomloppet for children and young people
Water stations along the course
additional: You can register individually up to race day, 1 September. Start places are sold only through the website. Companies or teams can rent a tent by the finish area, which has a sea view. Food, drinks and ice cream can be purchased from kiosks and food stands at the start. The race ends with a group picnic. Changing facilities, toilets and storage are available at the event area. The race is scheduled for 31 August 2027. Registration is not yet open, and price information is provisional.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural event through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to everyone; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the event, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km route from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions
additional: The event is non-competitive and open to everyone to run, walk, roll or dance. The start is by the sculpture Protest at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to foster a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 says the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg. Dates and times for 2027 are not specified in the sources.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 4
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances, from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, and includes shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadium for most races. Participants use the same race number throughout the series, and the event is open to children, teenagers, and adults.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden, 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden, 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races are held at different locations in Sørum, with Stomperud Stadium as the main venue. The meeting point is listed as Stomperud Stadium, Lørenvegen 2, 1923 Sørum. The distance, start time, and registration details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing via EQ Timing. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. Season-pass holders collect their race number at the first race; individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish right by the car park in Essoskogen
Two distances: 3 km (one lap) and 5.6 km (two laps)
After 200 metres, the course turns sharply right and runs down along the edge of the field
additional: Electronic timing via EQ Timing. Season-pass holders collect their race number at the first race; individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level. The season pass offers a discount, and race numbers are handed out at the first race. Start at 18:00. Registration is available with a season pass or for individual races.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course runs in the opposite direction from usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies awarded to the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of the Leśne Piątki series and part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging people to stay active throughout the year.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
location: Ramsviks Camping, Ramsvik, Sotenäs Municipality, Sweden
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a unique multi-stage trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Ramsvik in Bohuslän. Over three days, participants experience a total of 77 kilometres across varied terrain featuring massive cliffs, narrow forest trails, coastal communities and beautiful beaches. The race offers different start groups for walkers, joggers and runners, making it an experience for all levels. Alongside the race, there are activities for children at Kids Camp and accommodation options close to the sea at Race Village. It is a highlight for anyone looking to combine a challenge with spectacular nature and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 77 kilometres of trail over three days, in stages
Massive cliffs, narrow forest trails and beautiful beaches
Start groups for walkers, joggers and runners
additional: Participants use the Pace+ app for race tickets, start times, schedules and maps. The official accommodation partner is Ramsvik Stugby & Camping by the sea, where Race Village and post-finish activities are also located. During the race, Kids Camp offers activities for children such as sailing, fishing and a visit to Nordens Ark. Race Village is located at Ramsviks Camping. Accommodation is booked separately; Ramsvik offers accommodation packages with a cottage, breakfast and dinner. Kids Camp is available for children aged 6 and over.

name: Knarvikmila 2027 - Sparebanken Norge Stafetten
description: Knarvikmila is a long-standing running event that has grown since 1983 into a major community celebration featuring both sports and cultural activities. The event runs over several days and includes various races, seminars, concerts and family activities. The Sparebanken Norge Relay is a social and intense relay with five short legs, perfect for team-building and having fun together. The start and finish are at Knarvik Stadium, with good facilities such as changing rooms, showers and baggage storage in Nordhordlandshallen. After the relay, participants gather in the hall for food and mingling, with an awards ceremony for the top teams.
course_highlights: The relay consists of 5 legs between 400m and 1700m
Start and finish at Knarvik Stadium, with the relay exchange near the stadium
The course goes through Knarvik ungdomsskule, the car park, Juvikstølen and Brekkeløypa
additional: Race numbers and the relay baton can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday 16:00 - 17:45. The baton must be returned in the finish area. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. Free parking in the area around the stadium. After the relay, there will be an awards ceremony and a social gathering with food and mingling at Nordhordlandshallen. The event address provided is Knarvik Stadion, 5916 Isdalstø.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place on 28 August 2026 in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances include a 600 m Bambini run, 1.25 km school races, and 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals; participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with remarks by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini races have a participant limit of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. On-the-day registration is not available. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00. Several race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organised by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place on 4 September 2026 around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. The event is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a programme including race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circuit around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on event day from 14:00 to 15:30. A walking group starts at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at four-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a musical act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC, near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. The event takes place in all weather. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Run on 4 September 2026; registration opens on 1 June 2026; takes place in all weather; parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrte City Run takes place on September 4, 2026, and is a long-standing running event in downtown Lehrte. The races cover distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including children’s and school races, as well as a 2-kilometer inclusion run. The corporate competition over 4 and 10 kilometers will once again be sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Musical accompaniment and a varied program of activities featuring the LSV departments will create a great atmosphere.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description:
The HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon starts at Sundstorget, outside Dunkers Kulturhus. The unique route begins with two kilometres through Helsingborg’s historic and beautiful city centre. You’ll pass historic quarters such as Stortorget and the medieval fortress Kärnan, then continue through the Tågaborg and Maria Park neighbourhoods and the Pålsjö Forest Nature Reserve. The route then finishes through Laröd, down Tinkarpsbacken and along our beautiful seafront promenade, with the sparkling Öresund Strait before you.

The course has only 95 metres of elevation gain, with a hill up towards Kärnan after 2 kilometres and a long downhill towards the sea after 19 kilometres. Running the HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon lets you enjoy everything from the vibrant city centre to peaceful woodland and the sea.

At the finish, you can enjoy your achievement on the wooden deck—and perhaps celebrate with a dip in the Öresund Strait? Afterwards, head to our event area, with activities for the whole family, relatives and supporters.
additional:
START: 09:30, 09:33 & 09:36
DISTANCE: 21,097.5 metres
ELEVATION: 95 metres of elevation gain. 190 metres total (up & down)
SURFACE: approx. 99% asphalt, 1% other
HIGHLIGHTS: City centre, Bergaliden, Slottshagen, Kärnan, Mariastaden, Maria Park, Pålsjö Forest, Laröd, Tinkarsbacken & the Seafront Promenade
NEIGHBOURHOODS: City centre, Slottshöjden, Tågaborg S, Tågaborg N, Norr, Ringstorp, Mariastaden, Hittarp-Laröd
GPX: Available to download from the website.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is Gothenburg’s largest trail race, offering five challenging distances in beautiful, varied terrain close to the city. The races follow adventurous trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops with fantastic views, mixing technical sections with easy-running stretches. The start and finish are at historic Kvibergs Park, and the courses take you from the outskirts of the city into the wilderness, with lakes and magical forests along the way. After the finish, a convivial AfterRun with food and energy awaits, giving you a chance to celebrate your achievement. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners looking for a true nature challenge near Gothenburg.
course_highlights: A mix of technical and easy-running trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops
Routes past idyllic lakes and magical forests, including historic cairns
Start and finish at Kvibergs Park, with views over Gothenburg and the Säveå valley
additional: Start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shuttle bus from Kviberg. Self-seeding in start groups takes place on site. AfterRun with food and energy after the finish. Live tracking and split times. Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs are distributed on Friday and Saturday before the race. Public transport by tram and bus to Kviberg is recommended. Name changes are possible for a fee until 3 September. A children’s race is available as a supplementary activity. Most races start and finish at Kvibergs Park. The 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shuttle bus from Kviberg. The longer races require, among other things, a water container of at least 0.5 litres, energy supplies and a charged mobile phone.
