name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Stadtparklauf Sondershausen is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. It offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The route winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The event is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.

name: 6. The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon
description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, Sportverein Enge-Sande von 1959 e.V., is a multi-faceted club offering a wide range of sporting activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners looking for a special challenge.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Mountain Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km mountain runs with around 110 meters of elevation gain. Organized by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the run has been an accessible local mountain-running event for 19 years. After the run, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and refreshments available on site.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied programme for all age groups, with distances ranging from about 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, running through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also has a social focus, as proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest community race, offering a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals on its flat loop courses. The event features distances ranging from a 400 m children’s race to the 10 km main races, which take place on a flat 2.5 km loop through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take center stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. More than 1,300 participants make the race a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to take part in various races through the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race number. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, and changing rooms and restrooms are available at Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a long-established running event in Wilster, taking place for the 34th time on September 19, 2026. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, through the scenic Wilstermarsch. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzsee Run in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly fun run, taking place for the 21st time on September 19, 2026. The varied routes run around Lake Wutzsee through Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and a varied program of activities. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or print on site.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the scenic areas around the venue. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race through central Trollhättan that began in 2016. Starting at Folkets Park, the race takes runners through varied terrain, including urban surroundings, hilly trails, stairs and scenic areas such as Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, several locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan. There are several distances to choose from, from a short, child-friendly Mini Trail to longer, challenging courses of up to 22.5 km. The race also offers start classes for running with a dog on certain distances, making it an inclusive event with a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: A trail race featuring hilly paths and pulse-raising stairways
Passes several locks, Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
A mix of urban surroundings and nature experiences
additional: Bib distribution opens at 11:30. Start times: 13:00 for Mini Trail 0.8 km; 14:00 for City Trail 8.5, 14 and 22.5 km; and 14:15 for City Trail 8.5 and 14 km with dogs on a leash. The awards ceremony takes place about 30 minutes after the first finisher crosses the line. The race offers dedicated start groups for running with a dog on a leash in the 8.5 km and 14 km races. Mini Trail is a children’s race for ages 0–12, with no timing or competition. Start and finish at Folkets Park. Previous editions have offered 8.5 km, 14 km and 22.5 km, as well as Trollhättan Mini Trail at approximately 0.8 km. The distances and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race dating back to 1966, organized by IFK Skövde Skidor. The race has historically featured varying distances, but since 1993 both men and women have competed over 10.5 km. There are also categories for younger participants, such as Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet, as well as a Nordic walking category for recreational participants. Over the years, the race has attracted many well-known Swedish runners and is a popular event in Skövde.
course_highlights: A cross-country race with a rich tradition dating back to 1966
A 10.5 km race for both men and women since 1993
Categories for younger runners and Nordic walking
additional: New categories for younger participants are available, including Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet. There is also a Nordic walking category for those who prefer it. Course records are documented for men and women over 10.5 km, as well as for older distances. There is also a Nordic walking category for recreational participants.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a popular fun run held in Linköping, starting and finishing at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race offers a pleasant course through the central parts of the city and a great running experience for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good amenities, including changing rooms, showers and bag drop. It is a traditional autumn race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course passes through central Linköping, with lovely views
Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen
Paved surface with gentle undulations
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. A bag drop is offered. Food and drink, as well as medical assistance, are available on site. Bib numbers and race confirmations are handled according to the terms and conditions. It is possible to transfer an entry and change category. The race also seeks volunteers.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and ability levels. The main event is a 10 km fun run along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest participants. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The event venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race bib collection and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet has start times from 09:15 to 10:15 for different age groups. The Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45 and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition; details about the 2027 event format and registration have not been confirmed.

description: Lina Roindt is a traditional race organized by Rindal IL, bringing competitive runners, recreational runners, and walkers together for a major family day at Torshall in Bolme, Rindal. The 10.8 km route is on asphalt and forms a loop around Rindal town centre, with a 6.7 km option for the recreational class. The event includes competitive classes for different age groups, an untimed recreational class, and a school cup for grades 5–10. There is an awards ceremony, sprint prizes, prizes for course records, and raffle prizes in the recreational class. Lina Roindt attracts high participation and is known for its great atmosphere and efficient organization.
course_highlights: 10.8 km asphalt route around Rindal town centre
Recreational class with a 6.7 km option via Sunnabrua and Elvepromenaden
Course records are rewarded with NOK 1,000
additional: Start and finish at Torshall in Bolme. Race office at the start. Changing facilities at Rinnvollen Football Stadium. Awards ceremony for competitive classes at 15:00 at Torshall. The recreational class starts between 11:00 and 12:30. The «Bjergpris» sprint prize of NOK 300 is awarded after 2.7 km. One-third of participants receive prizes in each class, including cash prizes for the top three overall, regardless of class. The school cup is for grades 5–10, with a prize for the class with the highest participation. An untimed recreational class and a school cup for pupils in grades 5–10 are offered. The stated distances and practical details apply to previous editions and may change for 2027.

name: Gjesdalmilå
description: Gjesdalmilå is an annual race organized by Gjesdal Idrettslag and held in Ålgård. The event offers distances for children, 5 km and 10 km, as well as a double distance for those who want to run both the 5 km and 10 km. The courses pass through scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Sentralidrettsanlegget, and feature varied terrain with both easy-running sections and some hills. The event is a natural choice for both recreational and elite athletes in the region and promotes the joy of sport for all ages.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is easy to run, with fewer hills, and consists of several loops around Solås skole and Åfaret.
The 10 km course crosses the E39 through the underpass and follows Edlandsvatnet over varied terrain.
The finish is on the athletics track at the finish line at Sentralidrettsanlegget.
additional: Schedule: The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km starts at 12:30, and the 10 km starts at 13:30. The double distance involves running both the 5 km and 10 km. The children's race is 650 metres and takes place in the area around Ålgård Stadion. For 2027, the schedule is: children's race at 12:00, 5 km at 12:30, and 10 km at 13:30.

name: Storehornet 497 - 2027
location: Godøy, Giske, Møre og Romsdal, Norway

name: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros
description: KOMIA Kyrkösjärvi Loop is Seinäjoki’s legendary and popular running event, taking runners around Kyrkösjärvi. The event venue is Kyrkösjärvi Beach and the Käpälikkö Nature Centre, where the start, finish, parking and event centre are located. The main distance is a 15.4 km route. There is also the shorter, approximately 4.3 km Pikku Kyrkkäri for young people or as a jog, as well as the 400–500 m Mini Kyrkkäri for the youngest family members. The event offers a memorable running experience surrounded by nature and is open to participants in different age groups and categories.

name: Juutuanvaaran kymppi – polkujuoksu Inarissa 2026
location: Juutunvaaran vanha metsä, Inari, Lapland, Finland
description: Juutuanvaara Ten is a new trail-running event in Inari, offering memorable trails of varying lengths for all runners. The route runs through the old forest of Juutunvaara, with varied terrain ranging from pine heath to mountain birch woodland and stunning views of Lake Inari. The race starts on 20 September 2026 at 12:00. Participants will receive honorary prizes and commemorative medals. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and participants will receive a race sausage and a drink.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event offering various distances. It starts and finishes in Aerzen. Events include 5 km and 10 km fun runs, a 5 km company and team run, a 1.8 km schoolchildren’s run, and a free children’s run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony. The races are scored according to DLV rules, and participants can win prizes and enter a raffle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs, plus a 5 km company and team run
1.8 km schoolchildren’s run and free children’s run
additional: Late registration is available on September 20, 2026, from 9:00–9:45 a.m.; for the schoolchildren’s run, until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 1:30 p.m., with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit. Events for children and young people. Registration opens on August 1, 2026; late registration is available on the day of the event. Scoring according to DLV rules, prizes and certificates, company and team run, parking at the event venue.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on 20 September 2026 in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. laufen.de members can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” offer. The course is officially measured and suitable for record purposes.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C, with mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity initiative in sport and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are usually cloudy. Discounted registration is available through laufen.de; the event supports charitable causes. Ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorf Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program of activities that includes face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking, or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive activities for children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can look forward to a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an awards ceremony.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuit routes through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event includes individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish at the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is via the Davengo platform.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on September 20, 2026, in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs around Heidebad and offers varied surroundings. Registration is open until the day of the event.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf near Hamburg is a long-standing race, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including runs from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On race day, there is a tent village, with the start and finish at the dog meadow, where participants can collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km. The courses run through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including a section around the lake, and has a family-friendly atmosphere with plenty of volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 5
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is an inclusive running series for everyone aged 9 and up, with five races throughout the year. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and passes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes both casual runners and competitive runners.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race. Registration for all six races opens on 15 November 2026 and closes on 3 May 2027. Registration for individual races is available via eqtiming.no. The races take place on Mondays. Start time: 18:30. Registration takes place online via EQ Timing. You can register for an individual race or get a discount by registering for all six races before the second race.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club and takes place on the Järve health trail in Tallinn. This stage gives participants the chance to enjoy a health trail close to the city, well suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well organized, offering an enjoyable sporting experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy exercise in the fresh air.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place by Lake Rava in Järvamaa. Runners of all ages take part, from toddlers to seniors. The race features a single lap around the lake, with prizes awarded to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional, community-focused running event that offers both a sporting challenge and a chance to enjoy nature.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Kauno rajono mero Valerijaus Makūno ir olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento taurei laimėti
TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: #BeActive bėgimas, skirtas Europos sporto savaitei
description: The European Week of Sport #BeActive event in Vilkaviškis is an important community tradition, inviting people of all ages and fitness levels to spend time actively. The program includes relay races, active games, football, wrestling and chess competitions, line dancing, exercise, Nordic walking and a group walk around the city. The evening program culminates in a group dance and an energetic “Dance party” to Zumba rhythms, bringing participants together and highlighting the importance of movement in the community.

name: Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and levels to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km and 10 km, plus a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages fundraising via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact people can be reached via the specified email address. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. Information about the distances and event is based on previous editions; details for 2027 are not confirmed by the sources.

name: Birken Gateløp 10 km
description: Birken Street Run in Lillehammer is a running festival in the heart of the city, offering distances of 10 km, 5 km and the BarneBirken Street Run. The race is for everyone, whether you’re chasing a personal best, trying your first 5 km race or looking for an active experience with family and friends. Music, cheering crowds and lively support along the course create a festival atmosphere for both fast runners and those taking a more relaxed pace. The start and finish are centrally located at Sigrid Undsets plass, and the 10 km course follows parts of the historic route of the Olympic Dayrun from the 1980s and 90s.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Lillehammer on paved city streets
The 10 km course follows parts of the former Olympic Dayrun route
Music, bands and cheering crowds bring the course to life
additional: Music, bands, drums, majorettes and a DJ create a lively atmosphere along the course. The race welcomes both fast runners and those who prefer a more relaxed pace. BarneBirken Street Run supports a charitable cause by collecting donations for Right To Play. The 10 km distance is open to participants who turn at least 13 in 2027. The course returns to the finish just south of Mesna Bru.

name: Hagemanns rundbaneløp 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race held on Svelvik Cycling Club’s loop course. The challenge is to complete a 6.7 km loop within one hour, with a start every hour on the hour from 10:00. Participants who fail to finish within the time limit are eliminated, and the aim is to be the last one standing. A children’s race is also held, and participants can choose to run a single loop at any time. The festival offers medals for all participants, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop course, with a start every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen available all weekend
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Pizza is served to participants at 19:30. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Buying and selling race bibs is possible. Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen are available all weekend. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday at 15:05. A children’s race is also held at Ebbestad Primary School. Information about course distance and elevation gain is from the 2025 edition.

name: Nattland Backyard Ultra
description: Nattland Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon held in Bergen, Vestland. The race consists of multiple laps on a set course, with participants running for as long as they can in an effort to be the last one to finish. The event takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, and attracts local and international ultrarunners looking for a challenging and social running experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a set course repeated every hour
A demanding ultramarathon focused on endurance and tactics
Held in scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Registration is via Eqtiming.no. The race takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, in Bergen. No specific start times or price details were found on the available pages. Registration via EQTiming.no.

name: Backyard Stavanger Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Stavanger is a unique ultrarunning event held at Dyrsnes Nature Centre in Stavanger. The race consists of a gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km, run on the hour every hour, with a maximum of 12 laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last person to start wins the race. The event offers a friendly and inclusive atmosphere with a low barrier to entry, welcoming both beginners and experienced ultrarunners. Simple refreshments and places to rest are provided. A headlamp and reflective vest are required for safety.
course_highlights: Gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km per lap
Runs start on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps (80.4 km in total)
Social event with places to rest in a tent and barn
additional: You must bring your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Attaching your bib with a race belt is recommended. Simple refreshments include snacks, coffee, tea, broth and water. Support is not permitted indoors or on the course, only in the start/finish area. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup and a wooden medal for the ultradistance (longer than a marathon). Maximum 210 participants. Your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest are mandatory.

name: Gruemila
description: Gruemila is a challenging 10 km race held in Kirkenær as part of the Grue Half Marathon event. The race features technically demanding forest terrain on 6.7 km loops, where participants can compete for the win or finish for a medal and finisher cap. The event also includes a fast, flat half marathon, considered one of Norway’s fastest courses. This is a great race for both competitive and recreational runners looking for a varied and exciting running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Technically challenging forest terrain on 6.7 km loops
Medal available for completing a loop
Flat and fast half marathon
additional: The race is run on 6.7 km loops through technically challenging forest terrain, with a new start every hour until only one runner remains. Complete one loop for a medal, or compete for a finisher cap and the win.

name: 1. Full Moon Backyard Ultra Kymi
description: Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which competitors run a 6.706-kilometre course within an hour. The race continues as long as multiple runners are able to complete a lap in under an hour, and the winner is the one who runs one lap more than the others. The course is either a loop or an out-and-back, and the start area remains the same throughout the race. There is no predetermined time limit, making the event especially challenging and exciting. Backyard Ultra races in Finland are organised in collaboration, and the sport is being actively developed.

name: Vihteljärven ympärijuoksu - 67.
description: Vihteljärvi Round-the-Lake Run is Satakunta’s oldest annual running event held continuously, having been organized since 1960. The event offers a 6.5-kilometer race in several age groups, as well as a fun run without timing. There are also separate shorter-distance races for children. The event is held at Vihteljärvi School in Kankaanpää and offers participants a traditional, community-oriented running experience in scenic surroundings.

name: Kiehimänjoen juoksu 2026
description: The Kiehimänjoki Run is a running event held for the fifth time in Paltamo, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10K fitness run and children’s race. The event starts on Saturday, 26 September 2026, at 11:00. The event centre is at Kotolinna, where runners can use the facilities, dine, use the saunas and arrange accommodation. The courses are officially measured, and all categories are timed. After the run, participants can book a recovery massage. On-site registration is available, with an additional fee for adults.

name: Lampaloppet 2026
description: Lampaloppet 2026 will be held on Saturday, 26 September 2026, in Lamminaho, Pyhäjärvi. The route winds through the scenery of Honkavuori and introduces runners to Ahto’s historic sites. The event offers a suitable challenge for both goal-oriented runners and those looking for a more relaxed outing. The competitive categories are timed, and there is also an untimed jogging category where participants can go at their own pace. Participants can use water stations, washing facilities and a sauna, and receive a Lampaloppet neck gaiter.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: The Viking Window Paide-Türi Fun Run is a traditional mass-participation sporting event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features varied terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the main race, includes children’s runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual highlight that brings the community and sports enthusiasts together.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: The International Nida Half Marathon is a traditional annual event held in Nida, on the Curonian Spit. The event includes a half-marathon distance, the 5 km YIT Run, and shorter distances for children and young people. It is a great opportunity for both professional and recreational runners to enjoy running in a unique natural setting and take part in the Lithuanian Half Marathon Championships. The event encourages physical activity and promotes sport in Lithuania, while participants can look forward to professionally prepared courses and a friendly atmosphere.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania’s most vertical off-road running race, held in Vilnius. Participants tackle the slopes of Liepkalnis, and the race offers an opportunity to earn ITRA ranking points. An eco-friendly “Trash Vertical” challenge is also organized to encourage participants to care for the environment. Registration for the event is free, so everyone is invited to take part and test their strength on this unique course.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
description: The 26th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 26, 2026, in Nida. The event offers several distances: a half marathon, a 5 km YIT run, a 2 km youth run, and short children’s runs (500 m and 210 m). The courses are certified according to World Athletics and AIMS requirements, and the starts take place at different locations in Nida. This traditional event encourages physical activity and promotes running and athletics in Lithuania.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a family-friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course starts again every full hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mostly along forest and field paths with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. It offers courses for all ability levels, from a children’s race for the youngest participants to a half marathon that passes through the impressive 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal bests. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup and also hosts the Thuringian State Road Running Championships.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on a range of courses of up to 24 km and up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on September 26, 2026, and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini run, where fun takes center stage. The event is family-friendly and offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can compare their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times added together to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. Alongside the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp grants are available for the top participants. The event supports young athletes and offers a thrilling platform for emerging running talent.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Loddefjordløpet
description: Loddefjordløpet is held at Alvøen Sports Park in Bergen and is an annual race featuring distances including a 5 km and children’s races of 2 km or 600 metres. It is a popular event for both children and adults, with a focus on athletics and recreational running in a welcoming atmosphere. Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which organises the race, also offers a range of training activities for children and young people in the area. For the latest information, follow the race’s Facebook page.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Alvøen Sports Park
Children’s races of 2 km and 600 metres
Held in scenic surroundings in western Bergen
additional: Loddefjordløpet includes both a 5 km race and children’s races over shorter distances. The organiser is Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which also offers athletics training for children and young people. Historical results from previous years are available on the website. Previous editions have offered free children’s races for pupils in grades 1–4, with a medal for participants. Information about the 2027 edition is not provided in the sources.

name: Norgesløpet 2027
description: Norgesløpet 2027 is held as a road race at Jessheim Stadium, with distances of 5 km (Norwegian Championships) and 10 km. The race starts on Kanalveien and finishes inside Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Registration is available in an elite start wave, and pacers are provided for the most popular finish times. The event also includes children’s races with multiple waves for different age groups, creating an enjoyable day with a great atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium
Course along Kanalveien marked with red and white ribbons
Water stations at approximately 5 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Bag storage is available with a baggage tag. Toilets and changing rooms are located in several nearby buildings. Train travel is recommended, with several parking areas nearby. Pacers run with visible flags or T-shirts. Children’s races are held at 11:30 and 14:00, with waves grouped by age. Fantorangen and the NRK Super Bus will be there for families. Children’s races are also held. Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Train travel is recommended; parking costs 50 NOK via Vipps.

description: Skoppums Råeste is a challenging and fun obstacle-course trail race suitable for everyone, from beginners to experienced OCR runners. The race takes place at Skoppum Idrettsplass and features mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, water crossings, muddy streams, tire obstacles, and crawling zones. Participants can choose to run 2.5 km with approximately 15–20 obstacles, or double the distance to 5 km by completing an extra lap. The race is accessible to all and includes timing, but everyone who finishes receives a medal and is considered a winner. There is also a separate MiniRåeste for children under 10, with a shorter obstacle course.
course_highlights: Obstacle-course trail featuring mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, and water crossings
Approximately 2.5 km course with 15–20 obstacles; participants can run 5 km by completing two laps
Accessible race with timing and a medal for all participants
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 for bib pickup. Skoppums MiniRåeste for children under 10 starts at 11:00. Participants can choose a start group based on an expected lap time of under or over 30 minutes. Changing rooms and washing facilities are available, as is a kiosk that accepts payment via Vipps. Parking costs NOK 50 and is paid via Vipps. All participants receive a medal. The course can be walked before the start, but obstacles must not be tested. Timing and medals are provided. Start groups are divided by expected lap time: under or over 30 minutes. The prices found apply to 2027 registration on the page for the 2026 event.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distance options for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, along with the youth and children’s races, are popular and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ stages have secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on 27 September 2026 in Hamburg and offers runners an appealing natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from the half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as fun runs for children. The route stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburg Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical care.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the largest and most prestigious marathon events in the world and is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and various ways to take part through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and includes various race routes through the city.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, that passes through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf loops of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event places emphasis on professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Cabbage Day Run is a long-standing race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Company Cup. The event offers a range of distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The courses are traffic-free, clearly marked, and have markers at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and timing is provided professionally using a chip attached to the race number. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a long-standing running competition in Kleinmachnow, taking place on September 27, 2026, at Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School. The event offers various competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants can enjoy drinks and refreshments in the finish area and receive medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends of Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers runners and walkers various race distances in the great outdoors around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to medium-sized hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. Events include a bambinilauf, school races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walking event, and the 10 km main race. The routes pass through Lübeck’s city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including those who are not members of a club, and offers team rankings and a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking event in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and is organised by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances are offered, ranging from 400 m to 8.6 km, as well as a Nordic walking competition, in which the use of poles is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 entries; late registration is possible through the day of the event.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly along paved roads through the city centre. In addition to the main races over 5 and 10 kilometres, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026
description: The Kaunas District Run 2026 is a traditional sporting event held at a distinctive location in Kaunas District—the square next to the Old Zapyškis Church of St. John the Baptist. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, bringing together running enthusiasts of all ages and abilities. Participants can choose from several distances, while the organizers provide a safe, technically prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere for everyone.
